src.control_plane.orchestrator

orchestrator.py

Closed-loop AI Engineering Control Plane orchestrator. Enforces the complete governed lifecycle: Discovery -> Shadow Audit -> Plan/Route -> Implement -> Delta Capture -> Adversarial Review -> Structured Validation -> Reconciliation -> Remediation Loop -> Targeted Re-review -> Deterministic Verification -> Human Authority Boundary Gate -> Complete Evidence Ledger.

  87# Structured reasons a governed task did not reach "complete" (#59.1 Phase 1).
  88# The orchestrator assigns only the classes it can prove from its own gates.

 126# Retention vocabulary. A retained salvage artifact is a productive timeout's
 127# work that was rolled back out of the working tree so the next provider could
 128# start clean, and kept as a bounded terminal fallback. Retention is not
 129# acceptance, and a retained artifact is deliberately not yet the run's
 130# candidate (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-07R).
 131SALVAGE_ELIGIBLE = "ELIGIBLE"
 132SALVAGE_NOT_REPLAYABLE = "NOT_REPLAYABLE"
 133SALVAGE_RETAINED = "RETAINED"
 134SALVAGE_PROMOTED = "PROMOTED"
 135# A later attempt succeeded on its own, so the fallback is history, not an
 136# option. Recorded so nothing can later re-select an artifact that was
 137# superseded by provider-attested work.
 138SALVAGE_SUPERSEDED = "SUPERSEDED"
 139# Found, but proven not safely restorable. Recorded so a resumed run does not
 140# reach for the same unusable artifact forever.
 141SALVAGE_UNUSABLE = "UNUSABLE"
 142NEXT_SELECTION_SALVAGE_PROMOTED = "RETAINED_SALVAGE_PROMOTED"
 143
 144# Interruption points that only exist so the retention lifecycle can be crash

 147FAULT_DURING_SALVAGE_PROMOTION = "during_salvage_promotion"

 190@dataclass
 191class OrchestrationConfig:
 192    """Runtime configuration for governed task orchestration."""
 193
 194    max_remediation_cycles: int = 3
 195    max_review_cycles: int = 4
 196    timeout_seconds: int = 600
 197    # Remediation budget policy. When None, a bounded dynamic budget is derived
 198    # from the number/severity of review findings and affected files. Explicit
 199    # values are honored up to the configured multiplier ceiling.
 200    remediation_timeout_seconds: Optional[int] = None
 201    remediation_timeout_max_multiplier: float = 3.0
 202    remediation_timeout_per_finding_seconds: int = 60
 203    remediation_timeout_per_affected_file_seconds: int = 30
 204    dogfood_mode: str = "shadow"
 205    enable_howlframe_audit: bool = True
 206    record_evidence: bool = True
 207    record_trajectory: bool = True
 208    trajectory_store_dir: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None
 209    stop_on_verification_failure: bool = True
 210    force: bool = False
 211    skip_doctor: bool = False
 212    acquire_locks: bool = True
 213    failure_injection_hook: Optional[Callable[[str, Path, TaskSpec], None]] = None
 214    custom_backend: Optional[AgentBackend] = None
 215    custom_reviewer_fn: Optional[Callable[[str, str, TaskSpec], str]] = None
 216    custom_remediation_fn: Optional[Callable[[TaskSpec, Path, List[ReviewFinding]], None]] = None
 217    reviewer_agent_mapping: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None
 218    # Global safety ceiling. Normal traversal tries every eligible resource at
 219    # most once; this only limits pathological or unexpectedly huge inventories.
 220    max_provider_failover_attempts: int = 8
 221    # A provider is stalled only after this period with no meaningful semantic
 222    # progress. Raw CLI output and supervisor heartbeats are liveness evidence,
 223    # not progress. The absolute timeout remains final.
 224    provider_stall_timeout_seconds: int = 120
 225    provider_watchdog_interval_seconds: float = 0.25
 226    # Optional resolver that overrides AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend. Useful
 227    # in deterministic tests to inject per-resource fake backends.
 228    backend_resolver: Optional[Callable[[str], AgentBackend]] = None
 229    run_mode: str = "continuous"  # "continuous" | "bounded"
 230    bounded_remediation_timeout_ceiling_seconds: int = 300  # 5 minutes maximum for bounded runs
 231    preserve_independent_review: bool = True
 232    # Enables bounded reviewer failover (#59.2 Phase 4) in the governed review
 233    # cycle: a reviewer whose assigned provider fails, times out, or emits
 234    # invalid/malformed output gets one alternate-provider attempt instead of
 235    # immediately blocking the task. Sharing the caller's pool means review
 236    # quota exhaustion updates the same provider state implementation failover
 237    # reads (#59.2 Phase 9). Left None (the default) by callers that inject a
 238    # custom_backend/custom_reviewer_fn, which keeps deterministic tests on the
 239    # prior single-attempt path.
 240    provider_pool: Optional[Any] = None
 241    heartbeat_interval: float = DEFAULT_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS
 242    progress_stream: Optional[Any] = None
 243    progress_mode: str = "auto"
 244    progress_tracker: Optional[Any] = None
 245    # Root directory for external provider scratch workspaces. When None, defaults
 246    # to $HOWLPLANE_SCRATCH_ROOT or $XDG_CACHE_HOME/howlplane/scratch (~/.cache).
 247    scratch_root: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None
 248    # Run deterministic gates against a sanitized view (baseline + task delta)
 249    # instead of the live checkout, so untracked control plane evidence cannot
 250    # change a verification result (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-07S).
 251    verification_isolation: bool = True

 253
 254def compute_remediation_timeout(
 255    config: OrchestrationConfig,
 256    findings: Optional[List[ReviewFinding]] = None,
 257    affected_files: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None,
 258) -> int:
 259    """Returns a bounded execution budget for a remediation cycle.
 260
 261    The default policy is explicit, simple, and capped:
 262    - Start from the implementation timeout.
 263    - Add time per review finding weighted by severity.
 264    - Add time per affected file.
 265    - Never exceed max_multiplier * base timeout.
 266    - For bounded runs, never exceed bounded_remediation_timeout_ceiling_seconds.
 267
 268    An explicit ``remediation_timeout_seconds`` is honored up to the same max.
 269    """
 270    base = config.timeout_seconds
 271    max_total = int(base * max(1.0, config.remediation_timeout_max_multiplier))
 272    if config.run_mode == "bounded":
 273        max_total = min(max_total, config.bounded_remediation_timeout_ceiling_seconds)
 274
 275    if config.remediation_timeout_seconds is not None:
 276        return min(config.remediation_timeout_seconds, max_total)
 277
 278    severity_seconds = {
 279        "blocker": 120,
 280        "high": 90,
 281        "medium": 60,
 282        "low": 30,
 283        "informational": 15,
 284    }
 285
 286    finding_overhead = 0
 287    for finding in findings or []:
 288        finding_overhead += severity_seconds.get(finding.severity, 60)
 289
 290    file_overhead = (len(set(affected_files or []))) * config.remediation_timeout_per_affected_file_seconds
 291
 292    calculated = base + finding_overhead + file_overhead
 293    if config.run_mode == "bounded":
 294        return min(calculated, max_total)
 295    return max(base, min(calculated, max_total))
 296

 349    schema: str = ORCHESTRATOR_SCHEMA_VERSION
 350
 351    @property
 352    def executing_provider(self) -> Optional[str]:
 353        """The provider that actually executed, from observed evidence."""
 354        if self.provider_execution is not None:
 355            return self.provider_execution.agent_id
 356        return self.routing_decision.selected_agent_id if self.routing_decision else None
 357
 358    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 359        return {
 360            "task_id": self.task_id,
 361            "final_state": self.final_state,
 362            "exit_code": self.exit_code,
 363            "routing_decision": asdict(self.routing_decision) if self.routing_decision else None,
 364            "initial_delta": self.initial_delta.to_dict() if self.initial_delta else None,
 365            "final_delta": self.final_delta.to_dict() if self.final_delta else None,
 366            "review_cycles": [c.to_dict() for c in self.review_cycles],
 367            "reconciliation": self.reconciliation.to_dict() if self.reconciliation else None,
 368            "verification_plan": self.verification_plan.to_dict() if self.verification_plan else None,
 369            "howlframe_audit_status": self.howlframe_audit_status,
 370            "howlframe_audit_match": self.howlframe_audit_match,
 371            "remediation_cycles_count": self.remediation_cycles_count,
 372            "duration_seconds": self.duration_seconds,
 373            "error_message": self.error_message,
 374            "run_dir": self.run_dir,
 375            "provider_execution": self.provider_execution.to_dict() if self.provider_execution else None,
 376            "executing_provider": self.executing_provider,
 377            "failure_class": self.failure_class,
 378            "resource_selection": self.resource_selection,
 379            "capacity_after": self.capacity_after,
 380            "trajectory_id": self.trajectory_id,
 381            "implementation_attempts": self.implementation_attempts,
 382            "failover_summary": self.failover_summary,
 383            "schema": self.schema,
 384        }
