 387class GovernedTaskOrchestrator:
 388    """
 389    Drives the end-to-end governed engineering lifecycle, maintaining
 390    strict control over state transitions, adversarial reviews,
 391    remediation loops, verification gates, and human authority boundaries.
 392    """
 393
 394    def __init__(
 395        self,
 396        target_repo: Union[str, Path],
 397        control_plane_root: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
 398        config: Optional[OrchestrationConfig] = None,
 399    ):
 400        self.target_repo = Path(target_repo).resolve()
 401        self.control_plane_root = (
 402            Path(control_plane_root).resolve()
 403            if control_plane_root
 404            else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
 405        )
 406        self.config = config or OrchestrationConfig()
 407        ledger_path = str(self.control_plane_root / "logs" / "control_plane" / "evidence_ledger.jsonl")
 408        self.ledger = EvidenceLedger(ledger_path)
 409        traj_dir = self.config.trajectory_store_dir
 410        if traj_dir is None:
 411            traj_dir = self.control_plane_root / "logs" / "control_plane" / "trajectories"
 412        self.trajectory_store = TrajectoryStore(traj_dir) if self.config.record_trajectory else None
 413
 414    def _enforce_task_path_scope(self, task_spec: TaskSpec, delta: RepositoryDelta) -> List[str]:
 415        """
 416        Reverts edits outside `task_spec.allowed_paths` before the delta is
 417        reviewed (#59.2 Phase 8/17).
 418
 419        `allowed_paths` was previously enforced only at commit time, inside
 420        GitIntegrationExecutor.stage_and_commit -- after independent review had
 421        already seen (and legitimately objected to) the out-of-scope work. A
 422        path-scoped task whose agent wandered into production files therefore
 423        parked on review findings about code it was never permitted to change.
 424        Enforcing here keeps the reviewed diff identical to the committed one.
 425
 426        Reverts only the paths the delta itself names, using the same
 427        `git checkout --` / unlink pair as _reconcile_attempt_state: no
 428        `git reset --hard`, no `git clean`, and files the task never touched
 429        are never inspected. Returns the reverted paths (empty when the task
 430        declares no scope, which is the default for ordinary tasks).
 431        """
 432        allowed = list(task_spec.allowed_paths or [])
 433        if not allowed or delta is None or delta.is_empty:
 434            return []
 435
 436        repo_root = Path(self.target_repo).resolve()
 437        out_of_scope = [
 438            p for p in (
 439                list(delta.files_modified) + list(delta.files_deleted) + list(delta.files_added)
 440            )
 441            if p not in allowed
 442        ]
 443        added = set(delta.files_added)
 444        for rel_path in out_of_scope:
 445            if rel_path in added:
 446                candidate = (repo_root / rel_path).resolve()
 447                # Never step outside the repository, whatever the delta claims.
 448                if not str(candidate).startswith(str(repo_root)):
 449                    continue
 450                try:
 451                    if candidate.is_file():
 452                        candidate.unlink()
 453                except OSError:
 454                    pass
 455            else:
 456                run_git(repo_root, ["checkout", "--", rel_path], 30)
 457        return out_of_scope
 458
 459    def _capture_scoped_delta(
 460        self,
 461        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 462        baseline: GitBaseline,
 463        agent_id: str,
 464        stage: str,
 465    ) -> RepositoryDelta:
 466        """Capture delta and revert any out-of-scope edits before review/commit."""
 467        delta = capture_delta(self.target_repo, baseline)
 468        reverted_scope = self._enforce_task_path_scope(task_spec, delta)
 469        if reverted_scope:
 470            delta = capture_delta(self.target_repo, baseline)
 471            self._record_event(
 472                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 473                agent_id=agent_id,
 474                action="out_of_scope_edits_reverted",
 475                spec=task_spec,
 476                metadata={"reverted_paths": reverted_scope, "allowed_paths": list(task_spec.allowed_paths), "stage": stage},
 477            )
 478        return delta
 479
 480    def _record_implementation_attempt(
 481        self,
 482        run_dir: Path,
 483        attempts_dir: Path,
 484        attempt_num: int,
 485        resource_id: str,
 486        impl_res: Optional[AgentExecutionResult],
 487        delta: RepositoryDelta,
 488        failure_class: Optional[str],
 489        capacity_before: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
 490    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 491        """Persists attempt-level evidence and returns an additive record."""
 492        attempt_dir = attempts_dir / f"{attempt_num:02d}-{resource_id}"
 493        attempt_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 494
 495        if impl_res is not None:
 496            (attempt_dir / "result.json").write_text(impl_res.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
 497        (attempt_dir / "diff.patch").write_text(delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")
 498        if not delta.is_empty:
 499            (attempt_dir / "partial_work.patch").write_text(delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")
 500
 501        # A retained salvage artifact from an earlier, interrupted run lives on
 502        # this attempt's record. Re-recording the same slot on resume must not
 503        # erase the fallback; its patch is kept under its own name and its
 504        # identity is digest-checked before any promotion, so carrying it
 505        # forward can only ever be verified, never trusted blindly.
 506        carried_salvage: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
 507        existing_record = attempt_dir / "attempt_record.json"
 508        if existing_record.is_file():
 509            try:
 510                carried_salvage = (
 511                    safe_load_json(existing_record) or {}
 512                ).get("retained_salvage")
 513            except Exception:
 514                carried_salvage = None
 515
 516        capacity_after: Dict[str, str] = {}
 517        if self.config.provider_pool is not None:
 518            # record_result already mutated state; capture after.
 519            capacity_after = self.config.provider_pool.get_all_statuses()
 520
 521        record: Dict[str, Any] = {
 522            "attempt": attempt_num,
 523            "resource_id": resource_id,
 524            "agent_id": impl_res.agent_id if impl_res else resource_id,
 525            "identity": self._resource_identity_fields(resource_id),
 526            "success": impl_res.success if impl_res else False,
 527            "exit_code": impl_res.exit_code if impl_res else None,
 528            "duration_seconds": impl_res.duration_seconds if impl_res else 0.0,
 529            "failure_class": failure_class,
 530            "delta": delta.to_dict(),
 531            "capacity_before": capacity_before,
 532            "capacity_after": capacity_after,
 533            "schema": IMPLEMENTATION_ATTEMPT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
 534            "evidence_dir": str(attempt_dir.relative_to(run_dir)),
 535        }
 536        if impl_res and isinstance((impl_res.metadata or {}).get("watchdog_diagnostics"), dict):
 537            record["watchdog_diagnostics"] = impl_res.metadata["watchdog_diagnostics"]
 538        if carried_salvage:
 539            record["retained_salvage"] = carried_salvage
 540        self._persist_attempt_record(record, attempts_dir)
 541        return record
 542
 543    def _resource_identity_fields(self, resource_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 544        """Names which provider, interface, and model actually ran this attempt."""
 545        state = (
 546            self.config.provider_pool.get_resource_status(resource_id)
 547            if self.config.provider_pool is not None else None
 548        )
 549        if state is None:
 550            return {
 551                "provider_id": None,
 552                "interface_id": None,
 553                "resource_id": resource_id,
 554                "model_id": None,
 555            }
 556        return {
 557            "provider_id": state.provider_id,
 558            "interface_id": state.interface_id,
 559            "resource_id": state.resource_id or resource_id,
 560            "model_id": state.model_id,
 561        }
 562
 563    @staticmethod
 564    def _persist_attempt_record(
 565        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
 566        attempts_dir: Path,
 567    ) -> None:
 568        """Rewrites an attempt's record in place as later evidence is amended.
 569
 570        Attempt evidence is additive and is filled in across the attempt's
 571        lifetime -- the result first, then the failover selection, then the
 572        rollback outcome, and now the retained-salvage block -- so every
 573        amendment goes through here rather than opening its own write path.
 574
 575        The write is atomic because a retained salvage artifact is discoverable
 576        only through this file: a torn write during an interruption would lose
 577        the fallback that HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-07R proved must survive.
 578        """
 579        record_path = (
 580            attempts_dir
 581            / f"{attempt_record['attempt']:02d}-{attempt_record['resource_id']}"
 582            / "attempt_record.json"
 583        )
 584        atomic_write_json(record_path, attempt_record)
 585
 586    def _attach_next_selection(
 587        self,
 588        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
 589        attempts_dir: Path,
 590        decision: Any,
 591    ) -> None:
 592        """Records which resource failover chose next, and why the others lost."""
 593        selected = getattr(decision, "selected", None)
 594        attempt_record["next_selection"] = {
 595            "selected_resource_id": selected.resource_id if selected else None,
 596            "blocked_reason": getattr(decision, "blocked_reason", None),
 597            "eligible_resources": [
 598                identity.resource_id
 599                for identity in getattr(decision, "eligible_resources", []) or []
 600            ],
 601            "exclusions": [
 602                {
 603                    "resource_id": exclusion.resource_id,
 604                    "reason": exclusion.reason,
 605                    "stage": exclusion.stage,
 606                }
 607                for exclusion in getattr(decision, "exclusions", []) or []
 608            ],
 609        }
 610        self._persist_attempt_record(attempt_record, attempts_dir)
 611
 612    def _attach_rollback_result(
 613        self,
 614        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
 615        attempts_dir: Path,
 616        restored: bool,
 617        error: Optional[str],
 618    ) -> None:
 619        """Records whether this attempt's work was safely undone before the next."""
 620        attempt_record["rollback"] = {"restored": restored, "error": error}
 621        self._persist_attempt_record(attempt_record, attempts_dir)
 622
 623    def _park_awaiting_human(
 624        self,
 625        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 626        run_dir: Path,
 627        err_msg: str,
 628        decision_pkt: "HumanDecisionPacket",
 629        progress: Any,
 630    ) -> None:
 631        """Hands a task to human authority, leaving the working tree in place.
 632
 633        Every parking path performs the same five steps, and the working tree is
 634        deliberately never rolled back here: a human is being asked to look at
 635        exactly what is on disk.
 636        """
 637        progress.record_terminal(
 638            TaskProgressState.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
 639            TaskPhase.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
 640            error_message=err_msg,
 641        )
 642        task_spec.transition_to("awaiting_human", err_msg)
 643        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
 644        (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(
 645            decision_pkt.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8"
 646        )
 647        self._record_human_boundary_events(task_spec, run_dir, reason=err_msg)
 648
 649    def _get_scratch_base_path(self) -> Path:
 650        """Determines the root directory for external provider scratch workspaces.
 651
 652        Provider scratch and the sanitized verification view share one root and
 653        one containment rule, so a root configured inside the target repository
 654        is rejected identically for both.
 655        """
 656        repo = self.target_repo if hasattr(self, "target_repo") else Path.cwd()
 657        return resolve_external_scratch_root(repo, self.config.scratch_root)
 658
 659    def _execute_verification_plan(
 660        self,
 661        verif_plan: VerificationPlan,
 662        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 663        baseline: GitBaseline,
 664        delta: RepositoryDelta,
 665        run_dir: Path,
 666        progress: Optional[Any],
 667    ) -> str:
 668        """Runs the deterministic gates against a sanitized view of the repository.
 669
 670        The gates measure the product, so they must see the product and nothing
 671        else. Running them in the live checkout let untracked control plane
 672        evidence decide the outcome: in HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-07S a provider's
 673        source clone under `.task_runs/` moved the `go_production` clone count
 674        from 291 to 1421 without a line of product code changing.
 675
 676        A view that cannot be built fails the gate. Falling back to the live
 677        checkout would quietly restore that contamination and report the result
 678        as if it had been isolated.
 679        """
 680        if not self.config.verification_isolation:
 681            return verif_plan.execute_all(
 682                cwd=str(self.target_repo),
 683                stop_on_failure=self.config.stop_on_verification_failure,
 684                progress_tracker=progress,
 685            )
 686
 687        view_ref: Optional[Any] = None
 688        try:
 689            with verification_view(
 690                target_repo=self.target_repo,
 691                baseline=baseline,
 692                delta=delta,
 693                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 694                scratch_root=self.config.scratch_root,
 695            ) as view:
 696                view_ref = view
 697                self._record_event(
 698                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 699                    agent_id="control_plane",
 700                    action="verification_view_created",
 701                    spec=task_spec,
 702                    metadata={
 703                        "baseline_sha": view.baseline_sha,
 704                        "files_materialized": len(view.files_materialized),
 705                        "files_refused": view.files_refused,
 706                    },
 707                )
 708                status = verif_plan.execute_all(
 709                    cwd=str(view.path),
 710                    stop_on_failure=self.config.stop_on_verification_failure,
 711                    progress_tracker=progress,
 712                )
 713        except VerificationViewError as exc:
 714            reason = f"Sanitized verification view could not be built: {exc}"
 715            verif_plan.add_step(
 716                step_id="step-verification-view",
 717                name="Sanitized verification view",
 718                command=["git", "worktree", "add", "--detach"],
 719                category="policy_check",
 720                required=True,
 721                metadata={"baseline_sha": getattr(baseline, "initial_commit_sha", "")},
 722            )
 723            failed_step = verif_plan.steps[-1]
 724            failed_step.status = "failed"
 725            failed_step.exit_code = 1
 726            failed_step.stderr = reason
 727            verif_plan.overall_status = "failed"
 728            atomic_write_json(
 729                run_dir / "verification_view.json",
 730                {
 731                    "schema": VERIFICATION_VIEW_SCHEMA_VERSION,
 732                    "task_id": task_spec.task_id,
 733                    "status": "unavailable",
 734                    "error": str(exc),
 735                },
 736            )
 737            self._record_event(
 738                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 739                agent_id="control_plane",
 740                action="verification_view_failed",
 741                spec=task_spec,
 742                result="failed",
 743                metadata={"error": str(exc)},
 744            )
 745            return "failed"
 746
 747        # Written after teardown so the recorded cleanup status is the real one.
 748        if view_ref is not None:
 749            atomic_write_json(run_dir / "verification_view.json", view_ref.to_dict())
 750        return status
 751
 752    def _attempt_workspace_hint(self, task: TaskSpec) -> str:
 753        """The provider-writable scratch path, as named to the provider.
 754
 755        Deliberately outside `implementation/attempts/` and outside the target
 756        repository so scratch source trees or build caches cannot contaminate
 757        deterministic repository verification gates (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-07S).
 758        """
 759        base = self._get_scratch_base_path()
 760        repo_slug = self.target_repo.resolve().name if hasattr(self, "target_repo") else "repo"
 761        return f"{base}/{repo_slug}/{task.task_id}/provider_scratch/<NN-resource>/"
 762
 763    def _provider_scratch_dir(self, run_dir: Path, attempt_num: int, resource_id: str) -> Path:
 764        """Control-plane-owned scratch location for one attempt's provider."""
 765        base = self._get_scratch_base_path()
 766        repo_slug = self.target_repo.resolve().name if hasattr(self, "target_repo") else run_dir.parent.parent.name
 767        scratch_dir = base / repo_slug / run_dir.name / "provider_scratch" / f"{attempt_num:02d}-{resource_id}"
 768        scratch_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 769        return scratch_dir
 770
 771    def _record_scratch_manifest(
 772        self,
 773        run_dir: Path,
 774        task_id: str,
 775        attempt_num: int,
 776        resource_id: str,
 777        scratch_dir: Path,
 778        status: str = "active",
 779        artifacts: Optional[List[str]] = None,
 780    ) -> None:
 781        """Records durable scratch location and ownership metadata in evidence."""
 782        manifest_path = run_dir / "scratch_manifest.json"
 783        manifest: Dict[str, Any] = {}
 784        if manifest_path.is_file():
 785            try:
 786                manifest = safe_load_json(manifest_path) or {}
 787            except Exception:
 788                manifest = {}
 789        if not manifest:
 790            manifest = {
 791                "task_id": task_id,
 792                "repository": str(self.target_repo.resolve()) if hasattr(self, "target_repo") else str(run_dir.parent.parent),
 793                "scratch_root": str(self._get_scratch_base_path()),
 794                "attempts": {},
 795                "schema": SCRATCH_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,
 796            }
 797        attempt_key = f"{attempt_num:02d}-{resource_id}"
 798        attempt_entry = manifest.get("attempts", {}).get(attempt_key, {})
 799        attempt_entry.update({
 800            "attempt": attempt_num,
 801            "resource_id": resource_id,
 802            "scratch_path": str(scratch_dir.resolve()),
 803            "status": status,
 804            "updated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 805        })
 806        if "created_at" not in attempt_entry:
 807            attempt_entry["created_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 808        if artifacts:
 809            existing = set(attempt_entry.get("artifacts", []))
 810            existing.update(artifacts)
 811            attempt_entry["artifacts"] = sorted(existing)
 812        manifest.setdefault("attempts", {})[attempt_key] = attempt_entry
 813        atomic_write_json(manifest_path, manifest)
 814
 815    def _prune_ephemeral_scratch(self, run_dir: Path, task_id: str) -> None:
 816        """Prunes large disposable build and tool caches from external scratch.
 817
 818        Preserves candidate patches, diffs, provider transcripts, failure evidence,
 819        and provenance files. Never removes candidate material or durable evidence.
 820        Strictly validates containment beneath the authorized scratch base to prevent
 821        path traversal or unintended file deletion.
 822        """
 823        manifest_path = run_dir / "scratch_manifest.json"
 824        if not manifest_path.is_file():
 825            return
 826        try:
 827            manifest = safe_load_json(manifest_path)
 828            if not manifest or manifest.get("schema") != SCRATCH_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION:
 829                return
 830            if not isinstance(manifest.get("attempts"), dict):
 831                return
 832            scratch_base = self._get_scratch_base_path().resolve()
 833            disposable_names = {"go-cache", ".cache"}
 834            disposable_suffixes = {".tar", ".iso"}
 835            for attempt_key, attempt_info in manifest["attempts"].items():
 836                scratch_str = attempt_info.get("scratch_path")
 837                if not scratch_str:
 838                    continue
 839                scratch_p = Path(scratch_str).resolve()
 840                # Security: scratch directory must be strictly contained within scratch_base,
 841                # cannot be scratch_base itself, and cannot be a symlink.
 842                if not scratch_p.is_relative_to(scratch_base) or scratch_p == scratch_base:
 843                    continue
 844                if scratch_p.is_symlink() or not scratch_p.is_dir():
 845                    continue
 846                pruned = False
 847                for item in scratch_p.iterdir():
 848                    if item.is_symlink():
 849                        continue
 850                    if item.is_dir() and item.name in disposable_names:
 851                        shutil.rmtree(item, ignore_errors=True)
 852                        pruned = True
 853                    elif item.is_file() and item.suffix in disposable_suffixes:
 854                        try:
 855                            item.unlink()
 856                            pruned = True
 857                        except OSError:
 858                            pass
 859                if pruned:
 860                    attempt_info["status"] = "cleaned"
 861                    attempt_info["pruned_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 862            atomic_write_json(manifest_path, manifest)
 863        except Exception:
 864            pass
 865
 866    def _resolve_backend(self, resource_id: str) -> AgentBackend:
 867        """Resolves the execution backend for a resource, however it is wired.
 868
 869        A resumed run reconciles its implementation from the durable delta and
 870        never enters the attempt loop, so the loop-local backend it used to rely
 871        on did not exist by the time remediation needed one -- resume died with
 872        an UnboundLocalError before it could finish recovering anything.
 873        """
 874        if self.config.custom_backend is not None:
 875            return self.config.custom_backend
 876        if self.config.backend_resolver is not None:
 877            return self.config.backend_resolver(resource_id)
 878        return AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(resource_id)
 879
 880    def _sweep_provider_scratch(
 881        self,
 882        run_dir: Path,
 883        resource_id: str,
 884        attempt_num: int,
 885        known_before: Set[str],
 886        attempts_dir: Optional[Path] = None,
 887        attempts_before: Optional[Set[str]] = None,
 888        owned_attempt_name: Optional[str] = None,
 889    ) -> List[str]:
 890        """Moves anything a provider left in the evidence namespace into scratch.
 891
 892        Providers write where they like -- they run in the repository with no
 893        filesystem sandbox -- so the boundary is enforced afterwards rather than
 894        assumed. Two escapes are swept: artifacts dropped at the run's evidence
 895        root (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05), and directories invented under
 896        `implementation/attempts/` that imitate a canonical attempt
 897        (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06, where `01-claude/` made a three-attempt run look
 898        like four). Both are relocated with provenance and nothing is deleted:
 899        the artifacts may well be useful, they are simply not evidence.
 900        """
 901        scratch = self._provider_scratch_dir(run_dir, attempt_num, resource_id)
 902        swept: List[str] = []
 903
 904        def relocate(entry: Path, label: str) -> None:
 905            scratch.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 906            destination = scratch / entry.name
 907            if destination.exists():
 908                destination = scratch / f"{entry.name}.{attempt_num:02d}"
 909            try:
 910                entry.replace(destination)
 911            except OSError:
 912                return
 913            swept.append(label)
 914
 915        for entry in sorted(run_dir.iterdir()):
 916            if entry.name in known_before:
 917                continue
 918            if entry.name in CONTROL_PLANE_RUN_ARTIFACTS:
 919                continue
 920            relocate(entry, entry.name)
 921
 922        # A directory under attempts/ that this run did not create is a
 923        # provider's guess at its own attempt label, not an attempt.
 924        if attempts_dir is not None and attempts_dir.is_dir():
 925            known_attempts = attempts_before or set()
 926            for entry in sorted(attempts_dir.iterdir()):
 927                if not entry.is_dir():
 928                    continue
 929                if entry.name in known_attempts or entry.name == owned_attempt_name:
 930                    continue
 931                if (entry / "attempt_record.json").is_file():
 932                    # Real control-plane evidence; never touch it.
 933                    continue
 934                for child in sorted(entry.iterdir()):
 935                    relocate(child, f"implementation/attempts/{entry.name}/{child.name}")
 936                try:
 937                    # Only ever removes the empty shell left behind, so the
 938                    # canonical attempt count stops counting a fake one.
 939                    entry.rmdir()
 940                except OSError:
 941                    pass
 942
 943        if swept:
 944            atomic_write_json(
 945                scratch / "_provenance.json",
 946                {
 947                    "origin": "provider_scratch",
 948                    "created_by": resource_id,
 949                    "attempt": attempt_num,
 950                    "relocated_from": f".task_runs/{run_dir.name}/",
 951                    "files": swept,
 952                    "note": (
 953                        "Written by the provider inside the control plane's "
 954                        "evidence namespace and relocated here. Not control "
 955                        "plane evidence."
 956                    ),
 957                    "swept_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 958                    "schema": PROVIDER_SCRATCH_SCHEMA_VERSION,
 959                },
 960            )
 961            self._record_scratch_manifest(
 962                run_dir,
 963                run_dir.name,
 964                attempt_num,
 965                resource_id,
 966                scratch,
 967                status="relocated",
 968                artifacts=swept,
 969            )
 970        return swept
 971
 972    def _attach_terminal_disposition(
 973        self,
 974        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
 975        attempts_dir: Path,
 976        attempt_num: int,
 977        attempted: Set[str],
 978        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 979    ) -> None:
 980        """Records why a salvaged final attempt has no successor.
 981
 982        Attempts that hand off carry `rollback` and `next_selection`; the one
 983        that exhausts the budget carried neither, so "no provider remained" and
 984        "nobody wrote the field" looked identical in the evidence. The candidate
 985        is deliberately not rolled back -- it is parked for governance -- and
 986        that has to be stated, not inferred (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06).
 987        """
 988        remaining: List[str] = []
 989        pool = self.config.provider_pool
 990        if pool is not None:
 991            try:
 992                for resource_id in pool.select_candidates(
 993                    task_category="code_heavy", task=task_spec
 994                ):
 995                    if resource_id not in attempted:
 996                        remaining.append(resource_id)
 997            except Exception:
 998                remaining = []
 999
1000        attempt_record["max_attempts"] = self.config.max_provider_failover_attempts
1001        attempt_record["rollback"] = {
1002            "restored": False,
1003            "error": None,
1004            "status": ROLLBACK_PARKED_FOR_GOVERNANCE,
1005            "reason": (
1006                "Candidate preserved for governance instead of being rolled "
1007                "back; no further attempt follows it."
1008            ),
1009        }
1010        attempt_record["next_selection"] = None
1011        attempt_record["next_selection_reason"] = NEXT_SELECTION_MAX_ATTEMPTS
1012        attempt_record["remaining_eligible_resources"] = remaining
1013        attempt_record["transition"] = TRANSITION_CANDIDATE_GOVERNANCE
1014        self._persist_attempt_record(attempt_record, attempts_dir)
1015
1016    @staticmethod
1017    def _recover_implementation_resource(run_dir: Path, routing: Any) -> Optional[str]:
1018        """Restores which resource produced the work being resumed.
1019
1020        A resumed run re-routes from scratch, so the in-memory decision knows
1021        nothing about the failover that already happened. The durable effective
1022        route does, and it is the only truthful source for who to credit --
1023        and, until governance clears it, who not to let review their own work.
1024        """
1025        route_file = run_dir / "effective_route.json"
1026        if route_file.is_file():
1027            try:
1028                meta = (safe_load_json(route_file) or {}).get("metadata") or {}
1029            except Exception:
1030                meta = {}
1031            recovered = (
1032                meta.get("accepted_implementation_resource")
1033                or meta.get("candidate_resource")
1034                or meta.get("last_attempted_implementation_resource")
1035            )
1036            if recovered:
1037                # Carry the failover history forward so this run's evidence
1038                # continues the story instead of restarting it.
1039                for key in (
1040                    "initial_route",
1041                    "initial_implementation_resource",
1042                    "candidate_resource",
1043                    "last_attempted_implementation_resource",
1044                    "reviewer_resource_mapping",
1045                    "reviewer_resource_identities",
1046                ):
1047                    if key in meta and key not in routing.metadata:
1048                        routing.metadata[key] = meta[key]
1049                return recovered
1050        return routing.metadata.get("last_attempted_implementation_resource")
1051
1052    @staticmethod
1053    def _load_parked_candidate(run_dir: Path) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
1054        """Recovers a parked timeout candidate's record after an interruption.
1055
1056        The candidate is durable evidence, so a resumed run must know it is
1057        governing a salvaged fragment rather than provider-attested work.
1058        """
1059        attempts_dir = run_dir / "implementation" / "attempts"
1060        if not attempts_dir.is_dir():
1061            return None
1062        for attempt_dir in sorted(attempts_dir.iterdir(), reverse=True):
1063            candidate_file = attempt_dir / "candidate.json"
1064            if candidate_file.is_file():
1065                try:
1066                    return safe_load_json(candidate_file)
1067                except Exception:
1068                    return None
1069        return None
1070
1071    @staticmethod
1072    def _is_salvageable_timeout_candidate(
1073        failure_class: Optional[Any],
1074        delta: Optional[RepositoryDelta],
1075    ) -> bool:
1076        """Reports whether a budget-stopped attempt left work worth governing.
1077
1078        A provider we stopped at our own deadline never claimed completion, but
1079        that says nothing about what it had already written. When such an
1080        attempt leaves a non-empty task-attributable delta, the artifact is a
1081        candidate -- neither trustworthy nor disposable -- and belongs in review
1082        and verification rather than the bin (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05).
1083        """
1084        if failure_class != ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED:
1085            return False
1086        return delta is not None and not delta.is_empty
1087
1088    @staticmethod
1089    def _timed_out_artifact_provenance(
1090        resource_id: str,
1091        attempt: int,
1092        delta: RepositoryDelta,
1093    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1094        """The provenance every budget-stopped artifact carries.
1095
1096        A retained fallback and a governed candidate are the same artifact at
1097        two different points in its life, so they describe their origin
1098        identically -- including the completion claim their producer never made.
1099        """
1100        return {
1101            "provider_completion_claim": False,
1102            "origin": CANDIDATE_ORIGIN_TIMED_OUT,
1103            "failure_class": ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.value,
1104            "resource_id": resource_id,
1105            "attempt": attempt,
1106            "files_added": list(delta.files_added),
1107            "files_modified": list(delta.files_modified),
1108            "files_deleted": list(delta.files_deleted),
1109            "insertions": delta.insertions,
1110            "deletions": delta.deletions,
1111            "captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
1112        }
1113
1114    def _capture_timeout_candidate(
1115        self,
1116        run_dir: Path,
1117        attempts_dir: Path,
1118        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
1119        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1120        resource_id: str,
1121        delta: RepositoryDelta,
1122    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1123        """Preserves a budget-stopped candidate and marks it as needing governance.
1124
1125        Written before any rollback can run, and deliberately separate from the
1126        provider's own result: `implementation/result.json` keeps success=false,
1127        so nothing here fabricates a completion the provider never claimed.
1128        """
1129        candidate = {
1130            "candidate_captured": True,
1131            "requires_governance": True,
1132            **self._timed_out_artifact_provenance(
1133                resource_id, attempt_record["attempt"], delta
1134            ),
1135            "schema": TIMEOUT_CANDIDATE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
1136        }
1137        attempt_dir = attempts_dir / f"{attempt_record['attempt']:02d}-{resource_id}"
1138        attempt_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1139        atomic_write_json(attempt_dir / "candidate.json", candidate)
1140        (attempt_dir / "candidate.patch").write_text(delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")
1141
1142        attempt_record["candidate"] = candidate
1143        self._persist_attempt_record(attempt_record, attempts_dir)
1144
1145        # Publish it as the run's current diff so the existing review and
1146        # verification stages act on it exactly as they would a normal one.
1147        self._write_delta_patch(delta, run_dir / "implementation", run_dir)
1148        self._record_event(
1149            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1150            agent_id=resource_id,
1151            action="timeout_candidate_captured",
1152            spec=task_spec,
1153            metadata={
1154                "attempt": attempt_record["attempt"],
1155                "origin": CANDIDATE_ORIGIN_TIMED_OUT,
1156                "provider_completion_claim": False,
1157                "files_changed": len(delta.files_modified) + len(delta.files_added),
1158                "insertions": delta.insertions,
1159                "deletions": delta.deletions,
1160            },
1161        )
1162        return candidate
1163
1164    def _retain_salvage_artifact(
1165        self,
1166        attempts_dir: Path,
1167        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
1168        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1169        resource_id: str,
1170        delta: RepositoryDelta,
1171        baseline: GitBaseline,
1172    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1173        """Keeps a productive timeout's work as a bounded terminal fallback.
1174
1175        Rollback must not mean forgetting. HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-07R rolled Codex's
1176        eligible EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED artifact out of the tree so Claude
1177        could attempt from a clean baseline -- which was correct -- and then
1178        terminal-failed without ever reconsidering it, because salvage was only
1179        ever evaluated for whichever attempt happened to be last.
1180
1181        The record lives on the attempt record beside the already-written
1182        partial_work.patch, and deliberately not in a `candidate.json`: while
1183        fresh failover remains this is not the run's candidate and
1184        `candidate_resource` must stay null. Live implementation state and
1185        retained salvageable artifacts are different things.
1186        """
1187        retained = {
1188            "retained": True,
1189            "eligibility": SALVAGE_ELIGIBLE,
1190            "promotion_status": SALVAGE_RETAINED,
1191            **self._timed_out_artifact_provenance(
1192                resource_id, attempt_record["attempt"], delta
1193            ),
1194            "patch_path": f"{attempt_record['evidence_dir']}/retained_salvage.patch",
1195            "patch_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
1196                delta.diff_content.encode("utf-8")
1197            ).hexdigest(),
1198            # Patch identity: what this artifact was captured against, so a
1199            # later promotion can prove it is being replayed onto the same
1200            # repository state rather than whatever happens to be present.
1201            "baseline_head": baseline.initial_commit_sha,
1202            "baseline_status_digest": hashlib.sha256(
1203                baseline.status_porcelain.encode("utf-8")
1204            ).hexdigest(),
1205            # Answered against the restored baseline, which is the only tree
1206            # whose answer means anything. Unknown until rollback has run.
1207            "replayable": None,
1208        }
1209        # Written under a name no attempt-recording path ever produces:
1210        # partial_work.patch belongs to whichever attempt last occupied this
1211        # slot, but the fallback must outlive a resumed re-attempt.
1212        attempt_dir = attempts_dir / f"{attempt_record['attempt']:02d}-{resource_id}"
1213        attempt_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1214        (attempt_dir / "retained_salvage.patch").write_text(
1215            delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8"
1216        )
1217        attempt_record["retained_salvage"] = retained
1218        self._persist_attempt_record(attempt_record, attempts_dir)
1219        self._record_event(
1220            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1221            agent_id=resource_id,
1222            action="retained_salvage_captured",
1223            spec=task_spec,
1224            metadata={
1225                "attempt": attempt_record["attempt"],
1226                "origin": CANDIDATE_ORIGIN_TIMED_OUT,
1227                "provider_completion_claim": False,
1228                "insertions": delta.insertions,
1229                "deletions": delta.deletions,
1230                "baseline_head": baseline.initial_commit_sha,
1231            },
1232        )
1233        return retained
1234
1235    def _confirm_salvage_replayable(
1236        self,
1237        run_dir: Path,
1238        attempts_dir: Path,
1239        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
1240        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1241    ) -> bool:
1242        """Proves the retained patch still applies to the restored baseline.
1243
1244        Deliberately run after rollback rather than before it: the clean
1245        baseline is the tree a promotion would replay onto. `git apply --check`
1246        never writes, so this cannot disturb the state the next provider is
1247        about to be handed. An artifact that fails here stays as evidence but
1248        can never be selected, so it can never be partially applied.
1249        """
1250        retained = attempt_record.get("retained_salvage")
1251        if not retained:
1252            return False
1253        patch_file = run_dir / retained["patch_path"]
1254        replayable = False
1255        if patch_file.is_file():
1256            replayable = run_git(
1257                self.target_repo, ["apply", "--check", str(patch_file)], 60
1258            ).returncode == 0
1259        retained["replayable"] = replayable
1260        if not replayable:
1261            retained["eligibility"] = SALVAGE_NOT_REPLAYABLE
1262        self._persist_attempt_record(attempt_record, attempts_dir)
1263        self._record_event(
1264            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1265            agent_id=retained["resource_id"],
1266            action="retained_salvage_replay_checked",
1267            spec=task_spec,
1268            metadata={
1269                "attempt": retained["attempt"],
1270                "replayable": replayable,
1271                "eligibility": retained["eligibility"],
1272            },
1273        )
1274        return replayable
1275
1276    @staticmethod
1277    def _iter_attempt_records(attempts_dir: Path):
1278        """Yields (record, retained_salvage) per attempt, in attempt order.
1279
1280        Attempt evidence is the durable source of truth for retention, so both
1281        selection and supersession read it from disk rather than from memory --
1282        which is what makes a retained fallback survive an interruption for
1283        free.
1284        """
1285        if not attempts_dir.is_dir():
1286            return
1287        for attempt_dir in sorted(attempts_dir.iterdir()):
1288            record_file = attempt_dir / "attempt_record.json"
1289            if not record_file.is_file():
1290                continue
1291            try:
1292                record = safe_load_json(record_file) or {}
1293            except Exception:
1294                continue
1295            yield record, record.get("retained_salvage") or {}
1296
1297    @staticmethod
1298    def _select_retained_salvage(attempts_dir: Path) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
1299        """Picks the fallback deterministically: most recent eligible wins.
1300
1301        No scoring, no ranking, no size heuristic, no model judgment. This
1302        preserves the existing semantics -- a productive *final* timeout is
1303        already the candidate -- and merely extends the search backward to the
1304        nearest prior equivalent when the later attempts produced nothing.
1305
1306        Records are walked in attempt order and the last match is kept, so the
1307        rule holds however many attempts a run is configured to allow.
1308        """
1309        chosen: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
1310        for record, retained in GovernedTaskOrchestrator._iter_attempt_records(
1311            attempts_dir
1312        ):
1313            if (
1314                retained.get("retained")
1315                and retained.get("eligibility") == SALVAGE_ELIGIBLE
1316                and retained.get("promotion_status") == SALVAGE_RETAINED
1317            ):
1318                chosen = record
1319        return chosen
1320
1321    def _recover_promoted_salvage(
1322        self,
1323        run_dir: Path,
1324        delta: RepositoryDelta,
1325        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1326    ) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
1327        """Finishes a promotion that was interrupted after the patch landed.
1328
1329        The crash window between applying a retained patch and capturing the
1330        candidate leaves the artifact sitting in the tree with nothing
1331        describing it. Recovery has to prove the delta in the tree *is* that
1332        artifact, byte for byte, before crediting anyone for it: a resumed run
1333        whose delta came from a later provider -- or from a provider that
1334        simply succeeded -- must not have a rolled-back fragment's producer
1335        stamped onto it. Without that proof this would launder discarded work
1336        into an accepted implementation and certify a self-review as
1337        independent.
1338
1339        Proven, it rebuilds exactly the candidate the uninterrupted path would
1340        have written, so `provider_completion_claim` stays false and the
1341        artifact keeps its timed-out origin.
1342        """
1343        attempts_dir = run_dir / "implementation" / "attempts"
1344        record = self._select_retained_salvage(attempts_dir)
1345        if record is None:
1346            return None
1347        retained = record["retained_salvage"]
1348        if hashlib.sha256(
1349            delta.diff_content.encode("utf-8")
1350        ).hexdigest() != retained.get("patch_sha256"):
1351            return None
1352
1353        candidate = self._capture_timeout_candidate(
1354            run_dir=run_dir,
1355            attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
1356            attempt_record=record,
1357            task_spec=task_spec,
1358            resource_id=retained["resource_id"],
1359            delta=delta,
1360        )
1361        retained["promotion_status"] = SALVAGE_PROMOTED
1362        retained["promoted_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
1363        record["transition"] = TRANSITION_CANDIDATE_GOVERNANCE
1364        self._persist_attempt_record(record, attempts_dir)
1365        self._record_event(
1366            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1367            agent_id=retained["resource_id"],
1368            action="retained_salvage_promotion_recovered",
1369            spec=task_spec,
1370            metadata={
1371                "attempt": retained["attempt"],
1372                "resource_id": retained["resource_id"],
1373                "provider_completion_claim": False,
1374            },
1375        )
1376        return candidate
1377
1378    def _supersede_retained_salvage(
1379        self,
1380        attempts_dir: Path,
1381        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1382    ) -> None:
1383        """Retires every retained fallback once an attempt genuinely succeeds.
1384
1385        Provider-attested work outranks any fragment, so the fallbacks stop
1386        being options the moment one lands. Leaving them selectable would let a
1387        later resume reach for work that was deliberately superseded.
1388        """
1389        for record, retained in self._iter_attempt_records(attempts_dir):
1390            if retained.get("promotion_status") != SALVAGE_RETAINED:
1391                continue
1392            retained["promotion_status"] = SALVAGE_SUPERSEDED
1393            self._persist_attempt_record(record, attempts_dir)
1394            self._record_event(
1395                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1396                agent_id=retained.get("resource_id", "control_plane"),
1397                action="retained_salvage_superseded",
1398                spec=task_spec,
1399                metadata={"attempt": retained.get("attempt")},
1400            )
1401
1402    def _abandon_salvage_promotion(
1403        self,
1404        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1405        record: Dict[str, Any],
1406        attempts_dir: Path,
1407        reason: str,
1408    ) -> None:
1409        """Retires a fallback that was found but cannot be safely restored.
1410
1411        Marked unusable rather than merely logged: an artifact left eligible
1412        would be re-selected by every subsequent resume, retrying a restore
1413        that has already been proven impossible.
1414        """
1415        retained = record["retained_salvage"]
1416        retained["eligibility"] = SALVAGE_UNUSABLE
1417        retained["abandoned_reason"] = reason
1418        self._persist_attempt_record(record, attempts_dir)
1419        self._record_event(
1420            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1421            agent_id="control_plane",
1422            action="retained_salvage_promotion_failed",
1423            spec=task_spec,
1424            metadata={
1425                "attempt": retained.get("attempt"),
1426                "resource_id": retained.get("resource_id"),
1427                "reason": reason,
1428            },
1429        )
1430
1431    def _promote_retained_salvage(
1432        self,
1433        run_dir: Path,
1434        attempts_dir: Path,
1435        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1436        baseline: GitBaseline,
1437        current_delta: RepositoryDelta,
1438        attempt_record: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
1439    ) -> Optional[Tuple[Dict[str, Any], str, RepositoryDelta]]:
1440        """Recovers the retained fallback once no attempt produced a result.
1441
1442        This is governance of an artifact that already exists, not a new
1443        implementation attempt: no provider is re-invoked, no attempt record is
1444        added, and the bounded failover budget is untouched. Promoting Codex's
1445        retained artifact after attempt 3 failed does not create attempt 4.
1446
1447        Every step fails closed. A fallback that cannot be proven to belong to
1448        this baseline is left as evidence rather than applied, and nothing is
1449        ever partially applied.
1450        """
1451        record = self._select_retained_salvage(attempts_dir)
1452        if record is None:
1453            return None
1454        # `record` is a snapshot read from disk. When the attempt that just
1455        # failed occupies the same evidence slot -- which a resumed run makes
1456        # ordinary, since routing is deterministic -- `attempt_record` is the
1457        # live view of that same file, and writing the snapshot back would
1458        # erase the rollback result recorded below it.
1459        if (
1460            attempt_record is not None
1461            and attempt_record.get("attempt") == record.get("attempt")
1462            and attempt_record.get("resource_id") == record.get("resource_id")
1463        ):
1464            attempt_record["retained_salvage"] = record["retained_salvage"]
1465            record = attempt_record
1466        retained = record["retained_salvage"]
1467        producer = retained["resource_id"]
1468
1469        # The last attempt's state goes back through the sanctioned restore
1470        # path first, so pre-existing user work is put back before anything is
1471        # applied on top of it.
1472        restored_ok, restore_err = restore_repository_to_baseline(
1473            self.target_repo, baseline, current_delta
1474        )
1475        # The attempt that just failed still owes an honest rollback record.
1476        # Its work was undone here rather than in the failover branch, and
1477        # evidence that goes silent about it is what SLOPFIX-06 fixed.
1478        if attempt_record is not None:
1479            self._attach_rollback_result(
1480                attempt_record, attempts_dir, restored_ok, restore_err
1481            )
1482        if not restored_ok:
1483            self._abandon_salvage_promotion(
1484                task_spec, record, attempts_dir, f"baseline restore failed: {restore_err}"
1485            )
1486            return None
1487
1488        head_proc = run_git(self.target_repo, ["rev-parse", "HEAD"], 30)
1489        head = head_proc.stdout.strip() if head_proc.returncode == 0 else ""
1490        if head != retained.get("baseline_head"):
1491            self._abandon_salvage_promotion(
1492                task_spec,
1493                record,
1494                attempts_dir,
1495                f"baseline HEAD mismatch: expected {retained.get('baseline_head')}, "
1496                f"got {head or 'unknown'}",
1497            )
1498            return None
1499
1500        if hashlib.sha256(
1501            baseline.status_porcelain.encode("utf-8")
1502        ).hexdigest() != retained.get("baseline_status_digest"):
1503            self._abandon_salvage_promotion(
1504                task_spec,
1505                record,
1506                attempts_dir,
1507                "baseline state digest does not match the one captured with "
1508                "the artifact",
1509            )
1510            return None
1511
1512        patch_file = run_dir / retained["patch_path"]
1513        if not patch_file.is_file():
1514            self._abandon_salvage_promotion(
1515                task_spec, record, attempts_dir, f"retained patch missing at {retained['patch_path']}"
1516            )
1517            return None
1518        patch_text = patch_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
1519        if hashlib.sha256(patch_text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() != retained.get(
1520            "patch_sha256"
1521        ):
1522            self._abandon_salvage_promotion(
1523                task_spec, record, attempts_dir, "retained patch digest does not match its record"
1524            )
1525            return None
1526
1527        # Never `git apply` blind. Prove it applies, then apply it.
1528        if run_git(
1529            self.target_repo, ["apply", "--check", str(patch_file)], 60
1530        ).returncode != 0:
1531            self._abandon_salvage_promotion(
1532                task_spec, record, attempts_dir, "retained patch no longer applies to the baseline"
1533            )
1534            return None
1535        applied = run_git(self.target_repo, ["apply", str(patch_file)], 60)
1536        if applied.returncode != 0:
1537            restore_repository_to_baseline(self.target_repo, baseline)
1538            self._abandon_salvage_promotion(
1539                task_spec,
1540                record,
1541                attempts_dir,
1542                f"retained patch failed to apply: {(applied.stderr or '').strip()}",
1543            )
1544            return None
1545
1546        self._fault(FAULT_DURING_SALVAGE_PROMOTION, run_dir, task_spec)
1547
1548        promoted_delta = self._capture_scoped_delta(
1549            task_spec, baseline, producer, stage="salvage_promotion"
1550        )
1551        if promoted_delta.is_empty:
1552            restore_repository_to_baseline(self.target_repo, baseline)
1553            self._abandon_salvage_promotion(
1554                task_spec, record, attempts_dir, "restored artifact produced no task-attributable delta"
1555            )
1556            return None
1557
1558        # From here the artifact is an ordinary governed candidate: the same
1559        # capture the existing terminal-timeout path uses, with the same
1560        # provider_completion_claim=false, entering the same review,
1561        # verification and authority stages.
1562        candidate = self._capture_timeout_candidate(
1563            run_dir=run_dir,
1564            attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
1565            attempt_record=record,
1566            task_spec=task_spec,
1567            resource_id=producer,
1568            delta=promoted_delta,
1569        )
1570        retained["promotion_status"] = SALVAGE_PROMOTED
1571        retained["promoted_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
1572        record["transition"] = TRANSITION_CANDIDATE_GOVERNANCE
1573        self._persist_attempt_record(record, attempts_dir)
1574        # The attempt that ended the chain says so on its own record, rather
1575        # than leaving "an earlier fallback was governed instead" recoverable
1576        # only from the ledger.
1577        if attempt_record is not None and attempt_record is not record:
1578            attempt_record["next_selection"] = None
1579            attempt_record["next_selection_reason"] = (
1580                NEXT_SELECTION_SALVAGE_PROMOTED
1581            )
1582            attempt_record["transition"] = TRANSITION_CANDIDATE_GOVERNANCE
1583            self._persist_attempt_record(attempt_record, attempts_dir)
1584        self._record_event(
1585            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1586            agent_id=producer,
1587            action="retained_salvage_promoted",
1588            spec=task_spec,
1589            metadata={
1590                "attempt": retained["attempt"],
1591                "resource_id": producer,
1592                "provider_completion_claim": False,
1593                "insertions": promoted_delta.insertions,
1594                "deletions": promoted_delta.deletions,
1595                "baseline_head": retained["baseline_head"],
1596            },
1597        )
1598        return candidate, producer, promoted_delta
1599
1600    def _build_failover_summary(
1601        self,
1602        implementation_attempts: List[Dict[str, Any]],
1603        termination_reason: str,
1604        last_decision: Any,
1605    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1606        """Explains exhaustion so an operator never has to guess why it stopped."""
1607        remaining: List[str] = []
1608        excluded: Dict[str, str] = {}
1609        if last_decision is not None:
1610            selected = getattr(last_decision, "selected", None)
1611            remaining = [
1612                identity.resource_id
1613                for identity in getattr(last_decision, "eligible_resources", []) or []
1614                if selected is None or identity.resource_id != selected.resource_id
1615            ]
1616            excluded = {
1617                exclusion.resource_id: exclusion.reason
1618                for exclusion in getattr(last_decision, "exclusions", []) or []
1619            }
1620        return {
1621            "attempts_used": len(implementation_attempts),
1622            "attempts_allowed": self.config.max_provider_failover_attempts,
1623            "termination_reason": termination_reason,
1624            "attempted_resources": [
1625                {
1626                    "attempt": attempt.get("attempt"),
1627                    "resource_id": attempt.get("resource_id"),
1628                    "failure_class": attempt.get("failure_class"),
1629                }
1630                for attempt in implementation_attempts
1631            ],
1632            "remaining_eligible": remaining,
1633            "excluded": excluded,
1634            "schema": FAILOVER_SUMMARY_SCHEMA_VERSION,
1635        }
1636
1637    def _is_failover_eligible_failure(self, failure_class: Optional[Any]) -> bool:
1638        """Returns True when the normalized failure class justifies provider failover."""
1639        if failure_class is None:
1640            return False
1641        return failure_class in {
1642            ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
1643            ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT,
1644            ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED,
1645            ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED,
1646            ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
1647            ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE,
1648            ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED,
1649            ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
1650            ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED,
1651            ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_STALLED,
1652        }
1653
1654    def _map_failure_class_to_orchestrator_class(
1655        self,
1656        failure_class: Optional[Any],
1657    ) -> str:
1658        """Maps a provider failure class to the orchestrator's coarse failure class."""
1659        if failure_class is None:
1660            return FAILURE_CLASS_ENGINEERING
1661        value = getattr(failure_class, "value", str(failure_class))
1662        if value in {"QUOTA_EXHAUSTED", "SESSION_LIMIT", "RATE_LIMITED"}:
1663            return FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_EXHAUSTED
1664        if value == "EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED":
1665            return FAILURE_CLASS_EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
1666        if value in {
1667            "AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED",
1668            "PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE",
1669            "TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE",
1670            "MISSING_EXECUTABLE",
1671            "EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED",
1672            "PROVIDER_STALLED",
1673        }:
1674            return FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE
1675        return FAILURE_CLASS_ENGINEERING
1676
1677    def run_deterministic_verification(
1678        self,
1679        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1680        run_dir: Optional[Path] = None,
1681        progress: Optional[Any] = None,
1682        verif_plan: Optional[VerificationPlan] = None,
1683        baseline: Optional[GitBaseline] = None,
1684        delta: Optional[RepositoryDelta] = None,
1685    ) -> str:
1686        """Executes the deterministic verification plan for settled work.
1687
1688        The Stage 6 gate is reachable only by running the whole loop from the
1689        top, which re-invokes providers. A task that escalated to
1690        `awaiting_human` before Stage 6 already has its implementation, its
1691        reviews and its plan on disk; what it never had was the gate. This runs
1692        exactly that gate against the same sanitized view Stage 6 uses, and
1693        persists the same evidence.
1694
1695        Idempotent: a plan whose `overall_status` is already terminal is
1696        returned unchanged rather than re-executed, so a repeated resume cannot
1697        turn a recorded failure into a fresh pass (issues.md #12).
1698
1699        Returns the plan's overall status. Never transitions the task to
1700        `complete` -- that is the caller's policy decision.
1701        """
1702        run_dir = run_dir or (self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id)
1703        if verif_plan is None:
1704            plan_file = run_dir / "verification_plan.json"
1705            if not plan_file.is_file():
1706                raise VerificationPlanMissingError(
1707                    f"Task '{task_spec.task_id}' has no verification_plan.json at "
1708                    f"{plan_file}. Deterministic verification cannot be claimed "
1709                    f"for a plan that does not exist."
1710                )
1711            verif_plan = VerificationPlan.from_dict(safe_load_json(plan_file))
1712            if verif_plan.overall_status in TERMINAL_VERIFICATION_STATUSES:
1713                return verif_plan.overall_status
1714
1715        if baseline is None:
1716            baseline_file = run_dir / "baseline.json"
1717            if baseline_file.is_file():
1718                baseline = GitBaseline.from_dict(safe_load_json(baseline_file))
1719            else:
1720                baseline = capture_baseline(self.target_repo)
1721        if delta is None:
1722            delta = capture_delta(self.target_repo, baseline)
1723
1724        CheckpointManager.start_stage(
1725            run_dir,
1726            task_spec.task_id,
1727            "verifying",
1728            repo_path=self.target_repo,
1729            input_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "diff.patch")],
1730        )
1731        if task_spec.current_state != "verifying":
1732            task_spec.transition_to(
1733                "verifying",
1734                "Human approval authorized the governed workflow to continue; "
1735                "executing the deterministic verification plan that the "
1736                "pre-verification escalation skipped.",
1737            )
1738            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
1739
1740        self._record_event(
1741            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1742            agent_id="control_plane",
1743            action="verification_started",
1744            spec=task_spec,
1745            metadata={
1746                "steps_count": len(verif_plan.steps),
1747                "trigger": "resume_after_pre_verification_escalation",
1748            },
1749        )
1750
1751        verif_status = self._execute_verification_plan(
1752            verif_plan=verif_plan,
1753            task_spec=task_spec,
1754            baseline=baseline,
1755            delta=delta,
1756            run_dir=run_dir,
1757            progress=progress,
1758        )
1759
1760        plan_json = verif_plan.to_json()
1761        (run_dir / "verification_plan.json").write_text(plan_json, encoding="utf-8")
1762        (run_dir / "verification_result.json").write_text(plan_json, encoding="utf-8")
1763
1764        self._record_event(
1765            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1766            agent_id="control_plane",
1767            action="verification_completed",
1768            spec=task_spec,
1769            result=verif_status,
1770            verification_summary={s.name: s.status for s in verif_plan.steps},
1771        )
1772        CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
1773            run_dir,
1774            "verifying",
1775            output_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "verification_result.json")],
1776            result_summary={s.name: s.status for s in verif_plan.steps},
1777        )
1778        return verif_status
1779
1780    def _set_effective_implementer(
1781        self,
1782        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1783        run_dir: Path,
1784        resource_id: Optional[str],
1785    ) -> None:
1786        """Pins the single authoritative effective-implementer identity.
1787
1788        `actual_agent` mirrors it so durable task metadata, the
1789        reviewer-independence records (which read the same resource id) and the
1790        final summary cannot disagree about who produced the governed
1791        candidate. Full attempt history is untouched -- every provider that was
1792        asked still has its own record under implementation/attempts/.
1793
1794        A no-op when implementation produced no resource at all, so a task that
1795        failed before any provider ran does not claim an implementer
1796        (issues.md #16).
1797        """
1798        if not resource_id:
1799            return
1800        task_spec.effective_implementer_resource_id = resource_id
1801        task_spec.actual_agent = resource_id
1802        # The dispatch slot is per-invocation scratch; it must not survive as a
1803        # second, contradictory answer to "who implemented this".
1804        task_spec.dispatch_resource_id = None
1805        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
1806
1807    def _persist_effective_route(
1808        self,
1809        routing: Any,
1810        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1811        attempt_resource_id: str,
1812        route_status: str,
1813        accepted: bool,
1814        candidate_resource: Optional[str] = None,
1815        last_attempted_resource_id: Optional[str] = None,
1816    ) -> None:
1817        """Makes routing evidence on disk match who is actually implementing.
1818
1819        This used to run only after a *successful* failover, so a run that
1820        failed over and then failed left route.json still naming the originally
1821        routed provider, with no effective_route.json at all -- durable evidence
1822        contradicting the run (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05). Routing becomes durable at
1823        every real handoff instead, and distinguishes the resource currently
1824        attempting implementation from one whose work was actually accepted.
1825
1826        initial_route.json is never touched here; it stays the immutable record
1827        of what was routed first.
1828        """
1829        if self.config.provider_pool is None:
1830            return
1831        if "initial_route" not in routing.metadata:
1832            routing.metadata["initial_route"] = {
1833                "selected_agent_id": routing.selected_agent_id,
1834                "selected_agent_name": getattr(
1835                    routing, "selected_agent_name", routing.selected_agent_id
1836                ),
1837                "reviewer_resource_mapping": dict(
1838                    routing.metadata.get("reviewer_resource_mapping", {})
1839                ),
1840                "reviewer_resource_identities": dict(
1841                    routing.metadata.get("reviewer_resource_identities", {})
1842                ),
1843                "review_diversity_achieved": routing.metadata.get(
1844                    "review_diversity_achieved"
1845                ),
1846            }
1847
1848        # Reviewers are recomputed against whoever is implementing now, so no
1849        # mapping can imply a provider reviews its own work. Until a candidate
1850        # is actually accepted the mapping is labelled provisional, because the
1851        # implementer may change again on the next hop.
1852        mapping, diversity = self.config.provider_pool.select_reviewers(
1853            attempt_resource_id,
1854            routing.recommended_reviewers,
1855            task=task_spec,
1856        )
1857        registry = self.config.provider_pool.registry
1858        identities = {
1859            role: registry.get_resource(resource_id).resource_identity().to_dict()
1860            for role, resource_id in mapping.items()
1861            if registry.get_resource(resource_id) is not None
1862        }
1863        routing.metadata["reviewer_resource_mapping"] = mapping
1864        routing.metadata["reviewer_resource_identities"] = identities
1865        routing.metadata["review_diversity_achieved"] = diversity
1866        routing.metadata["reviewer_mapping_status"] = (
1867            "CONFIRMED"
1868            if accepted
1869            else ("CANDIDATE_REVIEW" if candidate_resource else "PROVISIONAL")
1870        )
1871        routing.metadata["route_status"] = route_status
1872        # Promoting a retained fallback credits the resource that produced the
1873        # artifact, but the last resource that actually *ran* is still the one
1874        # the failover chain ended on. Conflating them would rewrite history as
1875        # though the producer had been the final implementation attempt.
1876        routing.metadata["current_attempt_resource"] = (
1877            last_attempted_resource_id or attempt_resource_id
1878        )
1879        routing.metadata["last_attempted_implementation_resource"] = (
1880            last_attempted_resource_id or attempt_resource_id
1881        )
1882        routing.metadata["initial_implementation_resource"] = (
1883            routing.metadata.get("initial_route", {}).get("selected_agent_id")
1884            or routing.selected_agent_id
1885        )
1886        # A candidate is work that exists and is being governed; an accepted
1887        # implementation is work that cleared review, verification and
1888        # authority. Conflating them let SLOPFIX-06's route evidence claim an
1889        # accepted implementer while the task was still under review.
1890        routing.metadata["candidate_resource"] = candidate_resource
1891        routing.metadata["accepted_implementation_resource"] = (
1892            attempt_resource_id if accepted else None
1893        )
1894        routing.metadata["final_implementation_resource"] = (
1895            attempt_resource_id if accepted else None
1896        )
1897        routing.metadata["final_route"] = {
1898            "selected_agent_id": attempt_resource_id,
1899            "accepted": accepted,
1900            "reviewer_resource_mapping": mapping,
1901            "reviewer_resource_identities": identities,
1902            "review_diversity_achieved": diversity,
1903        }
1904        routing.metadata["reassignment_reason"] = (
1905            f"Implementation moved from {routing.selected_agent_id} to "
1906            f"{attempt_resource_id}; reviewers recomputed to keep review "
1907            f"independent of the implementer"
1908        )
1909
1910        # The effective implementer as durable routing evidence, so
1911        # effective_route.json, task.yaml and the summary answer the question
1912        # from one value rather than three (issues.md #16).
1913        routing.metadata["effective_implementer_resource_id"] = attempt_resource_id
1914
1915        run_dir = self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id
1916        if run_dir.exists():
1917            atomic_write_json(run_dir / "route.json", asdict(routing))
1918            effective = asdict(routing)
1919            effective["selected_agent_id"] = attempt_resource_id
1920            # The name has to follow the id. HOWLFRAM-BUG-52's
1921            # effective_route.json read `selected_agent_id: claude_code` beside
1922            # `selected_agent_name: "Antigravity CLI (agy)"` because only the id
1923            # was rewritten here, leaving the originally routed provider's name
1924            # attached to a different resource.
1925            effective_profile = registry.get_resource(attempt_resource_id)
1926            if effective_profile is not None:
1927                effective["selected_agent_name"] = getattr(
1928                    effective_profile, "name", attempt_resource_id
1929                )
1930            else:
1931                effective["selected_agent_name"] = attempt_resource_id
1932            atomic_write_json(run_dir / "effective_route.json", effective)
1933
1934        self._record_event(
1935            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1936            agent_id="control_plane",
1937            action="effective_route_updated",
1938            spec=task_spec,
1939            metadata={
1940                "initial_implementation_resource": routing.selected_agent_id,
1941                "attempt_resource": attempt_resource_id,
1942                "candidate_resource": candidate_resource,
1943                "accepted_implementation_resource": (
1944                    attempt_resource_id if accepted else None
1945                ),
1946                "route_status": route_status,
1947                "reviewer_mapping": mapping,
1948                "diversity_achieved": diversity,
1949            },
1950        )
1951
1952    def _record_event(
1953        self,
1954        task_id: str,
1955        agent_id: str,
1956        action: str,
1957        command: Optional[str] = None,
1958        result: Optional[str] = None,
1959        artifact: Optional[str] = None,
1960        spec: Optional[TaskSpec] = None,
1961        findings_summary: Optional[Dict[str, int]] = None,
1962        verification_summary: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
1963        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
1964    ) -> None:
1965        """Records an immutable event in the append-only evidence ledger."""
1966        if not self.config.record_evidence:
1967            return
1968
1969        meta = metadata or {}
1970        entry = EvidenceEntry(
1971            task_id=task_id,
1972            agent_id=agent_id,
1973            action=action,
1974            command=command,
1975            result=result,
1976            artifact=artifact,
1977            task_class=spec.task_class if spec else None,
1978            risk_level=spec.risk_level if spec else None,
1979            reasoning_tier=spec.recommended_reasoning_tier if spec else None,
1980            actual_agent=agent_id,
1981            repository=self.target_repo.name,
1982            findings_summary=findings_summary,
1983            verification_summary=verification_summary,
1984            metadata=meta,
1985        )
1986        try:
1987            self.ledger.append_entry(entry)
1988        except Exception:
1989            pass
1990

1998        (stage_dir / "diff.patch").write_text(delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")
1999        (run_dir / "diff.patch").write_text(delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")

2015    def prepare_task_plan(
2016        self,
2017        task_spec: TaskSpec,
2018        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
2019    ) -> Tuple[ProjectContext, RoutingDecision, VerificationPlan, Path, Optional[Any]]:
2020        """Prepares task run directory, project discovery, routing, verification plan, and review briefs."""
2021        run_dir = self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id
2022        run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2023        (run_dir / "reviews").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2024        (run_dir / "remediation").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2025
2026        ctx = ProjectAdapter.discover(self.target_repo)
2027        (run_dir / "project_context.json").write_text(ctx.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
2028
2029        router = TaskRouter(resource_pool=self.config.provider_pool)
2030        routing = router.route(task_spec)
2031        atomic_write_json(run_dir / "route.json", asdict(routing))
2032        atomic_write_json(run_dir / "initial_route.json", asdict(routing))
2033
2034        verif_plan = ProjectAdapter.create_verification_plan(ctx, task_id=task_spec.task_id)
2035        (run_dir / "verification_plan.json").write_text(verif_plan.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
2036
2037        task_spec.recommended_agent = routing.selected_agent_id
2038        task_spec.actual_agent = routing.selected_agent_id
2039        task_spec.is_override = routing.is_override
2040        task_spec.override_reason = routing.rationale if routing.is_override else None
2041        if task_spec.current_state == "discovered":
2042            task_spec.transition_to("planned", "Task routed and verification plan generated")
2043        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
2044        skill_ctx = build_skill_context(task_spec)
2045        for role_id in routing.recommended_reviewers:
2046            role = get_reviewer_role(role_id)
2047            if role:
2048                (run_dir / "reviews" / f"{role_id}.md").write_text(
2049                    role.render_brief(task=task_spec, diff_content="", context=skill_ctx), encoding="utf-8"
2050                )
2051        (run_dir / "findings_template.yaml").write_text("# Review Findings Template\nfindings: []\n", encoding="utf-8")
2052
2053        hf_res = None
2054        if self.config.enable_howlframe_audit:
2055            try:
2056                hf_res = HowlFrameAuditRunner.run_audit(
2057                    context=ctx,
2058                    record_evidence=self.config.record_evidence,
2059                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2060                    ledger=self.ledger,
2061                    dogfood_mode="shadow",
2062                )
2063                (run_dir / "howlframe_audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(hf_res.to_dict(), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
2064            except Exception:
2065                pass
2066
2067        # Check pre-execution human authority boundary and bind HowlChangeOps decision if applicable
2068        pre_b = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate_pre_execution(
2069            task=task_spec,
2070            planned_actions=planned_actions,
2071            target_repo=self.target_repo,
