2072        )
2073        self._bind_decision_packet(pre_b, run_dir)
2074        if pre_b.requires_human_approval and pre_b.decision_packet:
2075            (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(pre_b.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
2076
2077        return ctx, routing, verif_plan, run_dir, hf_res
2078
2079    def _bind_decision_packet(self, boundary_res: Any, run_dir: Path) -> None:
2080        """Binds bounded executor decision ID to human decision packet if required."""
2081        if not boundary_res.requires_human_approval or not boundary_res.decision_packet:
2082            return
2083        if not boundary_res.decision_packet.proposed_actions:
2084            return
2085        act_dict = boundary_res.decision_packet.proposed_actions[0]
2086        action_obj = ProposedAction.from_dict(act_dict)
2087        from howlplane.control_plane.executor import ExecutorRegistry
2088        executor = ExecutorRegistry.get_executor_for_action(action_obj.action_type)
2089        if executor and executor.is_available():
2090            verdict, dec_id, _ = executor.evaluate(action_obj, self.target_repo, run_dir)
2091            if dec_id:
2092                boundary_res.decision_packet.changeops_decision_id = dec_id
2093                boundary_res.decision_packet.executor_id = executor.name
2094
2095    def _fault(self, stage: str, run_dir: Path, task_spec: TaskSpec) -> None:
2096        """Fires the configured failure-injection hook for a lifecycle point.
2097
2098        Used to prove the acquisition/cleanup boundary holds: a test raises from
2099        any of these points and asserts no lock file survives.
2100        """
2101        if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
2102            self.config.failure_injection_hook(stage, run_dir, task_spec)
2103
2104    def run(
2105        self,
2106        task_spec: TaskSpec,
2107        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
2108        lock_ownership: Optional[LockOwnership] = None,
2109    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
2110        """
2111        Executes the complete governed control-plane loop for the task under
2112        mutual-exclusion locks and durable checkpoint guarantees.
2113
2114        `lock_ownership` is the task-lock token of an outer lifecycle that
2115        already owns this run -- `ai resume` holds the task lock across the
2116        whole recovery, then hands it here. Without it a resumed run would
2117        deadlock against itself (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06).
2118        """
2119        start_time = time.time()
2120        run_dir = self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id
2121
2122        # Setup Progress Tracker
2123        progress = self.config.progress_tracker
2124        if progress is None:
2125            enabled = (self.config.progress_mode != "never")
2126            stream = (
2127                self.config.progress_stream
2128                if self.config.progress_stream is not None
2129                else sys.stderr
2130            )
2131            progress = TaskProgressTracker(
2132                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2133                run_dir=run_dir,
2134                stream=stream,
2135                heartbeat_interval=self.config.heartbeat_interval,
2136                enabled=enabled,
2137            )
2138
2139        # Every acquisition below is registered for release the moment it
2140        # succeeds. Previously the repo lock was taken before the task lock but
2141        # outside the try/finally, so a task-lock failure stranded
2142        # `.git/howlplane.lock` and no later run could proceed
2143        # (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06). Progress starts only once the locks are held,
2144        # so a resume that cannot acquire never overwrites the durable
2145        # progress record of the run it was trying to recover.
2146        with ExitStack() as stack:
2147            if self.config.acquire_locks:
2148                repo_lock = RepoLock(
2149                    self.target_repo,
2150                    task_spec.task_id,
2151                    command=f"ai work {task_spec.task_id} --execute",
2152                )
2153                repo_lock.acquire()
2154                stack.callback(repo_lock.release)
2155                self._fault("after_repo_lock", run_dir, task_spec)
2156
2157                task_lock = TaskLock(
2158                    self.target_repo, task_spec.task_id, operation="orchestrate"
2159                )
2160                task_lock.acquire(lock_ownership)
2161                stack.callback(task_lock.release)
2162                self._fault("after_task_lock", run_dir, task_spec)
2163
2164            progress.start(
2165                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2166                run_dir=run_dir,
2167                initial_phase=TaskPhase.PREPARING.value,
2168            )
2169            stack.callback(progress.close)
2170            self._fault("after_progress_start", run_dir, task_spec)
2171
2172            try:
2173                result = self._run_governed_loop(
2174                    task_spec, planned_actions, start_time, progress=progress
2175                )
2176                if self.trajectory_store is not None:
2177                    try:
2178                        traj = ExecutionTrajectoryBuilder.from_orchestration_result(result)
2179                        self.trajectory_store.save(traj)
2180                        result.trajectory_id = traj.trajectory_id
2181                    except Exception as exc:
2182                        # Evidence persistence must never fail live engineering work (#B10).
2183                        # Degrade safely (record the conflict, continue) rather than killing the run.
2184                        self._record_event(
2185                            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2186                            agent_id="control_plane",
2187                            action="trajectory_persistence_conflict",
2188                            result=str(exc),
2189                            spec=task_spec,
2190                            metadata={
2191                                "conflict_error": str(exc),
2192                                "trajectory_id": getattr(traj, "trajectory_id", None) if "traj" in locals() else None,
2193                            },
2194                        )
2195                        if getattr(result, "trajectory_id", None) is None and "traj" in locals() and traj is not None:
2196                            result.trajectory_id = traj.trajectory_id
2197                return result
2198            except Exception as exc:
2199                progress.record_terminal(
2200                    TaskProgressState.FAILED,
2201                    TaskPhase.FAILED,
2202                    error_message=str(exc),
2203                )
2204                raise
2205
2206    def _run_governed_loop(
2207        self,
2208        task_spec: TaskSpec,
2209        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
2210        start_time: Optional[float] = None,
2211        progress: Optional[TaskProgressTracker] = None,
2212    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
2213        start_time = start_time or time.time()
2214        if progress is None:
2215            progress = TaskProgressTracker(
2216                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2217                run_dir=None,
2218                enabled=False,
2219            )
2220
2221        progress.transition(
2222            TaskPhase.ROUTING, details="selecting implementation resource"
2223        )
2224        ctx, routing, verif_plan, run_dir, hf_res = self.prepare_task_plan(task_spec, planned_actions)
2225        reviews_dir = run_dir / "reviews"
2226        remediation_base_dir = run_dir / "remediation"
2227        hf_audit_status = hf_res.status if hf_res else None
2228        hf_audit_match = (hf_res.status == "MATCH") if hf_res else True
2229
2230        CheckpointManager.start_stage(
2231            run_dir,
2232            task_spec.task_id,
2233            "planned",
2234            repo_path=self.target_repo,
2235            input_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "route.json"), str(run_dir / "verification_plan.json")],
2236        )
2237
2238        self._record_event(
2239            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2240            agent_id="control_plane",
2241            action="task_created",
2242            spec=task_spec,
2243            metadata={"repo_path": str(self.target_repo), "project_types": ctx.project_types},
2244        )
2245        self._record_event(
2246            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2247            agent_id="control_plane",
2248            action="project_discovered",
2249            spec=task_spec,
2250            metadata={"hygiene_status": ctx.hygiene_status, "has_agents_md": ctx.has_agents_md},
2251        )
2252        self._record_event(
2253            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2254            agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
2255            action="route_selected",
2256            spec=task_spec,
2257            metadata={
2258                "selected_agent": routing.selected_agent_id,
2259                "reviewers": routing.recommended_reviewers,
2260                "is_override": routing.is_override,
2261            },
2262        )
2263        CheckpointManager.complete_stage(run_dir, "planned")
2264
2265        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2266        # Stage 2.5: Pre-Execution Human Authority Gating
2267        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2268        pre_boundary = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate_pre_execution(
2269            task=task_spec,
2270            planned_actions=planned_actions,
2271            target_repo=self.target_repo,
2272        )
2273        self._bind_decision_packet(pre_boundary, run_dir)
2274
2275        if pre_boundary.requires_human_approval:
2276            progress.record_terminal(
2277                TaskProgressState.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
2278                TaskPhase.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
2279            )
2280            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
2281                run_dir,
2282                task_spec.task_id,
2283                "awaiting_human",
2284                repo_path=self.target_repo,
2285                metadata={"boundary_triggers": pre_boundary.triggered_boundaries},
2286            )
2287            task_spec.transition_to(
2288                "awaiting_human",
2289                f"Pre-execution human authority boundary triggered: {pre_boundary.triggered_boundaries}",
2290            )
2291            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
2292
2293            if pre_boundary.decision_packet:
2294                (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(
2295                    pre_boundary.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8"
2296                )
2297
2298            self._record_human_boundary_events(
2299                task_spec, run_dir, boundaries=pre_boundary.triggered_boundaries, reason="Pre-execution boundary triggered"
2300            )
2301
2302            stage_kwargs = dict(
2303                start_time=start_time,
2304                run_dir=run_dir,
2305                routing=routing,
2306                initial_delta=None,
2307                current_delta=None,
2308                review_cycles=[],
2309                reconciliation=None,
2310                verif_plan=verif_plan,
2311                boundary_res=pre_boundary,
2312                hf_status=hf_audit_status,
2313                hf_match=hf_audit_match,
2314                remediation_count=0,
2315            )
2316            return self._make_result(task_spec, "awaiting_human", 2, **stage_kwargs)
2317
2318        if not routing.selected_agent_id:
2319            blocked = routing.metadata.get("blocked_outcome") or {
2320                "status": "BLOCKED",
2321                "reason": FAILURE_CLASS_NO_ELIGIBLE_RESOURCE,
2322            }
2323            progress.record_terminal(
2324                TaskProgressState.FAILED,
2325                TaskPhase.FAILED,
2326                error_message=blocked.get("reason"),
2327            )
2328            task_spec.transition_to("blocked", blocked["reason"])
2329            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
2330            return self._make_result(
2331                task_spec,
2332                "blocked",
2333                3,
2334                start_time=start_time,
2335                run_dir=run_dir,
2336                routing=routing,
2337                verif_plan=verif_plan,
2338                hf_status=hf_audit_status,
2339                hf_match=hf_audit_match,
2340                err_msg=json.dumps(blocked, sort_keys=True),
2341                failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_NO_ELIGIBLE_RESOURCE,
2342            )
2343
2344        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2345        # Stage 3: Baseline Capture / Baseline Recovery
2346        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2347        baseline_file = run_dir / "baseline.json"
2348        if baseline_file.is_file():
2349            try:
2350                baseline = GitBaseline.from_dict(safe_load_json(baseline_file))
2351            except Exception:
2352                baseline = capture_baseline(self.target_repo)
2353                (run_dir / "baseline.json").write_text(baseline.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
2354        else:
2355            baseline = capture_baseline(self.target_repo)
2356            (run_dir / "baseline.json").write_text(baseline.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
2357
2358        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2359        # Stage 4: Implementation (implementing) / Reconcile on Recovery
2360        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2361        has_existing_delta, rec_delta, rec_msg = CrashRecoveryEngine.reconcile_interrupted_implementation(
2362            self.target_repo, run_dir, task_spec
2363        )
2364
2365        impl_dir = run_dir / "implementation"
2366        impl_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2367        attempts_dir = impl_dir / "attempts"
2368        attempts_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2369
2370        # Declared for the whole loop, not just the branch that runs providers:
2371        # a recovered implementation skips the attempt loop entirely, and later
2372        # stages still need to know who (if anyone) is credited with the work.
2373        final_impl_resource_id: Optional[str] = None
2374
2375        # Stays None on the crash-recovery path, where an interrupted
2376        # implementation's delta is reconciled rather than re-run: there is no
2377        # provider execution in *this* process to report (#59.1 Phase 1).
2378        impl_res: Optional[AgentExecutionResult] = None
2379        implementation_attempts: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
2380        # Declared out here because a resumed run can skip the attempt loop
2381        # entirely and still needs to report failover accounting.
2382        last_selection_decision: Optional[Any] = None
2383        # Set only when a budget-stopped attempt left a delta worth governing.
2384        timeout_candidate: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
2385        # Set only when a retained fallback is promoted: the producer becomes
2386        # the candidate, but the failover chain still ended on this resource.
2387        salvage_last_attempted_id: Optional[str] = None
2388
2389        if has_existing_delta and rec_delta:
2390            current_delta = rec_delta
2391            initial_delta = rec_delta
2392            # A resumed run reconciles the delta instead of re-running the
2393            # provider, so who produced it is reconstructed from the durable
2394            # route rather than re-derived. Without this the later stages had
2395            # no implementer to credit and acceptance could never be recorded.
2396            final_impl_resource_id = self._recover_implementation_resource(
2397                run_dir, routing
2398            )
2399            # A parked candidate is the strongest form of recovered work. If
2400            # there is none, the delta in the tree may be a retained fallback
2401            # whose promotion was interrupted -- but only if it actually is
2402            # that artifact, which _recover_promoted_salvage proves before
2403            # crediting its producer.
2404            timeout_candidate = self._load_parked_candidate(run_dir)
2405            if timeout_candidate is None:
2406                timeout_candidate = self._recover_promoted_salvage(
2407                    run_dir, current_delta, task_spec
2408                )
2409                if timeout_candidate is not None:
2410                    final_impl_resource_id = timeout_candidate["resource_id"]
2411                    # The durable route already records which resource the
2412                    # failover chain ended on. Crediting the producer as the
2413                    # candidate must not overwrite that with the producer.
2414                    salvage_last_attempted_id = routing.metadata.get(
2415                        "last_attempted_implementation_resource"
2416                    )
2417            self._record_event(
2418                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2419                agent_id="control_plane",
2420                action="implementation_recovered",
2421                spec=task_spec,
2422                metadata={
2423                    "files_changed": len(current_delta.files_modified) + len(current_delta.files_added),
2424                    "recovered_implementation_resource": final_impl_resource_id,
2425                    "candidate_recovered": timeout_candidate is not None,
2426                },
2427            )
2428            if task_spec.current_state == "planned":
2429                task_spec.transition_to(
2430                    "implementing",
2431                    "Recovered existing implementation delta from interrupted run",
2432                )
2433                task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
2434            impl_chk = CheckpointManager._find_latest_checkpoint_for_stage(run_dir, "implementing")
2435            if impl_chk and impl_chk.status == "in_progress":
2436                CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
2437                    run_dir,
2438                    "implementing",
2439                    result_summary={"recovered": True, "resource_id": final_impl_resource_id},
2440                )
2441        else:
2442            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
2443                run_dir,
2444                task_spec.task_id,
2445                "implementing",
2446                agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
2447                repo_path=self.target_repo,
2448            )
2449
2450            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
2451                self.config.failure_injection_hook("implementing", run_dir, task_spec)
2452
2453            impl_prompt = self._build_implementation_prompt(task_spec, ctx)
2454            current_impl_resource_id = routing.selected_agent_id
2455            attempted_impl_resource_ids: Set[str] = set()
2456
2457            def fail_implementation(
2458                err_msg: str,
2459                failure_class: str,
2460                exit_code: int = 1,
2461                termination_reason: str = TERMINATION_NON_FAILOVER_FAILURE,
2462                rollback: bool = True,
2463            ) -> OrchestrationResult:
2464                """Terminal-fails the run from inside the implementation attempt loop.
2465
2466                Reads the attempt-scoped locals (delta, provider execution, attempt
2467                records) at call time, so every terminal path reports the state as of
2468                the attempt that failed.
2469
2470                Rollback used to sit at the end of the failover branch, where it
2471                only ever ran to prepare a clean tree for a *next* attempt. A
2472                terminal attempt therefore left its edits behind and its record
2473                carried no rollback key at all, contaminating the next run's
2474                starting state (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05). Undoing it here instead
2475                makes every terminal implementation failure restore the
2476                pre-task baseline, and say so. Evidence is already written by
2477                this point, so the patch survives the restore.
2478                """
2479                # Unconditional, exactly like the inter-attempt rollback: a
2480                # task-attributable delta can be empty while the provider has
2481                # still clobbered a file the operator had already modified,
2482                # which capture_delta deliberately excludes. Only the baseline
2483                # restore knows how to put those back.
2484                if current_impl_resource_id != routing.selected_agent_id:
2485                    self._persist_effective_route(
2486                        routing,
2487                        task_spec,
2488                        current_impl_resource_id,
2489                        ROUTE_STATUS_IMPLEMENTATION_FAILED,
2490                        accepted=False,
2491                    )
2492                if rollback:
2493                    restored_ok, restore_err = restore_repository_to_baseline(
2494                        self.target_repo, baseline, current_delta
2495                    )
2496                    self._attach_rollback_result(
2497                        attempt_record, attempts_dir, restored_ok, restore_err
2498                    )
2499                    if not restored_ok:
2500                        err_msg = (
2501                            f"{err_msg} Repository could not be restored to baseline "
2502                            f"({restore_err}); task-attributable changes remain."
2503                        )
2504                return self._fail_task(
2505                    task_spec,
2506                    run_dir,
2507                    err_msg,
2508                    start_time,
2509                    exit_code=exit_code,
2510                    agent_id="control_plane",
2511                    progress_tracker=progress,
2512                    stage="implementing",
2513                    routing=routing,
2514                    initial_delta=current_delta,
2515                    current_delta=current_delta,
2516                    verif_plan=verif_plan,
2517                    hf_status=hf_audit_status,
2518                    hf_match=hf_audit_match,
2519                    provider_execution=impl_res,
2520                    failure_class=failure_class,
2521                    implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts,
2522                    failover_summary=self._build_failover_summary(
2523                        implementation_attempts,
2524                        termination_reason,
2525                        last_selection_decision,
2526                    ),
2527                )
2528
2529            def govern_candidate() -> Dict[str, Any]:
2530                """Preserves the current attempt's delta as a governed candidate.
2531
2532                Reads the attempt-scoped locals at call time, the same way
2533                fail_implementation does, so both terminal exits salvage
2534                identically.
2535                """
2536                captured = self._capture_timeout_candidate(
2537                    run_dir=run_dir,
2538                    attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
2539                    attempt_record=attempt_record,
2540                    task_spec=task_spec,
2541                    resource_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2542                    delta=current_delta,
2543                )
2544                self._record_delta_captured(task_spec, current_delta)
2545                return captured
2546
2547            def promote_retained_fallback() -> Optional[str]:
2548                """Recovers a retained fallback at a terminal exit.
2549
2550                Reads the attempt-scoped locals at call time, exactly like
2551                fail_implementation and govern_candidate, so all three terminal
2552                exits salvage identically instead of repeating the sequence.
2553                Returns the producing resource, or None to fail as before.
2554                """
2555                nonlocal timeout_candidate, current_delta
2556                promoted = self._promote_retained_salvage(
2557                    run_dir=run_dir,
2558                    attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
2559                    task_spec=task_spec,
2560                    baseline=baseline,
2561                    current_delta=current_delta,
2562                    attempt_record=attempt_record,
2563                )
2564                if promoted is None:
2565                    return None
2566                timeout_candidate, producer, current_delta = promoted
2567                self._record_delta_captured(task_spec, current_delta)
2568                return producer
2569
2570            for attempt_num in range(1, self.config.max_provider_failover_attempts + 1):
2571                impl_res = None
2572                normalized_failure = None
2573
2574                impl_backend = self._resolve_backend(current_impl_resource_id)
2575
2576                if not impl_backend.is_available():
2577                    impl_res = AgentExecutionResult(
2578                        agent_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2579                        role="implementation",
2580                        command=f"backend:{current_impl_resource_id}",
2581                        exit_code=127,
2582                        stdout="",
2583                        stderr=f"Agent binary '{current_impl_resource_id}' is not installed or available on PATH.",
2584                        duration_seconds=0.0,
2585                        success=False,
2586                        error_message=f"Agent '{current_impl_resource_id}' unavailable",
2587                    )
2588                else:
2589                    if task_spec.current_state != "implementing":
2590                        task_spec.transition_to(
2591                            "implementing",
2592                            f"Launching implementation attempt {attempt_num}: {current_impl_resource_id}",
2593                        )
2594                        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
2595
2596                    task_spec.actual_agent = current_impl_resource_id
2597                    task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
2598
2599                    self._record_event(
2600                        task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2601                        agent_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2602                        action="implementation_started",
2603                        spec=task_spec,
2604                        metadata={"attempt": attempt_num},
2605                    )
2606
2607                    attempt_scratch = self._provider_scratch_dir(
2608                        run_dir, attempt_num, current_impl_resource_id
2609                    )
2610                    attempt_scratch.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2611                    self._record_scratch_manifest(
2612                        run_dir,
2613                        task_spec.task_id,
2614                        attempt_num,
2615                        current_impl_resource_id,
2616                        attempt_scratch,
2617                        status="active",
2618                    )
2619                    evidence_root_before = {
2620                        entry.name for entry in run_dir.iterdir()
2621                    }
2622                    attempts_before = {
2623                        entry.name for entry in attempts_dir.iterdir()
2624                    } if attempts_dir.is_dir() else set()
2625
2626                    impl_agent_id = getattr(impl_backend, "agent_id", None) or current_impl_resource_id
2627                    # capture_delta already owns the task baseline and control
2628                    # plane exclusions. Reusing it keeps watchdog progress from
2629                    # treating journals, scratch, locks, or .task_runs as work.
2630                    def repository_fingerprint() -> str:
2631                        delta = capture_delta(self.target_repo, baseline)
2632                        return hashlib.sha256(delta.diff_content.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
2633
2634                    observe_provider = ProviderStreamObserver(
2635                        impl_agent_id,
2636                        self.config.provider_stall_timeout_seconds,
2637                        repository_fingerprint,
2638                    )
2639
2640                    with progress.operation(
2641                        phase=TaskPhase.IMPLEMENTING,
2642                        resource_id=impl_agent_id,
2643                        role="implementation",
2644                        details="started",
2645                        suppress_completion=True,
2646                        deadline_seconds=self.config.timeout_seconds,
2647                    ):
2648                        execute_kwargs: Dict[str, Any] = {
2649                            "task": task_spec,
2650                            "cwd": self.target_repo,
2651                            "role": "implementation",
2652                            "prompt_override": impl_prompt,
2653                            "timeout_seconds": self.config.timeout_seconds,
2654                        }
2655                        # Third-party/test adapters predate streamed execution.
2656                        # Preserve their bounded legacy contract; built-in CLI
2657                        # adapters opt into observation via **kwargs.
2658                        parameters = inspect.signature(impl_backend.execute).parameters
2659                        supports_kwargs = any(
2660                            parameter.kind == inspect.Parameter.VAR_KEYWORD
2661                            for parameter in parameters.values()
2662                        )
2663                        if supports_kwargs or "watchdog_callback" in parameters:
2664                            execute_kwargs.update({
2665                                "watchdog_callback": observe_provider,
2666                                "watchdog_interval_seconds": self.config.provider_watchdog_interval_seconds,
2667                            })
2668                        impl_res = impl_backend.execute(
2669                            **execute_kwargs,
2670                        )
2671
2672                # Relocate provider scratch before any evidence for this
2673                # attempt is written, so control-plane artifacts can never be
2674                # mistaken for files the provider left behind.
2675                if impl_backend.is_available():
2676                    swept = self._sweep_provider_scratch(
2677                        run_dir=run_dir,
2678                        resource_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2679                        attempt_num=attempt_num,
2680                        known_before=evidence_root_before,
2681                        attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
2682                        attempts_before=attempts_before,
2683                        owned_attempt_name=(
2684                            f"{attempt_num:02d}-{current_impl_resource_id}"
2685                        ),
2686                    )
2687                    if swept:
2688                        self._record_event(
2689                            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2690                            agent_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2691                            action="provider_scratch_relocated",
2692                            spec=task_spec,
2693                            metadata={"attempt": attempt_num, "files": swept},
2694                        )
2695
2696                # Snapshot capacity before record_result mutates it, so the
2697                # recorded "before" is genuinely the pre-attempt state.
2698                capacity_before: Dict[str, str] = (
2699                    self.config.provider_pool.get_all_statuses()
2700                    if self.config.provider_pool is not None else {}
2701                )
2702
2703                if self.config.provider_pool is not None and impl_res is not None:
2704                    normalized_failure = self.config.provider_pool.record_result(
2705                        current_impl_resource_id,
2706                        impl_res,
2707                        task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2708                    )
2709
2710                current_delta = self._capture_scoped_delta(
2711                    task_spec, baseline, current_impl_resource_id, stage="implementation"
2712                )
2713
2714                denial_outcome = (
2715                    (impl_res.metadata or {}).get(TOOL_PERMISSION_KEY)
2716                    if impl_res is not None else None
2717                )
2718                if (
2719                    impl_res is not None
2720                    and impl_res.success
2721                    and denial_outcome == TOOL_PERMISSION_DENIED
2722                    and current_delta.is_empty
2723                ):
2724                    impl_res.success = False
2725                    if not impl_res.error_message:
2726                        impl_res.error_message = (
2727                            "Required tool permissions were unavailable and zero delta produced"
2728                        )
2729                    if self.config.provider_pool is not None:
2730                        normalized_failure = ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED
2731
2732                attempt_record = self._record_implementation_attempt(
2733                    run_dir=run_dir,
2734                    attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
2735                    attempt_num=attempt_num,
2736                    resource_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2737                    impl_res=impl_res,
2738                    delta=current_delta,
2739                    failure_class=normalized_failure.value if normalized_failure else None,
2740                    capacity_before=capacity_before,
2741                )
2742                implementation_attempts.append(attempt_record)
2743
2744                if impl_res is not None and impl_res.success:
2745                    final_impl_resource_id = current_impl_resource_id
2746                    (impl_dir / "result.json").write_text(impl_res.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
2747                    self._write_delta_patch(current_delta, impl_dir, run_dir)
2748                    self._record_event(
2749                        task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2750                        agent_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2751                        action="implementation_completed",
2752                        result="success",
2753                        spec=task_spec,
2754                        metadata={
2755                            "files_changed": len(current_delta.files_modified) + len(current_delta.files_added),
2756                            "attempt": attempt_num,
2757                        },
2758                    )
2759                    self._record_delta_captured(task_spec, current_delta)
2760                    self._supersede_retained_salvage(attempts_dir, task_spec)
2761                    break
2762
2763                # Failed attempt: determine whether to failover or terminal-fail.
2764                err_msg = (
2765                    impl_res.stderr.strip()
2766                    if impl_res and impl_res.stderr and impl_res.stderr.strip()
2767                    else (impl_res.error_message if impl_res else f"Implementation failed on {current_impl_resource_id}")
2768                )
2769                failure_class_value = normalized_failure.value if normalized_failure else None
2770                if normalized_failure in {
2771                    ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT,
2772                    ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
2773                    ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED,
2774                    ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED,
2775                    ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
2776                    ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_STALLED,
2777                }:
2778                    detail = failure_class_value.lower() if failure_class_value else "provider failure"
2779                    progress.emit_provider_unusable(
2780                        current_impl_resource_id,
2781                        detail,
2782                        impl_res.duration_seconds if impl_res else 0.0,
2783                        diagnostics=(impl_res.metadata or {}).get("watchdog_diagnostics") if impl_res else None,
2784                    )
2785
2786                progress.emit_implementation_failed(
2787                    current_impl_resource_id,
2788                    reason=failure_class_value or err_msg,
2789                )
2790
2791                # This resource is spent for this task from here on, whatever
2792                # happens next. Recording it before selection is what stops a
2793                # resource whose cooldown elapsed mid-attempt from being offered
2794                # back and dead-ending the loop (SLOPFIX-03).
2795                attempted_impl_resource_ids.add(current_impl_resource_id)
2796
2797                if not self._is_failover_eligible_failure(normalized_failure):
2798                    # EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED is failover-eligible, so this
2799                    # attempt is never itself salvageable -- but an earlier one
2800                    # may be, and a provider erroring outright is still a
2801                    # termination without a successful implementation.
2802                    fallback_producer = promote_retained_fallback()
2803                    if fallback_producer is not None:
2804                        salvage_last_attempted_id = current_impl_resource_id
2805                        final_impl_resource_id = fallback_producer
2806                        break
2807                    return fail_implementation(
2808                        err_msg,
2809                        self._map_failure_class_to_orchestrator_class(normalized_failure),
2810                        exit_code=impl_res.exit_code if impl_res and impl_res.exit_code != 0 else 1,
2811                        termination_reason=TERMINATION_NON_FAILOVER_FAILURE,
2812                    )
2813
2814                # While failover budget remains, a fresh provider may yet
2815                # produce a complete, provider-attested result, and that is
2816                # strictly better than governing a fragment -- so the current
2817                # attempt's work is still rolled back before the next one runs.
2818                # It is not discarded, though: SLOPFIX-07R rolled back Codex's
2819                # eligible artifact and then forgot it existed, because salvage
2820                # was only ever evaluated for whichever attempt happened to be
2821                # last. Retention keeps it recoverable without ever letting it
2822                # contaminate a later attempt.
2823                salvageable = self._is_salvageable_timeout_candidate(
2824                    normalized_failure, current_delta
2825                )
2826                exhausted = attempt_num >= self.config.max_provider_failover_attempts
2827
2828                if exhausted and salvageable:
2829                    timeout_candidate = govern_candidate()
2830                    # State a terminal attempt reaches by exhausting the budget
2831                    # is still state: record it rather than letting the absence
2832                    # of `rollback`/`next_selection` imply it (SLOPFIX-06's
2833                    # attempt 3 was silent about all of it).
2834                    self._attach_terminal_disposition(
2835                        attempt_record,
2836                        attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
2837                        attempt_num=attempt_num,
2838                        attempted=attempted_impl_resource_ids,
2839                        task_spec=task_spec,
2840                    )
2841                    final_impl_resource_id = current_impl_resource_id
2842                    break
2843
2844                if exhausted:
2845                    # This is the SLOPFIX-07R path: the last attempt produced
2846                    # nothing, but an earlier productive timeout may have.
2847                    fallback_producer = promote_retained_fallback()
2848                    if fallback_producer is not None:
2849                        salvage_last_attempted_id = current_impl_resource_id
2850                        final_impl_resource_id = fallback_producer
2851                        break
2852                    err_msg = (
2853                        f"Implementation failed on {current_impl_resource_id} ({failure_class_value}); "
2854                        f"max failover attempts ({self.config.max_provider_failover_attempts}) reached."
2855                    )
2856                    return fail_implementation(
2857                        err_msg,
2858                        FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_EXHAUSTED,
2859                        termination_reason=TERMINATION_MAX_ATTEMPTS_REACHED,
2860                    )
2861
2862                # Select next eligible implementation resource. Everything already
2863                # attempted is a hard exclusion, not merely a demotion.
2864                next_resource_id = None
2865                if self.config.provider_pool is not None:
2866                    next_decision = self.config.provider_pool.select_resource(
2867                        task_spec,
2868                        role="implementation",
2869                        avoid_resource_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2870                        exclude_resource_ids=attempted_impl_resource_ids,
2871                    )
2872                    last_selection_decision = next_decision
2873                    self._attach_next_selection(attempt_record, attempts_dir, next_decision)
2874                    if next_decision.selected:
2875                        next_resource_id = next_decision.selected.resource_id
2876
2877                if (
2878                    not next_resource_id
2879                    or next_resource_id == current_impl_resource_id
2880                    or next_resource_id in attempted_impl_resource_ids
2881                ):
2882                    if salvageable:
2883                        timeout_candidate = govern_candidate()
2884                        final_impl_resource_id = current_impl_resource_id
2885                        break
2886
2887                    fallback_producer = promote_retained_fallback()
2888                    if fallback_producer is not None:
2889                        salvage_last_attempted_id = current_impl_resource_id
2890                        final_impl_resource_id = fallback_producer
2891                        break
2892
2893                    err_msg = f"Implementation failed on {current_impl_resource_id} ({failure_class_value}) and no eligible failover resource remains."
2894                    return fail_implementation(
2895                        err_msg,
2896                        FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_EXHAUSTED,
2897                        termination_reason=TERMINATION_NO_ELIGIBLE_RESOURCE,
2898                    )
2899
2900                # Preserve before destroying. Retention is recorded first so
2901                # an interruption between here and the rollback can only ever
2902                # leave a fallback that is known about, never one that was
2903                # silently dropped.
2904                if salvageable:
2905                    self._retain_salvage_artifact(
2906                        attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
2907                        attempt_record=attempt_record,
2908                        task_spec=task_spec,
2909                        resource_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2910                        delta=current_delta,
2911                        baseline=baseline,
2912                    )
2913
2914                # Restore repository to baseline before the next attempt.
2915                restored_ok, restore_err = restore_repository_to_baseline(
2916                    self.target_repo, baseline, current_delta
2917                )
2918                self._attach_rollback_result(
2919                    attempt_record, attempts_dir, restored_ok, restore_err
2920                )
2921                if not restored_ok:
2922                    err_msg = f"Implementation failover aborted: cannot safely restore baseline ({restore_err})."
2923                    return fail_implementation(
2924                        err_msg,
2925                        FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
2926                        termination_reason=TERMINATION_ROLLBACK_FAILED,
2927                        rollback=False,
2928                    )
2929
2930                # "Salvage preserved" and "rollback restored" are both true
2931                # here, and the evidence says both. The patch lives in the
2932                # attempt's evidence; the working tree is clean for the next
2933                # attempt. Replayability is proven against that clean tree,
2934                # because that is what a promotion would replay onto.
2935                if salvageable:
2936                    self._confirm_salvage_replayable(
2937                        run_dir, attempts_dir, attempt_record, task_spec
2938                    )
2939                    self._fault(FAULT_AFTER_SALVAGE_RETENTION, run_dir, task_spec)
2940
2941                progress.emit_failover(
2942                    current_impl_resource_id,
2943                    next_resource_id,
2944                    failure_class=failure_class_value,
2945                )
2946                self._record_event(
2947                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2948                    agent_id="control_plane",
2949                    action="implementation_failover",
2950                    spec=task_spec,
2951                    metadata={
2952                        "attempt": attempt_num,
2953                        "source_resource": current_impl_resource_id,
2954                        "target_resource": next_resource_id,
2955                        "failure_class": failure_class_value,
2956                    },
2957                )
2958
2959                current_impl_resource_id = next_resource_id
2960                self._persist_effective_route(
2961                    routing,
2962                    task_spec,
2963                    current_impl_resource_id,
2964                    ROUTE_STATUS_SUPERSEDED,
2965                    accepted=False,
2966                )
2967
2968            if timeout_candidate is None and (impl_res is None or not impl_res.success):
2969                err_msg = (
2970                    f"Implementation exhausted all {self.config.max_provider_failover_attempts} "
2971                    "attempted provider(s) without success."
2972                )
2973                return self._fail_task(
2974                    task_spec,
2975                    run_dir,
2976                    err_msg,
2977                    start_time,
2978                    exit_code=1,
2979                    agent_id="control_plane",
2980                    progress_tracker=progress,
2981                    stage="implementing",
2982                    routing=routing,
2983                    current_delta=current_delta if "current_delta" in locals() else None,
2984                    verif_plan=verif_plan,
2985                    hf_status=hf_audit_status,
2986                    hf_match=hf_audit_match,
2987                    provider_execution=impl_res,
2988                    failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_EXHAUSTED,
2989                    implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts,
2990                    failover_summary=self._build_failover_summary(
2991                        implementation_attempts,
2992                        TERMINATION_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED,
2993                        last_selection_decision,
2994                    ),
2995                )
2996
2997            initial_delta = current_delta
2998            CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
2999                run_dir,
3000                "implementing",
3001                output_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "diff.patch")],
3002            )
3003
3004        # Implementation has settled -- by success, by promotion of a retained
3005        # candidate, or by recovery on resume. This is the one place the
3006        # effective implementer becomes durable, and it runs before the
3007        # authority gate, so a task that escalates before Stage 6 still records
3008        # who produced the candidate. HOWLFRAM-BUG-52 escalated here and left
3009        # `final_implementation_resource: null` with task.yaml naming a
3010        # reviewer (issues.md #16).
3011        self._set_effective_implementer(task_spec, run_dir, final_impl_resource_id)
3012
3013        # Whether the work came from this run's attempt loop or was recovered on
3014        # resume, reviewer independence is settled here. If the final
3015        # implementation resource differs from the initially
3016        # routed one, recompute reviewer assignments so independence claims
3017        # are truthful (#59.2 Phase 9).
3018        if (
3019            final_impl_resource_id is not None
3020            and self.config.provider_pool is not None
3021            and (
3022                final_impl_resource_id != routing.selected_agent_id
3023                # A promoted producer can coincide with the originally
3024                # routed resource, and reviewers must still be recomputed
3025                # against it before it can be reviewed.
3026                or salvage_last_attempted_id is not None
3027            )
3028        ):
3029            # Implementation being finished is not the same as the work
3030            # being accepted: review, reconciliation, verification and the
3031            # authority gate all still lie ahead. The route records who
3032            # produced the candidate and stays provisional until Stage 8
3033            # (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06).
3034            self._persist_effective_route(
3035                routing,
3036                task_spec,
3037                final_impl_resource_id,
3038                ROUTE_STATUS_SUPERSEDED,
3039                accepted=False,
3040                candidate_resource=final_impl_resource_id,
3041                last_attempted_resource_id=salvage_last_attempted_id,
3042            )
3043
3044        # A salvaged candidate carries no completion claim from its
3045        # producer, so independent review is the only thing standing behind
3046        # it. When no independent reviewer is available the pool falls back
3047        # to the implementer reviewing its own work, which for this kind of
3048        # candidate is no review at all. Park it for a human rather than
3049        # completing on a self-review (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05).
3050        if timeout_candidate is not None and not routing.metadata.get(
3051            "review_diversity_achieved", True
3052        ):
3053            err_msg = (
3054                "Timed-out implementation candidate cannot be independently "
3055                f"reviewed: no reviewer is available other than "
3056                f"{final_impl_resource_id}, which produced it."
3057            )
3058            decision_pkt = HumanDecisionPacket(
3059                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3060                objective=task_spec.objective,
3061                change_summary=(
3062                    f"Candidate ({current_delta.insertions} ins, "
3063                    f"{current_delta.deletions} del) was left by "
3064                    f"{final_impl_resource_id} after this control plane "
3065                    "stopped it at its execution budget. The provider never "
3066                    "reported completion."
3067                ),
3068                boundary_triggers=["reviewer_independence_unavailable"],
3069                evidence=[
3070                    f"origin={CANDIDATE_ORIGIN_TIMED_OUT}",
3071                    "provider_completion_claim=false",
3072                ],
3073                risks=[
3074                    "No independent reviewer is available, so the candidate "
3075                    "has nothing standing behind it.",
3076                ],
3077                review_findings_summary={
3078                    "blocker": 0, "high": 0, "medium": 0, "low": 0,
3079                },
3080                verification_status="unverified",
3081                recommended_action=(
3082                    "Inspect implementation/attempts/*/candidate.patch and "
3083                    "either authorize it explicitly or discard it."
3084                ),
3085            )
3086            self._park_awaiting_human(
3087                task_spec, run_dir, err_msg, decision_pkt, progress
3088            )
3089            return self._make_result(
3090                task_spec=task_spec,
3091                final_state="awaiting_human",
3092                exit_code=2,
3093                start_time=start_time,
3094                run_dir=run_dir,
3095                routing=routing,
3096                initial_delta=initial_delta,
3097                current_delta=current_delta,
3098                verif_plan=verif_plan,
3099                hf_status=hf_audit_status,
3100                hf_match=hf_audit_match,
3101                provider_execution=impl_res,
3102                implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts,
3103                timeout_candidate=timeout_candidate,
3104            )
3105
3106            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
3107                self.config.failure_injection_hook("post_implementation", run_dir, task_spec)
3108
3109        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3110        # Stage 5: Independent Adversarial Reviews & Remediation Loop
3111        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3112        if task_spec.current_state != "reviewing":
3113            task_spec.transition_to("reviewing", "Initiating independent reviewer analysis on actual implementation diff")
3114            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
3115
3116        review_cycles: List[ReviewCycleResult] = []
3117        latest_reconciliation: Optional[ReconciliationResult] = None
3118        remediation_count = 0
3119        current_reviewers = list(routing.recommended_reviewers)
3120
3121        def _make_parked_review_exit(park_msg: str) -> OrchestrationResult:
3122            return self._make_result(
3123                task_spec=task_spec,
3124                final_state="awaiting_human",
3125                exit_code=2,
3126                start_time=start_time,
3127                run_dir=run_dir,
3128                routing=routing,
3129                initial_delta=initial_delta,
3130                current_delta=current_delta,
3131                review_cycles=review_cycles,
3132                reconciliation=latest_reconciliation,
3133                verif_plan=verif_plan,
3134                remediation_count=remediation_count,
3135                err_msg=park_msg,
3136                provider_execution=impl_res,
3137                failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED,
3138                hf_status=hf_audit_status,
3139                hf_match=hf_audit_match,
3140                implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts,
3141                failover_summary=self._build_failover_summary(
3142                    implementation_attempts,
3143                    TERMINATION_IMPLEMENTATION_SUCCEEDED,
3144                    last_selection_decision,
3145                ),
3146            )
3147
3148        while True:
3149            cycle_idx = len(review_cycles) + 1
3150            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
3151                run_dir,
3152                task_spec.task_id,
3153                "reviewing",
3154                repo_path=self.target_repo,
3155                metadata={"cycle": cycle_idx, "reviewers": current_reviewers},
3156            )
3157
3158            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
3159                self.config.failure_injection_hook("reviewing", run_dir, task_spec)
3160
3161            self._record_event(
3162                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3163                agent_id="control_plane",
3164                action="review_started",
3165                spec=task_spec,
3166                metadata={"cycle": cycle_idx, "reviewers": current_reviewers},
3167            )
3168
3169            cycle_res = ReviewRunner.execute_review_cycle(
3170                task=task_spec,
3171                diff_content=current_delta.diff_content,
3172                reviewer_roles=current_reviewers,
3173                cwd=self.target_repo,
3174                backend=self.config.custom_backend,
3175                cycle_index=cycle_idx,
3176                reviewer_agent_mapping=(
3177                    self.config.reviewer_agent_mapping
3178                    or routing.metadata.get("reviewer_resource_mapping")
3179                ),
3180                custom_reviewer_fn=self.config.custom_reviewer_fn,
3181                run_dir=run_dir,
3182                provider_pool=self.config.provider_pool,
3183                progress_tracker=progress,
3184                implementer_resource_id=final_impl_resource_id,
3185            )
3186            review_cycles.append(cycle_res)
3187            latest_reconciliation = cycle_res.reconciliation
3188
3189            # Save review cycle artifacts
3190            cycle_dir = reviews_dir if cycle_idx == 1 else (remediation_base_dir / f"cycle-{remediation_count:02d}" / "re_review")
3191            cycle_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
3192            for role_id, single_rev in cycle_res.reviewer_results.items():
3193                (cycle_dir / f"{role_id}.md").write_text(single_rev.raw_output, encoding="utf-8")
3194                (cycle_dir / f"{role_id}_findings.yaml").write_text(
3195                    yaml.dump([f.to_dict() for f in single_rev.findings], sort_keys=False),
3196                    encoding="utf-8",
3197                )
3198
3199            # Persist findings and reconciliation
3200            findings_data = {"findings": [f.to_dict() for f in cycle_res.all_findings]}
3201            (run_dir / "findings.yaml").write_text(yaml.dump(findings_data, sort_keys=False), encoding="utf-8")
3202            # Written unconditionally. A cycle with no findings leaves
3203            # cycle_res.reconciliation as None, and skipping the write used to
3204            # leave the *previous* cycle's report on disk -- so the decision
3205            # packet pointed operators at a finding that had already been
3206            # remediated (HOWLFRAM-BUG-50). An empty cycle now says it is empty.
3207            if cycle_res.reconciliation:
3208                (run_dir / "reconciliation.json").write_text(json.dumps(cycle_res.reconciliation.to_dict(), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
3209                (run_dir / "reconciliation_report.md").write_text(cycle_res.reconciliation.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
3210            else:
3211                (run_dir / "reconciliation.json").write_text(
3212                    json.dumps(
3213                        {
3214                            "summary": {"total_findings": 0, "unresolved_blockers": 0, "unresolved_highs": 0},
3215                            "findings": [],
3216                            "cycle_index": cycle_res.cycle_index,
3217                            "status": cycle_res.status,
3218                        },
3219                        indent=2,
3220                    ),
3221                    encoding="utf-8",
3222                )
3223                (run_dir / "reconciliation_report.md").write_text(
3224                    "# Review Reconciliation Report\n\n"
3225                    f"Cycle {cycle_res.cycle_index} produced no reviewer findings to reconcile "
3226                    f"(cycle status: `{cycle_res.status}`).\n",
3227                    encoding="utf-8",
3228                )
3229
3230            findings_summary = {
3231                "total": len(cycle_res.all_findings),
3232                "blocker": cycle_res.reconciliation.unresolved_blockers if cycle_res.reconciliation else 0,
3233                "high": cycle_res.reconciliation.unresolved_highs if cycle_res.reconciliation else 0,
3234            }
3235            self._record_event(
3236                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3237                agent_id="control_plane",
3238                action="review_completed",
3239                spec=task_spec,
3240                findings_summary=findings_summary,
3241                metadata={"status": cycle_res.status, "cycle": cycle_idx},
3242            )
3243            CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
3244                run_dir,
3245                "reviewing",
3246                output_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "reconciliation.json")],
3247                result_summary=findings_summary,
3248            )
3249
3250            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
3251                self.config.failure_injection_hook("post_review", run_dir, task_spec)
3252
3253            # Check if independent review was satisfied
3254            if (
3255                self.config.preserve_independent_review
3256                and not self.config.custom_reviewer_fn
3257                and not getattr(cycle_res, "independent_review_satisfied", True)
3258            ):
3259                triggers: List[str] = ["independent_review_unavailable"]
3260                if cycle_res.non_independent_roles:
3261                    triggers.append("non_independent_review")
3262                risks: List[str] = ["No independent provider family was available to complete code review."]
3263                evidence: List[str] = [
3264                    f"{role}: reviewed by non-independent provider family ({getattr(cycle_res, 'reviewing_provider_families', {}).get(role, 'unknown')})"
3265                    for role in cycle_res.non_independent_roles
3266                ] or ["Independent review could not be satisfied by any configured provider."]
3267                err_msg = "Independent review unavailable: no independent provider family completed review"
3268                decision_pkt = HumanDecisionPacket(
3269                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3270                    objective=task_spec.objective,
3271                    change_summary=(
3272                        f"Implementation diff ({current_delta.insertions} ins, {current_delta.deletions} del) "
3273                        f"lacks independent review; triggers: {', '.join(triggers)}."
3274                    ),
3275                    boundary_triggers=triggers,
3276                    evidence=evidence,
3277                    risks=risks,
3278                    review_findings_summary=findings_summary,
3279                    verification_status="unverified",
3280                    recommended_action="Authorize manual review or configure an independent provider family.",
3281                )
3282                self._park_awaiting_human(
3283                    task_spec,
3284                    run_dir,
3285                    err_msg,
3286                    decision_pkt,
3287                    progress,
3288                )
3289                return _make_parked_review_exit(err_msg)
3290
3291            # Check if any findings require remediation
3292            if not cycle_res.requires_remediation:
3293                break
3294
3295            # If remediation required, check cycle bounds
3296            if remediation_count >= self.config.max_remediation_cycles:
3297                err_msg = (
3298                    f"Remediation limit reached ({self.config.max_remediation_cycles} cycles) with "
3299                    f"{findings_summary['blocker']} blockers and {findings_summary['high']} high findings remaining."
3300                )
3301                # Name the cause that actually stopped the loop. Reporting every
3302                # escalation as "unresolved findings" told operators a change had
3303                # defects when the real problem was that a reviewer never ran, or
3304                # that the implementer reviewed its own diff -- three different
3305                # situations calling for three different human judgments
3306                # (HOWLFRAM-BUG-50).
3307                triggers: List[str] = []
3308                risks: List[str] = []
3309                evidence = [f.title for f in cycle_res.all_findings if f.severity in ("blocker", "high")]
3310                if findings_summary["high"] > 0 or findings_summary["blocker"] > 0:
3311                    triggers.append("security_policy_exception")
3312                    risks.append("Unresolved reviewer findings may indicate defects or security vulnerabilities.")
3313                if cycle_res.non_independent_roles:
3314                    triggers.append("non_independent_review")
3315                    risks.append(
3316                        "The implementer reviewed its own change for "
3317                        f"{', '.join(cycle_res.non_independent_roles)}; those roles are not independent review."
3318                    )
3319                    evidence.extend(
3320                        f"{role}: reviewed by the implementer ({final_impl_resource_id or 'unknown'})"
3321                        for role in cycle_res.non_independent_roles
3322                    )
3323                if cycle_res.status == "review_failure":
3324                    triggers.append("review_incomplete")
3325                    risks.append("At least one reviewer never completed, so this change is under-reviewed.")
3326                    evidence.extend(
3327                        f"{role}: {res.status}"
3328                        for role, res in sorted(cycle_res.reviewer_results.items())
3329                        if res.status == "reviewer_failure"
3330                    )
3331                if not triggers:
3332                    triggers.append("unresolved_findings")
3333                    risks.append("Unresolved reviewer findings may indicate defects or security vulnerabilities.")
3334
3335                decision_pkt = HumanDecisionPacket(
3336                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3337                    objective=task_spec.objective,
3338                    change_summary=(
3339                        f"Implementation diff ({current_delta.insertions} ins, {current_delta.deletions} del) "
3340                        f"reached the remediation limit; triggers: {', '.join(triggers)}."
3341                    ),
3342                    boundary_triggers=triggers,
3343                    evidence=evidence,
3344                    risks=risks,
3345                    review_findings_summary=findings_summary,
3346                    verification_status="unverified",
3347                    recommended_action="Review finding report in reconciliation_report.md and authorize override or manual remediation.",
3348                )
3349                self._park_awaiting_human(
3350                    task_spec,
3351                    run_dir,
3352                    f"Max remediation cycles exceeded: {err_msg}",
3353                    decision_pkt,
3354                    progress,
3355                )
3356                return _make_parked_review_exit(err_msg)
3357
3358            remediation_count += 1
3359            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
3360                run_dir,
3361                task_spec.task_id,
3362                "remediating",
3363                repo_path=self.target_repo,
3364                metadata={"cycle": remediation_count},
3365            )
3366
3367            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
3368                self.config.failure_injection_hook("remediating", run_dir, task_spec)
3369
3370            task_spec.transition_to(
3371                "remediating",
3372                f"Remediation cycle {remediation_count}: resolving {len(cycle_res.all_findings)} review findings",
3373            )
3374            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
3375
3376            self._record_event(
3377                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3378                agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
3379                action="remediation_started",
3380                spec=task_spec,
3381                metadata={"cycle": remediation_count, "findings_count": len(cycle_res.all_findings)},
3382            )
3383
3384            rem_cycle_dir = remediation_base_dir / f"cycle-{remediation_count:02d}"
3385            rem_cycle_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
3386
3387            rem_resource_id = (
3388                final_impl_resource_id or routing.selected_agent_id
3389            )
3390            rem_backend = self._resolve_backend(rem_resource_id)
3391            rem_agent_id = getattr(rem_backend, "agent_id", None) or rem_resource_id
3392            rem_res = None
3393            rem_failure = None
3394            remediation_timeout = None
3395            if not self.config.custom_remediation_fn:
3396                rem_prompt = self._build_remediation_prompt(task_spec, current_delta.diff_content, cycle_res.all_findings)
3397                affected_files = set(current_delta.files_modified + current_delta.files_added)
3398                remediation_timeout = compute_remediation_timeout(
3399                    self.config, cycle_res.all_findings, affected_files
3400                )
3401            with progress.operation(
3402                phase=TaskPhase.REMEDIATING,
3403                resource_id=rem_agent_id,
3404                role="remediation",
3405                cycle=remediation_count,
3406                details=f"cycle {remediation_count}",
3407                deadline_seconds=remediation_timeout,
3408            ):
3409                if self.config.custom_remediation_fn:
3410                    self.config.custom_remediation_fn(task_spec, self.target_repo, cycle_res.all_findings)
3411                else:
3412                    self._record_event(
3413                        task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3414                        agent_id=rem_agent_id,
3415                        action="remediation_timeout_derived",
3416                        spec=task_spec,
3417                        metadata={
3418                            "cycle": remediation_count,
3419                            "timeout_seconds": remediation_timeout,
3420                            "findings_count": len(cycle_res.all_findings),
3421                            "affected_files_count": len(affected_files),
3422                            "run_mode": self.config.run_mode,
3423                            "remediation_timeout_ceiling": (
3424                                self.config.bounded_remediation_timeout_ceiling_seconds
3425                                if self.config.run_mode == "bounded"
3426                                else None
3427                            ),
3428                        },
3429                    )
3430                    rem_res = rem_backend.execute(
3431                        task=task_spec,
3432                        cwd=self.target_repo,
3433                        role="remediation",
3434                        prompt_override=rem_prompt,
3435                        timeout_seconds=remediation_timeout,
3436                    )
3437                    (rem_cycle_dir / "result.json").write_text(rem_res.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
3438                    if self.config.provider_pool is not None:
3439                        rem_failure = self.config.provider_pool.record_result(
3440                            rem_resource_id, rem_res, task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3441                        )
3442                    else:
3443                        from howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool import ProviderPoolManager
3444
3445                        rem_failure = ProviderPoolManager.classify_result(rem_resource_id, rem_res)
3446
3447            current_delta = self._capture_scoped_delta(
3448                task_spec, baseline, routing.selected_agent_id, stage="remediation"
3449            )
3450            self._write_delta_patch(current_delta, rem_cycle_dir, run_dir)
3451
3452            if rem_res is not None and not rem_res.success:
3453                # Evidence must survive, but incomplete remediation must not be
3454                # recorded as completed or leak into a later task's baseline.
3455                # Restore the whole task, including earlier remediation cycles;
3456                # the cumulative patch above preserves all of that work.
3457                restored, restore_error = restore_repository_to_baseline(
3458                    self.target_repo, baseline, current_delta,
3459                )
3460                failure_class = self._map_failure_class_to_orchestrator_class(rem_failure)
3461                error = rem_res.error_message or rem_res.stderr or "Remediation worker failed"
3462                if not restored:
3463                    error += f"; baseline restore failed: {restore_error}"
3464                disposition = {
3465                    "resource_id": rem_resource_id,
3466                    "failure_class": failure_class,
3467                    "provider_failure_class": getattr(rem_failure, "value", None),
3468                    "rollback": {"restored": restored, "error": restore_error},
3469                }
3470                (rem_cycle_dir / "failure.json").write_text(
3471                    json.dumps(disposition, indent=2), encoding="utf-8",
3472                )
3473                self._record_event(
3474                    task_id=task_spec.task_id, agent_id=rem_resource_id,
3475                    action="remediation_failed", spec=task_spec, metadata=disposition,
3476                )
3477                return self._fail_task(
3478                    task_spec, run_dir, error, start_time,
3479                    exit_code=rem_res.exit_code or 1, progress_tracker=progress,
3480                    stage="remediating", routing=routing, current_delta=current_delta,
3481                    review_cycles=review_cycles, verif_plan=verif_plan,
3482                    remediation_count=remediation_count, provider_execution=rem_res,
3483                    failure_class=failure_class, implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts,
3484                )
3485
3486            self._record_event(
3487                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3488                agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
3489                action="remediation_completed",
3490                spec=task_spec,
3491                metadata={"cycle": remediation_count, "files_modified": len(current_delta.files_modified)},
3492            )
3493            self._record_delta_captured(task_spec)
3494            CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
3495                run_dir,
3496                "remediating",
3497                output_artifacts=[str(rem_cycle_dir / "diff.patch")],
3498            )
3499
3500            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
3501                self.config.failure_injection_hook("post_remediation", run_dir, task_spec)
3502
3503            current_reviewers = ReviewRunner.determine_re_review_roles(
3504                cycle_res.all_findings,
3505                routing.recommended_reviewers,
3506            )
3507            task_spec.transition_to("reviewing", f"Re-review cycle {remediation_count + 1} for targeted roles: {current_reviewers}")
3508            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
3509
3510        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3511        # Stage 6: Deterministic Verification Gate (verifying)
3512        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3513        if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
3514            self.config.failure_injection_hook("verifying", run_dir, task_spec)
3515
3516        # The same gate the resume path runs, called rather than restated, so a
3517        # task verified after a pre-verification escalation and a task verified
3518        # in one pass cannot reach different conclusions from the same evidence
3519        # (issues.md #12).
3520        verif_status = self.run_deterministic_verification(
3521            task_spec,
3522            run_dir=run_dir,
3523            progress=progress,
3524            verif_plan=verif_plan,
3525            baseline=baseline,
3526            delta=current_delta,
3527        )
3528        verif_summary = {s.name: s.status for s in verif_plan.steps}
3529        if verif_status != "passed":
3530            failed_steps = [s.name for s in verif_plan.steps if s.status == "failed" and s.required]
3531            err_msg = f"Deterministic verification failed on required steps: {', '.join(failed_steps)}"
3532            # A salvaged candidate only ever existed on sufferance. Governance
3533            # has now rejected it, so the repository goes back to its pre-task
3534            # baseline rather than keeping a patch nothing stands behind. A
3535            # provider-attested implementation still keeps its diff in place for
3536            # inspection, as before.
3537            if timeout_candidate is not None and not current_delta.is_empty:
3538                restored_ok, restore_err = restore_repository_to_baseline(
3539                    self.target_repo, baseline, current_delta
3540                )
3541                self._record_event(
3542                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3543                    agent_id="control_plane",
3544                    action="timeout_candidate_rejected",
3545                    spec=task_spec,
3546                    metadata={
3547                        "stage": "verifying",
3548                        "origin": CANDIDATE_ORIGIN_TIMED_OUT,
3549                        "rollback_restored": restored_ok,
3550                        "rollback_error": restore_err,
3551                        "failed_steps": failed_steps,
3552                    },
3553                )
3554                if not restored_ok:
3555                    err_msg = (
3556                        f"{err_msg}. Repository could not be restored to baseline "
3557                        f"({restore_err}); candidate changes remain."
3558                    )
3559            return self._fail_task(
3560                task_spec,
3561                run_dir,
3562                err_msg,
3563                start_time,
3564                exit_code=1,
3565                progress_tracker=progress,
3566                stage="verifying",
3567                routing=routing,
3568                initial_delta=initial_delta,
3569                current_delta=current_delta,
3570                review_cycles=review_cycles,
3571                reconciliation=latest_reconciliation,
3572                verif_plan=verif_plan,
3573                hf_status=hf_audit_status,
3574                hf_match=hf_audit_match,
