3575                remediation_count=remediation_count,
3576                provider_execution=impl_res,
3577                failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_VERIFICATION,
3578                timeout_candidate=timeout_candidate,
3579            )
3580
3581        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3582        # Stage 7: Human Authority Boundary Gate (awaiting_human)
3583        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3584        actions_to_check = list(planned_actions or [])
3585        if any(kw in task_spec.objective.lower() for kw in ["deploy", "terraform apply", "kubectl apply", "drop table"]):
3586            actions_to_check.append(task_spec.objective)
3587
3588        boundary_res = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate(
3589            task=task_spec,
3590            planned_actions=actions_to_check,
3591            change_summary=f"Changed {len(current_delta.files_modified) + len(current_delta.files_added)} files (+{current_delta.insertions}/-{current_delta.deletions})",
3592            reconciliation=latest_reconciliation,
3593            verification=verif_plan,
3594            non_independent_roles=sorted(
3595                {role for cyc in review_cycles for role in cyc.non_independent_roles}
3596            ),
3597        )
3598
3599        stage_kwargs = dict(
3600            start_time=start_time,
3601            run_dir=run_dir,
3602            routing=routing,
3603            initial_delta=initial_delta,
3604            current_delta=current_delta,
3605            review_cycles=review_cycles,
3606            reconciliation=latest_reconciliation,
3607            verif_plan=verif_plan,
3608            boundary_res=boundary_res,
3609            hf_status=hf_audit_status,
3610            hf_match=hf_audit_match,
3611            remediation_count=remediation_count,
3612            provider_execution=impl_res,
3613            implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts,
3614            failover_summary=self._build_failover_summary(
3615                implementation_attempts,
3616                TERMINATION_IMPLEMENTATION_SUCCEEDED
3617                if timeout_candidate is None
3618                else TERMINATION_TIMEOUT_CANDIDATE_GOVERNED,
3619                last_selection_decision,
3620            ),
3621            timeout_candidate=timeout_candidate,
3622        )
3623
3624        if boundary_res.requires_human_approval:
3625            progress.record_terminal(
3626                TaskProgressState.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
3627                TaskPhase.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
3628            )
3629            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
3630                run_dir,
3631                task_spec.task_id,
3632                "awaiting_human",
3633                repo_path=self.target_repo,
3634                metadata={"boundary_triggers": boundary_res.triggered_boundaries},
3635            )
3636            task_spec.transition_to("awaiting_human", f"Human authority boundary triggered: {boundary_res.triggered_boundaries}")
3637            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
3638
3639            if boundary_res.decision_packet:
3640                (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(boundary_res.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
3641
3642            self._record_human_boundary_events(
3643                task_spec, run_dir, boundaries=boundary_res.triggered_boundaries
3644            )
3645
3646            return self._make_result(
3647                task_spec, "awaiting_human", 2,
3648                failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED, **stage_kwargs,
3649            )
3650
3651        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3652        # Stage 8: Governed Completion (complete)
3653        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3654        CheckpointManager.start_stage(
3655            run_dir,
3656            task_spec.task_id,
3657            "complete",
3658            repo_path=self.target_repo,
3659        )
3660        task_spec.transition_to("complete", "All reviews, reconciliations, deterministic verifications, and policies passed.")
3661        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
3662
3663        # The one place acceptance becomes true. Everything before this point
3664        # survived review, reconciliation, deterministic verification and the
3665        # human authority boundary; only now is there an accepted implementer.
3666        if final_impl_resource_id is not None:
3667            self._persist_effective_route(
3668                routing,
3669                task_spec,
3670                final_impl_resource_id,
3671                ROUTE_STATUS_SUPERSEDED
3672                if final_impl_resource_id != routing.metadata.get(
3673                    "initial_implementation_resource", routing.selected_agent_id
3674                )
3675                else ROUTE_STATUS_ACCEPTED,
3676                accepted=True,
3677                # Acceptance does not erase how the work arrived. A candidate
3678                # that cleared governance is still a candidate in provenance.
3679                candidate_resource=(
3680                    final_impl_resource_id if timeout_candidate else None
3681                ),
3682                # Acceptance names an accepted implementer; it does not
3683                # retroactively make a promoted fallback the last resource that
3684                # was actually attempted.
3685                last_attempted_resource_id=salvage_last_attempted_id,
3686            )
3687
3688        # Generate summary markdown
3689        summary_md = self._render_summary_markdown(
3690            task=task_spec,
3691            routing=routing,
3692            delta=current_delta,
3693            review_cycles=review_cycles,
3694            verif_plan=verif_plan,
3695            remediation_count=remediation_count,
3696            hf_status=hf_audit_status,
3697        )
3698        (run_dir / "summary.md").write_text(summary_md, encoding="utf-8")
3699
3700        self._record_event(
3701            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3702            agent_id="control_plane",
3703            action="task_completed",
3704            spec=task_spec,
3705            metadata={
3706                "remediation_cycles": remediation_count,
3707                "verification_status": verif_status,
3708                "files_changed": len(current_delta.files_modified) + len(current_delta.files_added),
3709            },
3710        )
3711        CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
3712            run_dir,
3713            "complete",
3714            output_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "summary.md")],
3715        )
3716
3717        progress.record_terminal(
3718            TaskProgressState.COMPLETE,
3719            TaskPhase.COMPLETE,
3720        )
3721        self._prune_ephemeral_scratch(run_dir, task_spec.task_id)
3722        return self._make_result(task_spec, "complete", 0, **stage_kwargs)
3723
3724    def _record_human_boundary_events(
3725        self,
3726        task_spec: TaskSpec,
3727        run_dir: Path,
3728        boundaries: Optional[List[str]] = None,
3729        reason: Optional[str] = None,
3730    ) -> None:
3731        meta = {"boundaries": boundaries} if boundaries else {"reason": reason}
3732        self._record_event(
3733            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3734            agent_id="control_plane",
3735            action="human_decision_requested",
3736            artifact=str(run_dir / "decision_packet.md"),
3737            spec=task_spec,
3738            metadata=meta,
3739        )
3740        self._record_event(
3741            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3742            agent_id="control_plane",
3743            action="human_boundary_triggered",
3744            spec=task_spec,
3745            metadata=meta,
3746        )
3747
3748    def _make_result(
3749        self,
3750        task_spec: TaskSpec,
3751        final_state: str,
3752        exit_code: int,
3753        start_time: float,
3754        run_dir: Path,
3755        routing: Optional[Any] = None,
3756        initial_delta: Optional[Any] = None,
3757        current_delta: Optional[Any] = None,
3758        review_cycles: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
3759        reconciliation: Optional[Any] = None,
3760        verif_plan: Optional[Any] = None,
3761        boundary_res: Optional[Any] = None,
3762        hf_status: Optional[str] = None,
3763        hf_match: Optional[bool] = None,
3764        remediation_count: int = 0,
3765        err_msg: Optional[str] = None,
3766        provider_execution: Optional[AgentExecutionResult] = None,
3767        failure_class: Optional[str] = None,
3768        implementation_attempts: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
3769        failover_summary: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
3770        timeout_candidate: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
3771    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
3772        return OrchestrationResult(
3773            implementation_completion_claim=timeout_candidate is None,
3774            candidate_origin=(
3775                timeout_candidate.get("origin") if timeout_candidate else None
3776            ),
3777            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3778            task_spec=task_spec,
3779            final_state=final_state,
3780            exit_code=exit_code,
3781            routing_decision=routing,
3782            initial_delta=initial_delta,
3783            final_delta=current_delta,
3784            review_cycles=review_cycles or [],
3785            reconciliation=reconciliation,
3786            verification_plan=verif_plan,
3787            boundary_result=boundary_res,
3788            howlframe_audit_status=hf_status,
3789            howlframe_audit_match=hf_match,
3790            remediation_cycles_count=remediation_count,
3791            duration_seconds=round(time.time() - start_time, 3),
3792            error_message=err_msg,
3793            run_dir=str(run_dir),
3794            provider_execution=provider_execution,
3795            failure_class=failure_class,
3796            resource_selection=(
3797                routing.metadata.get("resource_selection")
3798                if routing is not None else None
3799            ),
3800            capacity_after=(
3801                self.config.provider_pool.get_all_statuses()
3802                if self.config.provider_pool is not None else {}
3803            ),
3804            implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts or [],
3805            failover_summary=failover_summary,
3806        )
3807
3808    def _fail_task(
3809        self,
3810        task_spec: TaskSpec,
3811        run_dir: Path,
3812        err_msg: str,
3813        start_time: float,
3814        exit_code: int = 1,
3815        agent_id: str = "control_plane",
3816        progress_tracker: Optional[Any] = None,
3817        **kwargs,
3818    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
3819        # Capture the original active stage identity BEFORE modifying task_spec state
3820        active_stage = kwargs.pop("stage", None)
3821        if not active_stage or active_stage in ("failed", "cancelled"):
3822            active_stage = task_spec.current_state
3823        if not active_stage or active_stage in ("failed", "cancelled"):
3824            latest_chk = CheckpointManager.load_latest_checkpoint(run_dir)
3825            if latest_chk and latest_chk.stage not in ("failed", "cancelled"):
3826                active_stage = latest_chk.stage
3827
3828        # Terminalize current stage checkpoint so it does not remain permanently in_progress
3829        try:
3830            delta = kwargs.get("current_delta") or kwargs.get("initial_delta")
3831            summary: Dict[str, Any] = {
3832                "error": err_msg,
3833                "exit_code": exit_code,
3834            }
3835            if kwargs.get("failure_class"):
3836                summary["failure_class"] = kwargs.get("failure_class")
3837            if delta is not None:
3838                summary.update(delta.to_event_metadata())
3839                summary["partial_work"] = not delta.is_empty
3840            CheckpointManager.fail_stage(
3841                run_dir,
3842                stage=active_stage,
3843                reason=err_msg,
3844                result_summary=summary,
3845            )
3846        except Exception:
3847            pass
3848
3849        if progress_tracker is not None:
3850            progress_tracker.record_terminal(
3851                TaskProgressState.FAILED,
3852                TaskPhase.FAILED,
3853                error_message=err_msg,
3854            )
3855        task_spec.transition_to("failed", err_msg)
3856        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
3857
3858        self._record_event(
3859            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3860            agent_id=agent_id,
3861            action="task_failed",
3862            result=err_msg,
3863            spec=task_spec,
3864        )
3865        self._prune_ephemeral_scratch(run_dir, task_spec.task_id)
3866        return self._make_result(
3867            task_spec=task_spec,
3868            final_state="failed",
3869            exit_code=exit_code,
3870            start_time=start_time,
3871            run_dir=run_dir,
3872            err_msg=err_msg,
3873            **kwargs,
3874        )

3876    def _build_implementation_prompt(
3877        self,
3878        task: TaskSpec,
3879        ctx: Optional[ProjectContext] = None,
3880    ) -> str:
3881        """Constructs an implementation prompt with criteria and skill guidance."""
3882        lines = [
3883            f"# Task Implementation Request: `{task.task_id}`",

3885            "",
3886            "## Acceptance Criteria",

3888        for c in task.acceptance_criteria:
3889            lines.append(f"- {c}")
3890        if task.constraints:
3891            lines.append("")
3892            lines.append("## Constraints")
3893            for c in task.constraints:
3894                lines.append(f"- {c}")
3895        if task.required_skills:
3896            lines.append("")
3897            lines.append("## Required Skills")
3898            for s in task.required_skills:
3899                lines.append(f"- {s}")
3900        lines.append("")
3901        lines.append("## Workspace")
3902        lines.append(
3903            f"- Scratch files belong in `{self._attempt_workspace_hint(task)}`."
3904        )
3905        lines.append(
3906            f"- Everything else under `.task_runs/{task.task_id}/` is "
3907            "control-plane evidence. Do not create or edit files there."
3908        )
3909        if "howlframe-app-development" in (task.required_skills or []):
3910            lines.append("")
3911            lines.append("## HowlFrame Application Guidance")
3912            lines.append("- Build & test commands: `bash scripts/build.sh`, `bash scripts/test.sh`")
3913            lines.append("- Standalone bytecode VM runs under capability gates (`network,database,filesystem`).")
3914            lines.append("- Single root form (`http_server`, `web_app`, `cli_app`, or `module`) per `.howl` file.")
3915            lines.append("- Handle fallible parsing/io using `try_let`.")

3917
3918    def _build_remediation_prompt(
3919        self,
3920        task: TaskSpec,
3921        diff_content: str,
3922        findings: List[ReviewFinding],
3923    ) -> str:
3924        """Constructs an actionable remediation prompt with confirmed defect evidence."""
3925        lines = [
3926            f"# Remediation Request for Task `{task.task_id}`",
3927            f"**Objective:** {task.objective}",
3928            "",
3929            "## Identified Defects to Remediate",
3930        ]
3931        for f in findings:
3932            lines.append(f"### [{f.severity.upper()}] {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role})")
3933            if f.location:
3934                lines.append(f"- **Location:** `{f.location}`")
3935            if f.claim:
3936                lines.append(f"- **Claim:** {f.claim}")
3937            if f.evidence:
3938                lines.append(f"- **Evidence / Failure Case:** {f.evidence}")
3939            if f.suggested_fix:
3940                lines.append(f"- **Suggested Fix:** {f.suggested_fix}")
3941            lines.append("")
3942
3943        lines.extend([
3944            "## Current Implementation Diff",
3945            "```diff",
3946            diff_content,
3947            "```",
3948            "",
3949            "## Instructions",
3950            "Fix the reported defects in the repository. Ensure all edge cases and tests pass.",
3951        ])
3952        return "\n".join(lines)
3953
3954    def _render_summary_markdown(
3955        self,
3956        task: TaskSpec,
3957        routing: RoutingDecision,
3958        delta: RepositoryDelta,
3959        review_cycles: List[ReviewCycleResult],
3960        verif_plan: VerificationPlan,
3961        remediation_count: int,
3962        hf_status: Optional[str],
3963    ) -> str:
3964        # One authoritative answer, not a per-line re-derivation. `actual_agent`
3965        # mirrors the effective implementer once implementation settles; the
3966        # explicit field wins where both exist (issues.md #16).
3967        implementer_id = (
3968            task.effective_implementer_resource_id
3969            or task.actual_agent
3970            or routing.selected_agent_id
3971        )
3972        lines = [
3973            f"# Governed Task Run Summary: `{task.task_id}`",
3974            "",
3975            "## Overview",
3976            f"- **Objective:** {task.objective}",
3977            f"- **Repository:** {self.target_repo.name}",
3978            f"- **Final State:** `{task.current_state.upper()}`",
3979            f"- **Implementing Agent:** {implementer_id} (`{implementer_id}`)",
3980            f"- **Reasoning Tier:** {routing.reasoning_tier}",
3981            f"- **HowlFrame Shadow Audit:** {hf_status or 'N/A'}",
3982            "",
3983        ]
3984        if implementer_id and implementer_id != routing.selected_agent_id:
3985            lines.append(f"- **Initial Route:** {routing.selected_agent_name} (`{routing.selected_agent_id}`)")
3986            lines.append("")
3987        lines.extend([
3988            "## Repository Changes",
3989            f"- **Files Added:** {len(delta.files_added)}",
3990            f"- **Files Modified:** {len(delta.files_modified)}",
3991            f"- **Files Deleted:** {len(delta.files_deleted)}",
3992            f"- **Total Insertions:** +{delta.insertions}",
3993            f"- **Total Deletions:** -{delta.deletions}",
3994            "",
3995            "## Review & Remediation",
3996            f"- **Total Review Cycles:** {len(review_cycles)}",
3997            f"- **Remediation Cycles:** {remediation_count}",
3998        ])
3999        if review_cycles:
4000            last_cycle = review_cycles[-1]
4001            lines.append(f"- **Final Review Status:** `{last_cycle.status}`")
4002            for role, res in sorted(last_cycle.reviewer_results.items()):
4003                lines.append(f"  - `{role}`: {res.status} ({len(res.findings)} findings)")
4004
4005        lines.extend([
4006            "",
4007            "## Deterministic Verification",
4008            f"- **Overall Status:** `{verif_plan.overall_status.upper()}`",
4009        ])
4010        executed_steps = [
4011            s for s in verif_plan.steps
4012            if s.exit_code is not None or s.status in ("verified", "failed")
4013        ]
4014        if not executed_steps and verif_plan.steps:
4015            lines.append(f"- **Discovered:** {len(verif_plan.steps)} steps (not executed — implementation failed before verification)")
4016        for step in verif_plan.steps:
4017            if step.exit_code is not None or step.status in ("verified", "failed"):
4018                mark = "✓" if step.status == "verified" else "✗"
4019                lines.append(f"- [{mark}] **{step.name}** (`{step.category}`): {step.status} (exit {step.exit_code})")
4020            else:
4021                lines.append(f"- [ ] **{step.name}** (`{step.category}`): {step.status}")
4022
4023        lines.extend([
4024            "",
4025            "---",
4026            "*Verified and sealed by HowlPlane AI Engineering Control Plane.*",
4027        ])
4028        return "\n".join(lines)

248    scratch_root: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None
249    # Run deterministic gates against a sanitized view (baseline + task delta)
250    # instead of the live checkout, so untracked control plane evidence cannot
251    # change a verification result (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-07S).
252    verification_isolation: bool = True

def compute_remediation_timeout( config: OrchestrationConfig, findings: Optional[List[howlplane.control_plane.reconciliation.ReviewFinding]] = None, affected_files: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None) -> int: 
255def compute_remediation_timeout(
256    config: OrchestrationConfig,
257    findings: Optional[List[ReviewFinding]] = None,
258    affected_files: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None,
259) -> int:
260    """Returns a bounded execution budget for a remediation cycle.
261
262    The default policy is explicit, simple, and capped:
263    - Start from the implementation timeout.
264    - Add time per review finding weighted by severity.
265    - Add time per affected file.
266    - Never exceed max_multiplier * base timeout.
267    - For bounded runs, never exceed bounded_remediation_timeout_ceiling_seconds.
268
269    An explicit ``remediation_timeout_seconds`` is honored up to the same max.
270    """
271    base = config.timeout_seconds
272    max_total = int(base * max(1.0, config.remediation_timeout_max_multiplier))
273    if config.run_mode == "bounded":
274        max_total = min(max_total, config.bounded_remediation_timeout_ceiling_seconds)
275
276    if config.remediation_timeout_seconds is not None:
277        return min(config.remediation_timeout_seconds, max_total)
278
279    severity_seconds = {
280        "blocker": 120,
281        "high": 90,
282        "medium": 60,
283        "low": 30,
284        "informational": 15,
285    }
286
287    finding_overhead = 0
288    for finding in findings or []:
289        finding_overhead += severity_seconds.get(finding.severity, 60)
290
291    file_overhead = (len(set(affected_files or []))) * config.remediation_timeout_per_affected_file_seconds
292
293    calculated = base + finding_overhead + file_overhead
294    if config.run_mode == "bounded":
295        return min(calculated, max_total)
296    return max(base, min(calculated, max_total))

Returns a bounded execution budget for a remediation cycle.

The default policy is explicit, simple, and capped:

  • Start from the implementation timeout.
  • Add time per review finding weighted by severity.
  • Add time per affected file.
  • Never exceed max_multiplier * base timeout.
  • For bounded runs, never exceed bounded_remediation_timeout_ceiling_seconds.

An explicit remediation_timeout_seconds is honored up to the same max.

310class OrchestrationResult:
311    """Complete result packet from governed task execution."""
312
313    task_id: str
314    task_spec: TaskSpec
315    final_state: str  # "complete", "awaiting_human", "failed", "blocked"
316    exit_code: int
317    routing_decision: Optional[RoutingDecision] = None
318    initial_delta: Optional[RepositoryDelta] = None
319    final_delta: Optional[RepositoryDelta] = None
320    review_cycles: List[ReviewCycleResult] = field(default_factory=list)
321    reconciliation: Optional[ReconciliationResult] = None
322    verification_plan: Optional[VerificationPlan] = None
323    boundary_result: Optional[BoundaryCheckResult] = None
324    howlframe_audit_status: Optional[str] = None
325    howlframe_audit_match: bool = True
326    remediation_cycles_count: int = 0
327    duration_seconds: float = 0.0
328    error_message: Optional[str] = None
329    run_dir: Optional[str] = None
330    # Structured provider evidence (#59.1 Phase 1). `provider_execution` is the
331    # verbatim implementation-role AgentExecutionResult -- exactly the type
332    # ProviderPoolManager.detect_exhaustion() consumes -- so a caller can tell a
333    # quota/session failure apart from bad generated code without parsing any
334    # human-readable summary text.
335    provider_execution: Optional[AgentExecutionResult] = None
336    failure_class: Optional[str] = None
337    resource_selection: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
338    capacity_after: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
339    trajectory_id: Optional[str] = None
340    # Additive record of every implementation provider attempt, successful or not.
341    implementation_attempts: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
342    # Why bounded failover stopped, and what was still eligible when it did.
343    failover_summary: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
344    # Whether the implementing provider actually reported completion. False for
345    # a candidate salvaged from a budget-stopped attempt, which reaches the same
346    # review and verification gates without ever being called a success
347    # (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05).
348    implementation_completion_claim: bool = True
349    candidate_origin: Optional[str] = None
350    schema: str = ORCHESTRATOR_SCHEMA_VERSION
351
352    @property
353    def executing_provider(self) -> Optional[str]:
354        """The provider that actually executed, from observed evidence."""
355        if self.provider_execution is not None:
356            return self.provider_execution.agent_id
357        return self.routing_decision.selected_agent_id if self.routing_decision else None
358
359    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
360        return {
361            "task_id": self.task_id,
362            "final_state": self.final_state,
363            "exit_code": self.exit_code,
364            "routing_decision": asdict(self.routing_decision) if self.routing_decision else None,
365            "initial_delta": self.initial_delta.to_dict() if self.initial_delta else None,
366            "final_delta": self.final_delta.to_dict() if self.final_delta else None,
367            "review_cycles": [c.to_dict() for c in self.review_cycles],
368            "reconciliation": self.reconciliation.to_dict() if self.reconciliation else None,
369            "verification_plan": self.verification_plan.to_dict() if self.verification_plan else None,
370            "howlframe_audit_status": self.howlframe_audit_status,
371            "howlframe_audit_match": self.howlframe_audit_match,
372            "remediation_cycles_count": self.remediation_cycles_count,
373            "duration_seconds": self.duration_seconds,
374            "error_message": self.error_message,
375            "run_dir": self.run_dir,
376            "provider_execution": self.provider_execution.to_dict() if self.provider_execution else None,
377            "executing_provider": self.executing_provider,
378            "failure_class": self.failure_class,
379            "resource_selection": self.resource_selection,
380            "capacity_after": self.capacity_after,
381            "trajectory_id": self.trajectory_id,
382            "implementation_attempts": self.implementation_attempts,
383            "failover_summary": self.failover_summary,
384            "schema": self.schema,

 388class GovernedTaskOrchestrator:
 389    """
 390    Drives the end-to-end governed engineering lifecycle, maintaining
 391    strict control over state transitions, adversarial reviews,
 392    remediation loops, verification gates, and human authority boundaries.
 393    """
 394
 395    def __init__(
 396        self,
 397        target_repo: Union[str, Path],
 398        control_plane_root: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
 399        config: Optional[OrchestrationConfig] = None,
 400    ):
 401        self.target_repo = Path(target_repo).resolve()
 402        self.control_plane_root = (
 403            Path(control_plane_root).resolve()
 404            if control_plane_root
 405            else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
 406        )
 407        self.config = config or OrchestrationConfig()
 408        ledger_path = str(self.control_plane_root / "logs" / "control_plane" / "evidence_ledger.jsonl")
 409        self.ledger = EvidenceLedger(ledger_path)
 410        traj_dir = self.config.trajectory_store_dir
 411        if traj_dir is None:
 412            traj_dir = self.control_plane_root / "logs" / "control_plane" / "trajectories"
 413        self.trajectory_store = TrajectoryStore(traj_dir) if self.config.record_trajectory else None
 414
 415    def _enforce_task_path_scope(self, task_spec: TaskSpec, delta: RepositoryDelta) -> List[str]:
 416        """
 417        Reverts edits outside `task_spec.allowed_paths` before the delta is
 418        reviewed (#59.2 Phase 8/17).
 419
 420        `allowed_paths` was previously enforced only at commit time, inside
 421        GitIntegrationExecutor.stage_and_commit -- after independent review had
 422        already seen (and legitimately objected to) the out-of-scope work. A
 423        path-scoped task whose agent wandered into production files therefore
 424        parked on review findings about code it was never permitted to change.
 425        Enforcing here keeps the reviewed diff identical to the committed one.
 426
 427        Reverts only the paths the delta itself names, using the same
 428        `git checkout --` / unlink pair as _reconcile_attempt_state: no
 429        `git reset --hard`, no `git clean`, and files the task never touched
 430        are never inspected. Returns the reverted paths (empty when the task
 431        declares no scope, which is the default for ordinary tasks).
 432        """
 433        allowed = list(task_spec.allowed_paths or [])
 434        if not allowed or delta is None or delta.is_empty:
 435            return []
 436
 437        repo_root = Path(self.target_repo).resolve()
 438        out_of_scope = [
 439            p for p in (
 440                list(delta.files_modified) + list(delta.files_deleted) + list(delta.files_added)
 441            )
 442            if p not in allowed
 443        ]
 444        added = set(delta.files_added)
 445        for rel_path in out_of_scope:
 446            if rel_path in added:
 447                candidate = (repo_root / rel_path).resolve()
 448                # Never step outside the repository, whatever the delta claims.
 449                if not str(candidate).startswith(str(repo_root)):
 450                    continue
 451                try:
 452                    if candidate.is_file():
 453                        candidate.unlink()
 454                except OSError:
 455                    pass
 456            else:
 457                run_git(repo_root, ["checkout", "--", rel_path], 30)
 458        return out_of_scope
 459
 460    def _capture_scoped_delta(
 461        self,
 462        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 463        baseline: GitBaseline,
 464        agent_id: str,
 465        stage: str,
 466    ) -> RepositoryDelta:
 467        """Capture delta and revert any out-of-scope edits before review/commit."""
 468        delta = capture_delta(self.target_repo, baseline)
 469        reverted_scope = self._enforce_task_path_scope(task_spec, delta)
 470        if reverted_scope:
 471            delta = capture_delta(self.target_repo, baseline)
 472            self._record_event(
 473                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 474                agent_id=agent_id,
 475                action="out_of_scope_edits_reverted",
 476                spec=task_spec,
 477                metadata={"reverted_paths": reverted_scope, "allowed_paths": list(task_spec.allowed_paths), "stage": stage},
 478            )
 479        return delta
 480
 481    def _record_implementation_attempt(
 482        self,
 483        run_dir: Path,
 484        attempts_dir: Path,
 485        attempt_num: int,
 486        resource_id: str,
 487        impl_res: Optional[AgentExecutionResult],
 488        delta: RepositoryDelta,
 489        failure_class: Optional[str],
 490        capacity_before: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
 491    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 492        """Persists attempt-level evidence and returns an additive record."""
 493        attempt_dir = attempts_dir / f"{attempt_num:02d}-{resource_id}"
 494        attempt_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 495
 496        if impl_res is not None:
 497            (attempt_dir / "result.json").write_text(impl_res.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
 498        (attempt_dir / "diff.patch").write_text(delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")
 499        if not delta.is_empty:
 500            (attempt_dir / "partial_work.patch").write_text(delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")
 501
 502        # A retained salvage artifact from an earlier, interrupted run lives on
 503        # this attempt's record. Re-recording the same slot on resume must not
 504        # erase the fallback; its patch is kept under its own name and its
 505        # identity is digest-checked before any promotion, so carrying it
 506        # forward can only ever be verified, never trusted blindly.
 507        carried_salvage: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
 508        existing_record = attempt_dir / "attempt_record.json"
 509        if existing_record.is_file():
 510            try:
 511                carried_salvage = (
 512                    safe_load_json(existing_record) or {}
 513                ).get("retained_salvage")
 514            except Exception:
 515                carried_salvage = None
 516
 517        capacity_after: Dict[str, str] = {}
 518        if self.config.provider_pool is not None:
 519            # record_result already mutated state; capture after.
 520            capacity_after = self.config.provider_pool.get_all_statuses()
 521
 522        record: Dict[str, Any] = {
 523            "attempt": attempt_num,
 524            "resource_id": resource_id,
 525            "agent_id": impl_res.agent_id if impl_res else resource_id,
 526            "identity": self._resource_identity_fields(resource_id),
 527            "success": impl_res.success if impl_res else False,
 528            "exit_code": impl_res.exit_code if impl_res else None,
 529            "duration_seconds": impl_res.duration_seconds if impl_res else 0.0,
 530            "failure_class": failure_class,
 531            "delta": delta.to_dict(),
 532            "capacity_before": capacity_before,
 533            "capacity_after": capacity_after,
 534            "schema": IMPLEMENTATION_ATTEMPT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
 535            "evidence_dir": str(attempt_dir.relative_to(run_dir)),
 536        }
 537        if impl_res and isinstance((impl_res.metadata or {}).get("watchdog_diagnostics"), dict):
 538            record["watchdog_diagnostics"] = impl_res.metadata["watchdog_diagnostics"]
 539        if carried_salvage:
 540            record["retained_salvage"] = carried_salvage
 541        self._persist_attempt_record(record, attempts_dir)
 542        return record
 543
 544    def _resource_identity_fields(self, resource_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 545        """Names which provider, interface, and model actually ran this attempt."""
 546        state = (
 547            self.config.provider_pool.get_resource_status(resource_id)
 548            if self.config.provider_pool is not None else None
 549        )
 550        if state is None:
 551            return {
 552                "provider_id": None,
 553                "interface_id": None,
 554                "resource_id": resource_id,
 555                "model_id": None,
 556            }
 557        return {
 558            "provider_id": state.provider_id,
 559            "interface_id": state.interface_id,
 560            "resource_id": state.resource_id or resource_id,
 561            "model_id": state.model_id,
 562        }
 563
 564    @staticmethod
 565    def _persist_attempt_record(
 566        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
 567        attempts_dir: Path,
 568    ) -> None:
 569        """Rewrites an attempt's record in place as later evidence is amended.
 570
 571        Attempt evidence is additive and is filled in across the attempt's
 572        lifetime -- the result first, then the failover selection, then the
 573        rollback outcome, and now the retained-salvage block -- so every
 574        amendment goes through here rather than opening its own write path.
 575
 576        The write is atomic because a retained salvage artifact is discoverable
 577        only through this file: a torn write during an interruption would lose
 578        the fallback that HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-07R proved must survive.
 579        """
 580        record_path = (
 581            attempts_dir
 582            / f"{attempt_record['attempt']:02d}-{attempt_record['resource_id']}"
 583            / "attempt_record.json"
 584        )
 585        atomic_write_json(record_path, attempt_record)
 586
 587    def _attach_next_selection(
 588        self,
 589        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
 590        attempts_dir: Path,
 591        decision: Any,
 592    ) -> None:
 593        """Records which resource failover chose next, and why the others lost."""
 594        selected = getattr(decision, "selected", None)
 595        attempt_record["next_selection"] = {
 596            "selected_resource_id": selected.resource_id if selected else None,
 597            "blocked_reason": getattr(decision, "blocked_reason", None),
 598            "eligible_resources": [
 599                identity.resource_id
 600                for identity in getattr(decision, "eligible_resources", []) or []
 601            ],
 602            "exclusions": [
 603                {
 604                    "resource_id": exclusion.resource_id,
 605                    "reason": exclusion.reason,
 606                    "stage": exclusion.stage,
 607                }
 608                for exclusion in getattr(decision, "exclusions", []) or []
 609            ],
 610        }
 611        self._persist_attempt_record(attempt_record, attempts_dir)
 612
 613    def _attach_rollback_result(
 614        self,
 615        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
 616        attempts_dir: Path,
 617        restored: bool,
 618        error: Optional[str],
 619    ) -> None:
 620        """Records whether this attempt's work was safely undone before the next."""
 621        attempt_record["rollback"] = {"restored": restored, "error": error}
 622        self._persist_attempt_record(attempt_record, attempts_dir)
 623
 624    def _park_awaiting_human(
 625        self,
 626        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 627        run_dir: Path,
 628        err_msg: str,
 629        decision_pkt: "HumanDecisionPacket",
 630        progress: Any,
 631    ) -> None:
 632        """Hands a task to human authority, leaving the working tree in place.
 633
 634        Every parking path performs the same five steps, and the working tree is
 635        deliberately never rolled back here: a human is being asked to look at
 636        exactly what is on disk.
 637        """
 638        progress.record_terminal(
 639            TaskProgressState.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
 640            TaskPhase.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
 641            error_message=err_msg,
 642        )
 643        task_spec.transition_to("awaiting_human", err_msg)
 644        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
 645        (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(
 646            decision_pkt.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8"
 647        )
 648        self._record_human_boundary_events(task_spec, run_dir, reason=err_msg)
 649
 650    def _get_scratch_base_path(self) -> Path:
 651        """Determines the root directory for external provider scratch workspaces.
 652
 653        Provider scratch and the sanitized verification view share one root and
 654        one containment rule, so a root configured inside the target repository
 655        is rejected identically for both.
 656        """
 657        repo = self.target_repo if hasattr(self, "target_repo") else Path.cwd()
 658        return resolve_external_scratch_root(repo, self.config.scratch_root)
 659
 660    def _execute_verification_plan(
 661        self,
 662        verif_plan: VerificationPlan,
 663        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 664        baseline: GitBaseline,
 665        delta: RepositoryDelta,
 666        run_dir: Path,
 667        progress: Optional[Any],
 668    ) -> str:
 669        """Runs the deterministic gates against a sanitized view of the repository.
 670
 671        The gates measure the product, so they must see the product and nothing
 672        else. Running them in the live checkout let untracked control plane
 673        evidence decide the outcome: in HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-07S a provider's
 674        source clone under `.task_runs/` moved the `go_production` clone count
 675        from 291 to 1421 without a line of product code changing.
 676
 677        A view that cannot be built fails the gate. Falling back to the live
 678        checkout would quietly restore that contamination and report the result
 679        as if it had been isolated.
 680        """
 681        if not self.config.verification_isolation:
 682            return verif_plan.execute_all(
 683                cwd=str(self.target_repo),
 684                stop_on_failure=self.config.stop_on_verification_failure,
 685                progress_tracker=progress,
 686            )
 687
 688        view_ref: Optional[Any] = None
 689        try:
 690            with verification_view(
 691                target_repo=self.target_repo,
 692                baseline=baseline,
 693                delta=delta,
 694                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 695                scratch_root=self.config.scratch_root,
 696            ) as view:
 697                view_ref = view
 698                self._record_event(
 699                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 700                    agent_id="control_plane",
 701                    action="verification_view_created",
 702                    spec=task_spec,
 703                    metadata={
 704                        "baseline_sha": view.baseline_sha,
 705                        "files_materialized": len(view.files_materialized),
 706                        "files_refused": view.files_refused,
 707                    },
 708                )
 709                status = verif_plan.execute_all(
 710                    cwd=str(view.path),
 711                    stop_on_failure=self.config.stop_on_verification_failure,
 712                    progress_tracker=progress,
 713                )
 714        except VerificationViewError as exc:
 715            reason = f"Sanitized verification view could not be built: {exc}"
 716            verif_plan.add_step(
 717                step_id="step-verification-view",
 718                name="Sanitized verification view",
 719                command=["git", "worktree", "add", "--detach"],
 720                category="policy_check",
 721                required=True,
 722                metadata={"baseline_sha": getattr(baseline, "initial_commit_sha", "")},
 723            )
 724            failed_step = verif_plan.steps[-1]
 725            failed_step.status = "failed"
 726            failed_step.exit_code = 1
 727            failed_step.stderr = reason
 728            verif_plan.overall_status = "failed"
 729            atomic_write_json(
 730                run_dir / "verification_view.json",
 731                {
 732                    "schema": VERIFICATION_VIEW_SCHEMA_VERSION,
 733                    "task_id": task_spec.task_id,
 734                    "status": "unavailable",
 735                    "error": str(exc),
 736                },
 737            )
 738            self._record_event(
 739                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 740                agent_id="control_plane",
 741                action="verification_view_failed",
 742                spec=task_spec,
 743                result="failed",
 744                metadata={"error": str(exc)},
 745            )
 746            return "failed"
 747
 748        # Written after teardown so the recorded cleanup status is the real one.
 749        if view_ref is not None:
 750            atomic_write_json(run_dir / "verification_view.json", view_ref.to_dict())
 751        return status
 752
 753    def _attempt_workspace_hint(self, task: TaskSpec) -> str:
 754        """The provider-writable scratch path, as named to the provider.
 755
 756        Deliberately outside `implementation/attempts/` and outside the target
 757        repository so scratch source trees or build caches cannot contaminate
 758        deterministic repository verification gates (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-07S).
 759        """
 760        base = self._get_scratch_base_path()
 761        repo_slug = self.target_repo.resolve().name if hasattr(self, "target_repo") else "repo"
 762        return f"{base}/{repo_slug}/{task.task_id}/provider_scratch/<NN-resource>/"
 763
 764    def _provider_scratch_dir(self, run_dir: Path, attempt_num: int, resource_id: str) -> Path:
 765        """Control-plane-owned scratch location for one attempt's provider."""
 766        base = self._get_scratch_base_path()
 767        repo_slug = self.target_repo.resolve().name if hasattr(self, "target_repo") else run_dir.parent.parent.name
 768        scratch_dir = base / repo_slug / run_dir.name / "provider_scratch" / f"{attempt_num:02d}-{resource_id}"
 769        scratch_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 770        return scratch_dir

 772    def _record_scratch_manifest(
 773        self,
 774        run_dir: Path,
 775        task_id: str,
 776        attempt_num: int,
 777        resource_id: str,
 778        scratch_dir: Path,
 779        status: str = "active",
 780        artifacts: Optional[List[str]] = None,
 781    ) -> None:
 782        """Records durable scratch location and ownership metadata in evidence."""
 783        manifest_path = run_dir / "scratch_manifest.json"
 784        manifest: Dict[str, Any] = {}
 785        if manifest_path.is_file():
 786            try:
 787                manifest = safe_load_json(manifest_path) or {}
 788            except Exception:
 789                manifest = {}
 790        if not manifest:
 791            manifest = {
 792                "task_id": task_id,
 793                "repository": str(self.target_repo.resolve()) if hasattr(self, "target_repo") else str(run_dir.parent.parent),
 794                "scratch_root": str(self._get_scratch_base_path()),
 795                "attempts": {},
 796                "schema": SCRATCH_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,
 797            }
 798        attempt_key = f"{attempt_num:02d}-{resource_id}"
 799        attempt_entry = manifest.get("attempts", {}).get(attempt_key, {})
 800        attempt_entry.update({
 801            "attempt": attempt_num,
 802            "resource_id": resource_id,
 803            "scratch_path": str(scratch_dir.resolve()),
 804            "status": status,
 805            "updated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 806        })
 807        if "created_at" not in attempt_entry:
 808            attempt_entry["created_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 809        if artifacts:
 810            existing = set(attempt_entry.get("artifacts", []))
 811            existing.update(artifacts)
 812            attempt_entry["artifacts"] = sorted(existing)
 813        manifest.setdefault("attempts", {})[attempt_key] = attempt_entry
 814        atomic_write_json(manifest_path, manifest)
