 816    def _prune_ephemeral_scratch(self, run_dir: Path, task_id: str) -> None:
 817        """Prunes large disposable build and tool caches from external scratch.
 818
 819        Preserves candidate patches, diffs, provider transcripts, failure evidence,
 820        and provenance files. Never removes candidate material or durable evidence.
 821        Strictly validates containment beneath the authorized scratch base to prevent
 822        path traversal or unintended file deletion.
 823        """
 824        manifest_path = run_dir / "scratch_manifest.json"
 825        if not manifest_path.is_file():
 826            return
 827        try:
 828            manifest = safe_load_json(manifest_path)
 829            if not manifest or manifest.get("schema") != SCRATCH_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION:
 830                return
 831            if not isinstance(manifest.get("attempts"), dict):
 832                return
 833            scratch_base = self._get_scratch_base_path().resolve()
 834            disposable_names = {"go-cache", ".cache"}
 835            disposable_suffixes = {".tar", ".iso"}
 836            for attempt_key, attempt_info in manifest["attempts"].items():
 837                scratch_str = attempt_info.get("scratch_path")
 838                if not scratch_str:
 839                    continue
 840                scratch_p = Path(scratch_str).resolve()
 841                # Security: scratch directory must be strictly contained within scratch_base,
 842                # cannot be scratch_base itself, and cannot be a symlink.
 843                if not scratch_p.is_relative_to(scratch_base) or scratch_p == scratch_base:
 844                    continue
 845                if scratch_p.is_symlink() or not scratch_p.is_dir():
 846                    continue
 847                pruned = False
 848                for item in scratch_p.iterdir():
 849                    if item.is_symlink():
 850                        continue
 851                    if item.is_dir() and item.name in disposable_names:
 852                        shutil.rmtree(item, ignore_errors=True)
 853                        pruned = True
 854                    elif item.is_file() and item.suffix in disposable_suffixes:
 855                        try:
 856                            item.unlink()
 857                            pruned = True
 858                        except OSError:
 859                            pass
 860                if pruned:
 861                    attempt_info["status"] = "cleaned"
 862                    attempt_info["pruned_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 863            atomic_write_json(manifest_path, manifest)
 864        except Exception:
 865            pass
 866
 867    def _resolve_backend(self, resource_id: str) -> AgentBackend:
 868        """Resolves the execution backend for a resource, however it is wired.
 869
 870        A resumed run reconciles its implementation from the durable delta and
 871        never enters the attempt loop, so the loop-local backend it used to rely
 872        on did not exist by the time remediation needed one -- resume died with
 873        an UnboundLocalError before it could finish recovering anything.
 874        """
 875        if self.config.custom_backend is not None:
 876            return self.config.custom_backend
 877        if self.config.backend_resolver is not None:
 878            return self.config.backend_resolver(resource_id)
 879        return AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(resource_id)
 880
 881    def _sweep_provider_scratch(
 882        self,
 883        run_dir: Path,
 884        resource_id: str,
 885        attempt_num: int,
 886        known_before: Set[str],
 887        attempts_dir: Optional[Path] = None,
 888        attempts_before: Optional[Set[str]] = None,
 889        owned_attempt_name: Optional[str] = None,
 890    ) -> List[str]:
 891        """Moves anything a provider left in the evidence namespace into scratch.
 892
 893        Providers write where they like -- they run in the repository with no
 894        filesystem sandbox -- so the boundary is enforced afterwards rather than
 895        assumed. Two escapes are swept: artifacts dropped at the run's evidence
 896        root (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05), and directories invented under
 897        `implementation/attempts/` that imitate a canonical attempt
 898        (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06, where `01-claude/` made a three-attempt run look
 899        like four). Both are relocated with provenance and nothing is deleted:
 900        the artifacts may well be useful, they are simply not evidence.
 901        """
 902        scratch = self._provider_scratch_dir(run_dir, attempt_num, resource_id)
 903        swept: List[str] = []
 904
 905        def relocate(entry: Path, label: str) -> None:
 906            scratch.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 907            destination = scratch / entry.name
 908            if destination.exists():
 909                destination = scratch / f"{entry.name}.{attempt_num:02d}"
 910            try:
 911                entry.replace(destination)
 912            except OSError:
 913                return
 914            swept.append(label)
 915
 916        for entry in sorted(run_dir.iterdir()):
 917            if entry.name in known_before:
 918                continue
 919            if entry.name in CONTROL_PLANE_RUN_ARTIFACTS:
 920                continue
 921            relocate(entry, entry.name)
 922
 923        # A directory under attempts/ that this run did not create is a
 924        # provider's guess at its own attempt label, not an attempt.
 925        if attempts_dir is not None and attempts_dir.is_dir():
 926            known_attempts = attempts_before or set()
 927            for entry in sorted(attempts_dir.iterdir()):
 928                if not entry.is_dir():
 929                    continue
 930                if entry.name in known_attempts or entry.name == owned_attempt_name:
 931                    continue
 932                if (entry / "attempt_record.json").is_file():
 933                    # Real control-plane evidence; never touch it.
 934                    continue
 935                for child in sorted(entry.iterdir()):
 936                    relocate(child, f"implementation/attempts/{entry.name}/{child.name}")
 937                try:
 938                    # Only ever removes the empty shell left behind, so the
 939                    # canonical attempt count stops counting a fake one.
 940                    entry.rmdir()
 941                except OSError:
 942                    pass
 943
 944        if swept:
 945            atomic_write_json(
 946                scratch / "_provenance.json",
 947                {
 948                    "origin": "provider_scratch",
 949                    "created_by": resource_id,
 950                    "attempt": attempt_num,
 951                    "relocated_from": f".task_runs/{run_dir.name}/",
 952                    "files": swept,
 953                    "note": (
 954                        "Written by the provider inside the control plane's "
 955                        "evidence namespace and relocated here. Not control "
 956                        "plane evidence."
 957                    ),
 958                    "swept_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 959                    "schema": PROVIDER_SCRATCH_SCHEMA_VERSION,
 960                },
 961            )
 962            self._record_scratch_manifest(
 963                run_dir,
 964                run_dir.name,
 965                attempt_num,
 966                resource_id,
 967                scratch,
 968                status="relocated",
 969                artifacts=swept,
 970            )
 971        return swept
 972
 973    def _attach_terminal_disposition(
 974        self,
 975        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
 976        attempts_dir: Path,
 977        attempt_num: int,
 978        attempted: Set[str],
 979        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 980    ) -> None:
 981        """Records why a salvaged final attempt has no successor.
 982
 983        Attempts that hand off carry `rollback` and `next_selection`; the one
 984        that exhausts the budget carried neither, so "no provider remained" and
 985        "nobody wrote the field" looked identical in the evidence. The candidate
 986        is deliberately not rolled back -- it is parked for governance -- and
 987        that has to be stated, not inferred (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06).
 988        """
 989        remaining: List[str] = []
 990        pool = self.config.provider_pool
 991        if pool is not None:
 992            try:
 993                for resource_id in pool.select_candidates(
 994                    task_category="code_heavy", task=task_spec
 995                ):
 996                    if resource_id not in attempted:
 997                        remaining.append(resource_id)
 998            except Exception:
 999                remaining = []
1000
1001        attempt_record["max_attempts"] = self.config.max_provider_failover_attempts
1002        attempt_record["rollback"] = {
1003            "restored": False,
1004            "error": None,
1005            "status": ROLLBACK_PARKED_FOR_GOVERNANCE,
1006            "reason": (
1007                "Candidate preserved for governance instead of being rolled "
1008                "back; no further attempt follows it."
1009            ),
1010        }
1011        attempt_record["next_selection"] = None
1012        attempt_record["next_selection_reason"] = NEXT_SELECTION_MAX_ATTEMPTS
1013        attempt_record["remaining_eligible_resources"] = remaining
1014        attempt_record["transition"] = TRANSITION_CANDIDATE_GOVERNANCE
1015        self._persist_attempt_record(attempt_record, attempts_dir)
1016
1017    @staticmethod
1018    def _recover_implementation_resource(run_dir: Path, routing: Any) -> Optional[str]:
1019        """Restores which resource produced the work being resumed.
1020
1021        A resumed run re-routes from scratch, so the in-memory decision knows
1022        nothing about the failover that already happened. The durable effective
1023        route does, and it is the only truthful source for who to credit --
1024        and, until governance clears it, who not to let review their own work.
1025        """
1026        route_file = run_dir / "effective_route.json"
1027        if route_file.is_file():
1028            try:
1029                meta = (safe_load_json(route_file) or {}).get("metadata") or {}
1030            except Exception:
1031                meta = {}
1032            recovered = (
1033                meta.get("accepted_implementation_resource")
1034                or meta.get("candidate_resource")
1035                or meta.get("last_attempted_implementation_resource")
1036            )
1037            if recovered:
1038                # Carry the failover history forward so this run's evidence
1039                # continues the story instead of restarting it.
1040                for key in (
1041                    "initial_route",
1042                    "initial_implementation_resource",
1043                    "candidate_resource",
1044                    "last_attempted_implementation_resource",
1045                    "reviewer_resource_mapping",
1046                    "reviewer_resource_identities",
1047                ):
1048                    if key in meta and key not in routing.metadata:
1049                        routing.metadata[key] = meta[key]
1050                return recovered
1051        return routing.metadata.get("last_attempted_implementation_resource")
1052
1053    @staticmethod
1054    def _load_parked_candidate(run_dir: Path) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
1055        """Recovers a parked timeout candidate's record after an interruption.
1056
1057        The candidate is durable evidence, so a resumed run must know it is
1058        governing a salvaged fragment rather than provider-attested work.
1059        """
1060        attempts_dir = run_dir / "implementation" / "attempts"
1061        if not attempts_dir.is_dir():
1062            return None
1063        for attempt_dir in sorted(attempts_dir.iterdir(), reverse=True):
1064            candidate_file = attempt_dir / "candidate.json"
1065            if candidate_file.is_file():
1066                try:
1067                    return safe_load_json(candidate_file)
1068                except Exception:
1069                    return None
1070        return None
1071
1072    @staticmethod
1073    def _is_salvageable_timeout_candidate(
1074        failure_class: Optional[Any],
1075        delta: Optional[RepositoryDelta],
1076    ) -> bool:
1077        """Reports whether a budget-stopped attempt left work worth governing.
1078
1079        A provider we stopped at our own deadline never claimed completion, but
1080        that says nothing about what it had already written. When such an
1081        attempt leaves a non-empty task-attributable delta, the artifact is a
1082        candidate -- neither trustworthy nor disposable -- and belongs in review
1083        and verification rather than the bin (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05).
1084        """
1085        if failure_class != ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED:
1086            return False
1087        return delta is not None and not delta.is_empty
1088
1089    @staticmethod
1090    def _timed_out_artifact_provenance(
1091        resource_id: str,
1092        attempt: int,
1093        delta: RepositoryDelta,
1094    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1095        """The provenance every budget-stopped artifact carries.
1096
1097        A retained fallback and a governed candidate are the same artifact at
1098        two different points in its life, so they describe their origin
1099        identically -- including the completion claim their producer never made.
1100        """
1101        return {
1102            "provider_completion_claim": False,
1103            "origin": CANDIDATE_ORIGIN_TIMED_OUT,
1104            "failure_class": ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.value,
1105            "resource_id": resource_id,
1106            "attempt": attempt,
1107            "files_added": list(delta.files_added),
1108            "files_modified": list(delta.files_modified),
1109            "files_deleted": list(delta.files_deleted),
1110            "insertions": delta.insertions,
1111            "deletions": delta.deletions,
1112            "captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
1113        }
1114
1115    def _capture_timeout_candidate(
1116        self,
1117        run_dir: Path,
1118        attempts_dir: Path,
1119        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
1120        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1121        resource_id: str,
1122        delta: RepositoryDelta,
1123    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1124        """Preserves a budget-stopped candidate and marks it as needing governance.
1125
1126        Written before any rollback can run, and deliberately separate from the
1127        provider's own result: `implementation/result.json` keeps success=false,
1128        so nothing here fabricates a completion the provider never claimed.
1129        """
1130        candidate = {
1131            "candidate_captured": True,
1132            "requires_governance": True,
1133            **self._timed_out_artifact_provenance(
1134                resource_id, attempt_record["attempt"], delta
1135            ),
1136            "schema": TIMEOUT_CANDIDATE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
1137        }
1138        attempt_dir = attempts_dir / f"{attempt_record['attempt']:02d}-{resource_id}"
1139        attempt_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1140        atomic_write_json(attempt_dir / "candidate.json", candidate)
1141        (attempt_dir / "candidate.patch").write_text(delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")
1142
1143        attempt_record["candidate"] = candidate
1144        self._persist_attempt_record(attempt_record, attempts_dir)
1145
1146        # Publish it as the run's current diff so the existing review and
1147        # verification stages act on it exactly as they would a normal one.
1148        self._write_delta_patch(delta, run_dir / "implementation", run_dir)
1149        self._record_event(
1150            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1151            agent_id=resource_id,
1152            action="timeout_candidate_captured",
1153            spec=task_spec,
1154            metadata={
1155                "attempt": attempt_record["attempt"],
1156                "origin": CANDIDATE_ORIGIN_TIMED_OUT,
1157                "provider_completion_claim": False,
1158                "files_changed": len(delta.files_modified) + len(delta.files_added),
1159                "insertions": delta.insertions,
1160                "deletions": delta.deletions,
1161            },
1162        )
1163        return candidate
1164
1165    def _retain_salvage_artifact(
1166        self,
1167        attempts_dir: Path,
1168        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
1169        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1170        resource_id: str,
1171        delta: RepositoryDelta,
1172        baseline: GitBaseline,
1173    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1174        """Keeps a productive timeout's work as a bounded terminal fallback.
1175
1176        Rollback must not mean forgetting. HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-07R rolled Codex's
1177        eligible EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED artifact out of the tree so Claude
1178        could attempt from a clean baseline -- which was correct -- and then
1179        terminal-failed without ever reconsidering it, because salvage was only
1180        ever evaluated for whichever attempt happened to be last.
1181
1182        The record lives on the attempt record beside the already-written
1183        partial_work.patch, and deliberately not in a `candidate.json`: while
1184        fresh failover remains this is not the run's candidate and
1185        `candidate_resource` must stay null. Live implementation state and
1186        retained salvageable artifacts are different things.
1187        """
1188        retained = {
1189            "retained": True,
1190            "eligibility": SALVAGE_ELIGIBLE,
1191            "promotion_status": SALVAGE_RETAINED,
1192            **self._timed_out_artifact_provenance(
1193                resource_id, attempt_record["attempt"], delta
1194            ),
1195            "patch_path": f"{attempt_record['evidence_dir']}/retained_salvage.patch",
1196            "patch_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
1197                delta.diff_content.encode("utf-8")
1198            ).hexdigest(),
1199            # Patch identity: what this artifact was captured against, so a
1200            # later promotion can prove it is being replayed onto the same
1201            # repository state rather than whatever happens to be present.
1202            "baseline_head": baseline.initial_commit_sha,
1203            "baseline_status_digest": hashlib.sha256(
1204                baseline.status_porcelain.encode("utf-8")
1205            ).hexdigest(),
1206            # Answered against the restored baseline, which is the only tree
1207            # whose answer means anything. Unknown until rollback has run.
1208            "replayable": None,
1209        }
1210        # Written under a name no attempt-recording path ever produces:
1211        # partial_work.patch belongs to whichever attempt last occupied this
1212        # slot, but the fallback must outlive a resumed re-attempt.
1213        attempt_dir = attempts_dir / f"{attempt_record['attempt']:02d}-{resource_id}"
1214        attempt_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1215        (attempt_dir / "retained_salvage.patch").write_text(
1216            delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8"
1217        )
1218        attempt_record["retained_salvage"] = retained
1219        self._persist_attempt_record(attempt_record, attempts_dir)
1220        self._record_event(
1221            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1222            agent_id=resource_id,
1223            action="retained_salvage_captured",
1224            spec=task_spec,
1225            metadata={
1226                "attempt": attempt_record["attempt"],
1227                "origin": CANDIDATE_ORIGIN_TIMED_OUT,
1228                "provider_completion_claim": False,
1229                "insertions": delta.insertions,
1230                "deletions": delta.deletions,
1231                "baseline_head": baseline.initial_commit_sha,
1232            },
1233        )
1234        return retained
1235
1236    def _confirm_salvage_replayable(
1237        self,
1238        run_dir: Path,
1239        attempts_dir: Path,
1240        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
1241        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1242    ) -> bool:
1243        """Proves the retained patch still applies to the restored baseline.
1244
1245        Deliberately run after rollback rather than before it: the clean
1246        baseline is the tree a promotion would replay onto. `git apply --check`
1247        never writes, so this cannot disturb the state the next provider is
1248        about to be handed. An artifact that fails here stays as evidence but
1249        can never be selected, so it can never be partially applied.
1250        """
1251        retained = attempt_record.get("retained_salvage")
1252        if not retained:
1253            return False
1254        patch_file = run_dir / retained["patch_path"]
1255        replayable = False
1256        if patch_file.is_file():
1257            replayable = run_git(
1258                self.target_repo, ["apply", "--check", str(patch_file)], 60
1259            ).returncode == 0
1260        retained["replayable"] = replayable
1261        if not replayable:
1262            retained["eligibility"] = SALVAGE_NOT_REPLAYABLE
1263        self._persist_attempt_record(attempt_record, attempts_dir)
1264        self._record_event(
1265            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1266            agent_id=retained["resource_id"],
1267            action="retained_salvage_replay_checked",
1268            spec=task_spec,
1269            metadata={
1270                "attempt": retained["attempt"],
1271                "replayable": replayable,
1272                "eligibility": retained["eligibility"],
1273            },
1274        )
1275        return replayable
1276
1277    @staticmethod
1278    def _iter_attempt_records(attempts_dir: Path):
1279        """Yields (record, retained_salvage) per attempt, in attempt order.
1280
1281        Attempt evidence is the durable source of truth for retention, so both
1282        selection and supersession read it from disk rather than from memory --
1283        which is what makes a retained fallback survive an interruption for
1284        free.
1285        """
1286        if not attempts_dir.is_dir():
1287            return
1288        for attempt_dir in sorted(attempts_dir.iterdir()):
1289            record_file = attempt_dir / "attempt_record.json"
1290            if not record_file.is_file():
1291                continue
1292            try:
1293                record = safe_load_json(record_file) or {}
1294            except Exception:
1295                continue
1296            yield record, record.get("retained_salvage") or {}
1297
1298    @staticmethod
1299    def _select_retained_salvage(attempts_dir: Path) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
1300        """Picks the fallback deterministically: most recent eligible wins.
1301
1302        No scoring, no ranking, no size heuristic, no model judgment. This
1303        preserves the existing semantics -- a productive *final* timeout is
1304        already the candidate -- and merely extends the search backward to the
1305        nearest prior equivalent when the later attempts produced nothing.
1306
1307        Records are walked in attempt order and the last match is kept, so the
1308        rule holds however many attempts a run is configured to allow.
1309        """
1310        chosen: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
1311        for record, retained in GovernedTaskOrchestrator._iter_attempt_records(
1312            attempts_dir
1313        ):
1314            if (
1315                retained.get("retained")
1316                and retained.get("eligibility") == SALVAGE_ELIGIBLE
1317                and retained.get("promotion_status") == SALVAGE_RETAINED
1318            ):
1319                chosen = record
1320        return chosen
1321
1322    def _recover_promoted_salvage(
1323        self,
1324        run_dir: Path,
1325        delta: RepositoryDelta,
1326        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1327    ) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
1328        """Finishes a promotion that was interrupted after the patch landed.
1329
1330        The crash window between applying a retained patch and capturing the
1331        candidate leaves the artifact sitting in the tree with nothing
1332        describing it. Recovery has to prove the delta in the tree *is* that
1333        artifact, byte for byte, before crediting anyone for it: a resumed run
1334        whose delta came from a later provider -- or from a provider that
1335        simply succeeded -- must not have a rolled-back fragment's producer
1336        stamped onto it. Without that proof this would launder discarded work
1337        into an accepted implementation and certify a self-review as
1338        independent.
1339
1340        Proven, it rebuilds exactly the candidate the uninterrupted path would
1341        have written, so `provider_completion_claim` stays false and the
1342        artifact keeps its timed-out origin.
1343        """
1344        attempts_dir = run_dir / "implementation" / "attempts"
1345        record = self._select_retained_salvage(attempts_dir)
1346        if record is None:
1347            return None
1348        retained = record["retained_salvage"]
1349        if hashlib.sha256(
1350            delta.diff_content.encode("utf-8")
1351        ).hexdigest() != retained.get("patch_sha256"):
1352            return None
1353
1354        candidate = self._capture_timeout_candidate(
1355            run_dir=run_dir,
1356            attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
1357            attempt_record=record,
1358            task_spec=task_spec,
1359            resource_id=retained["resource_id"],
1360            delta=delta,
1361        )
1362        retained["promotion_status"] = SALVAGE_PROMOTED
1363        retained["promoted_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
1364        record["transition"] = TRANSITION_CANDIDATE_GOVERNANCE
1365        self._persist_attempt_record(record, attempts_dir)
1366        self._record_event(
1367            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1368            agent_id=retained["resource_id"],
1369            action="retained_salvage_promotion_recovered",
1370            spec=task_spec,
1371            metadata={
1372                "attempt": retained["attempt"],
1373                "resource_id": retained["resource_id"],
1374                "provider_completion_claim": False,
1375            },
1376        )
1377        return candidate
1378
1379    def _supersede_retained_salvage(
1380        self,
1381        attempts_dir: Path,
1382        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1383    ) -> None:
1384        """Retires every retained fallback once an attempt genuinely succeeds.
1385
1386        Provider-attested work outranks any fragment, so the fallbacks stop
1387        being options the moment one lands. Leaving them selectable would let a
1388        later resume reach for work that was deliberately superseded.
1389        """
1390        for record, retained in self._iter_attempt_records(attempts_dir):
1391            if retained.get("promotion_status") != SALVAGE_RETAINED:
1392                continue
1393            retained["promotion_status"] = SALVAGE_SUPERSEDED
1394            self._persist_attempt_record(record, attempts_dir)
1395            self._record_event(
1396                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1397                agent_id=retained.get("resource_id", "control_plane"),
1398                action="retained_salvage_superseded",
1399                spec=task_spec,
1400                metadata={"attempt": retained.get("attempt")},
1401            )
1402
1403    def _abandon_salvage_promotion(
1404        self,
1405        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1406        record: Dict[str, Any],
1407        attempts_dir: Path,
1408        reason: str,
1409    ) -> None:
1410        """Retires a fallback that was found but cannot be safely restored.
1411
1412        Marked unusable rather than merely logged: an artifact left eligible
1413        would be re-selected by every subsequent resume, retrying a restore
1414        that has already been proven impossible.
1415        """
1416        retained = record["retained_salvage"]
1417        retained["eligibility"] = SALVAGE_UNUSABLE
1418        retained["abandoned_reason"] = reason
1419        self._persist_attempt_record(record, attempts_dir)
1420        self._record_event(
1421            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1422            agent_id="control_plane",
1423            action="retained_salvage_promotion_failed",
1424            spec=task_spec,
1425            metadata={
1426                "attempt": retained.get("attempt"),
1427                "resource_id": retained.get("resource_id"),
1428                "reason": reason,
1429            },
1430        )
1431
1432    def _promote_retained_salvage(
1433        self,
1434        run_dir: Path,
1435        attempts_dir: Path,
1436        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1437        baseline: GitBaseline,
1438        current_delta: RepositoryDelta,
1439        attempt_record: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
1440    ) -> Optional[Tuple[Dict[str, Any], str, RepositoryDelta]]:
1441        """Recovers the retained fallback once no attempt produced a result.
1442
1443        This is governance of an artifact that already exists, not a new
1444        implementation attempt: no provider is re-invoked, no attempt record is
1445        added, and the bounded failover budget is untouched. Promoting Codex's
1446        retained artifact after attempt 3 failed does not create attempt 4.
1447
1448        Every step fails closed. A fallback that cannot be proven to belong to
1449        this baseline is left as evidence rather than applied, and nothing is
1450        ever partially applied.
1451        """
1452        record = self._select_retained_salvage(attempts_dir)
1453        if record is None:
1454            return None
1455        # `record` is a snapshot read from disk. When the attempt that just
1456        # failed occupies the same evidence slot -- which a resumed run makes
1457        # ordinary, since routing is deterministic -- `attempt_record` is the
1458        # live view of that same file, and writing the snapshot back would
1459        # erase the rollback result recorded below it.
1460        if (
1461            attempt_record is not None
1462            and attempt_record.get("attempt") == record.get("attempt")
1463            and attempt_record.get("resource_id") == record.get("resource_id")
1464        ):
1465            attempt_record["retained_salvage"] = record["retained_salvage"]
1466            record = attempt_record
1467        retained = record["retained_salvage"]
1468        producer = retained["resource_id"]
1469
1470        # The last attempt's state goes back through the sanctioned restore
1471        # path first, so pre-existing user work is put back before anything is
1472        # applied on top of it.
1473        restored_ok, restore_err = restore_repository_to_baseline(
1474            self.target_repo, baseline, current_delta
1475        )
1476        # The attempt that just failed still owes an honest rollback record.
1477        # Its work was undone here rather than in the failover branch, and
1478        # evidence that goes silent about it is what SLOPFIX-06 fixed.
1479        if attempt_record is not None:
1480            self._attach_rollback_result(
1481                attempt_record, attempts_dir, restored_ok, restore_err
1482            )
1483        if not restored_ok:
1484            self._abandon_salvage_promotion(
1485                task_spec, record, attempts_dir, f"baseline restore failed: {restore_err}"
1486            )
1487            return None
1488
1489        head_proc = run_git(self.target_repo, ["rev-parse", "HEAD"], 30)
1490        head = head_proc.stdout.strip() if head_proc.returncode == 0 else ""
1491        if head != retained.get("baseline_head"):
1492            self._abandon_salvage_promotion(
1493                task_spec,
1494                record,
1495                attempts_dir,
1496                f"baseline HEAD mismatch: expected {retained.get('baseline_head')}, "
1497                f"got {head or 'unknown'}",
1498            )
1499            return None
1500
1501        if hashlib.sha256(
1502            baseline.status_porcelain.encode("utf-8")
1503        ).hexdigest() != retained.get("baseline_status_digest"):
1504            self._abandon_salvage_promotion(
1505                task_spec,
1506                record,
1507                attempts_dir,
1508                "baseline state digest does not match the one captured with "
1509                "the artifact",
1510            )
1511            return None
1512
1513        patch_file = run_dir / retained["patch_path"]
1514        if not patch_file.is_file():
1515            self._abandon_salvage_promotion(
1516                task_spec, record, attempts_dir, f"retained patch missing at {retained['patch_path']}"
1517            )
1518            return None
1519        patch_text = patch_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
1520        if hashlib.sha256(patch_text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() != retained.get(
1521            "patch_sha256"
1522        ):
1523            self._abandon_salvage_promotion(
1524                task_spec, record, attempts_dir, "retained patch digest does not match its record"
1525            )
1526            return None
1527
1528        # Never `git apply` blind. Prove it applies, then apply it.
1529        if run_git(
1530            self.target_repo, ["apply", "--check", str(patch_file)], 60
1531        ).returncode != 0:
1532            self._abandon_salvage_promotion(
1533                task_spec, record, attempts_dir, "retained patch no longer applies to the baseline"
1534            )
1535            return None
1536        applied = run_git(self.target_repo, ["apply", str(patch_file)], 60)
1537        if applied.returncode != 0:
1538            restore_repository_to_baseline(self.target_repo, baseline)
1539            self._abandon_salvage_promotion(
1540                task_spec,
1541                record,
1542                attempts_dir,
1543                f"retained patch failed to apply: {(applied.stderr or '').strip()}",
1544            )
1545            return None
1546
1547        self._fault(FAULT_DURING_SALVAGE_PROMOTION, run_dir, task_spec)
1548
1549        promoted_delta = self._capture_scoped_delta(
1550            task_spec, baseline, producer, stage="salvage_promotion"
1551        )
1552        if promoted_delta.is_empty:
1553            restore_repository_to_baseline(self.target_repo, baseline)
1554            self._abandon_salvage_promotion(
1555                task_spec, record, attempts_dir, "restored artifact produced no task-attributable delta"
1556            )
1557            return None
1558
1559        # From here the artifact is an ordinary governed candidate: the same
1560        # capture the existing terminal-timeout path uses, with the same
1561        # provider_completion_claim=false, entering the same review,
1562        # verification and authority stages.
1563        candidate = self._capture_timeout_candidate(
1564            run_dir=run_dir,
1565            attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
1566            attempt_record=record,
1567            task_spec=task_spec,
1568            resource_id=producer,
1569            delta=promoted_delta,
1570        )
1571        retained["promotion_status"] = SALVAGE_PROMOTED
1572        retained["promoted_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
1573        record["transition"] = TRANSITION_CANDIDATE_GOVERNANCE
1574        self._persist_attempt_record(record, attempts_dir)
1575        # The attempt that ended the chain says so on its own record, rather
1576        # than leaving "an earlier fallback was governed instead" recoverable
1577        # only from the ledger.
1578        if attempt_record is not None and attempt_record is not record:
1579            attempt_record["next_selection"] = None
1580            attempt_record["next_selection_reason"] = (
1581                NEXT_SELECTION_SALVAGE_PROMOTED
1582            )
1583            attempt_record["transition"] = TRANSITION_CANDIDATE_GOVERNANCE
1584            self._persist_attempt_record(attempt_record, attempts_dir)
1585        self._record_event(
1586            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1587            agent_id=producer,
1588            action="retained_salvage_promoted",
1589            spec=task_spec,
1590            metadata={
1591                "attempt": retained["attempt"],
1592                "resource_id": producer,
1593                "provider_completion_claim": False,
1594                "insertions": promoted_delta.insertions,
1595                "deletions": promoted_delta.deletions,
1596                "baseline_head": retained["baseline_head"],
1597            },
1598        )
1599        return candidate, producer, promoted_delta
1600
1601    def _build_failover_summary(
1602        self,
1603        implementation_attempts: List[Dict[str, Any]],
1604        termination_reason: str,
1605        last_decision: Any,
1606    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1607        """Explains exhaustion so an operator never has to guess why it stopped."""
1608        remaining: List[str] = []
1609        excluded: Dict[str, str] = {}
1610        if last_decision is not None:
1611            selected = getattr(last_decision, "selected", None)
1612            remaining = [
1613                identity.resource_id
1614                for identity in getattr(last_decision, "eligible_resources", []) or []
1615                if selected is None or identity.resource_id != selected.resource_id
1616            ]
1617            excluded = {
1618                exclusion.resource_id: exclusion.reason
1619                for exclusion in getattr(last_decision, "exclusions", []) or []
1620            }
1621        return {
1622            "attempts_used": len(implementation_attempts),
1623            "attempts_allowed": self.config.max_provider_failover_attempts,
1624            "termination_reason": termination_reason,
1625            "attempted_resources": [
1626                {
1627                    "attempt": attempt.get("attempt"),
1628                    "resource_id": attempt.get("resource_id"),
1629                    "failure_class": attempt.get("failure_class"),
1630                }
1631                for attempt in implementation_attempts
1632            ],
1633            "remaining_eligible": remaining,
1634            "excluded": excluded,
1635            "schema": FAILOVER_SUMMARY_SCHEMA_VERSION,
1636        }
1637
1638    def _is_failover_eligible_failure(self, failure_class: Optional[Any]) -> bool:
1639        """Returns True when the normalized failure class justifies provider failover."""
1640        if failure_class is None:
1641            return False
1642        return failure_class in {
1643            ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
1644            ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT,
1645            ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED,
1646            ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED,
1647            ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
1648            ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE,
1649            ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED,
1650            ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
1651            ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED,
1652            ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_STALLED,
1653        }
1654
1655    def _map_failure_class_to_orchestrator_class(
1656        self,
1657        failure_class: Optional[Any],
1658    ) -> str:
1659        """Maps a provider failure class to the orchestrator's coarse failure class."""
1660        if failure_class is None:
1661            return FAILURE_CLASS_ENGINEERING
1662        value = getattr(failure_class, "value", str(failure_class))
1663        if value in {"QUOTA_EXHAUSTED", "SESSION_LIMIT", "RATE_LIMITED"}:
1664            return FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_EXHAUSTED
1665        if value == "EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED":
1666            return FAILURE_CLASS_EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
1667        if value in {
1668            "AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED",
1669            "PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE",
1670            "TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE",
1671            "MISSING_EXECUTABLE",
1672            "EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED",
1673            "PROVIDER_STALLED",
1674        }:
1675            return FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE
1676        return FAILURE_CLASS_ENGINEERING
1677
1678    def run_deterministic_verification(
1679        self,
1680        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1681        run_dir: Optional[Path] = None,
1682        progress: Optional[Any] = None,
1683        verif_plan: Optional[VerificationPlan] = None,
1684        baseline: Optional[GitBaseline] = None,
1685        delta: Optional[RepositoryDelta] = None,
1686    ) -> str:
1687        """Executes the deterministic verification plan for settled work.
1688
1689        The Stage 6 gate is reachable only by running the whole loop from the
1690        top, which re-invokes providers. A task that escalated to
1691        `awaiting_human` before Stage 6 already has its implementation, its
1692        reviews and its plan on disk; what it never had was the gate. This runs
1693        exactly that gate against the same sanitized view Stage 6 uses, and
1694        persists the same evidence.
1695
1696        Idempotent: a plan whose `overall_status` is already terminal is
1697        returned unchanged rather than re-executed, so a repeated resume cannot
1698        turn a recorded failure into a fresh pass (issues.md #12).
1699
1700        Returns the plan's overall status. Never transitions the task to
1701        `complete` -- that is the caller's policy decision.
1702        """
1703        run_dir = run_dir or (self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id)
1704        if verif_plan is None:
1705            plan_file = run_dir / "verification_plan.json"
1706            if not plan_file.is_file():
1707                raise VerificationPlanMissingError(
1708                    f"Task '{task_spec.task_id}' has no verification_plan.json at "
1709                    f"{plan_file}. Deterministic verification cannot be claimed "
1710                    f"for a plan that does not exist."
1711                )
1712            verif_plan = VerificationPlan.from_dict(safe_load_json(plan_file))
1713            if verif_plan.overall_status in TERMINAL_VERIFICATION_STATUSES:
1714                return verif_plan.overall_status
1715
1716        if baseline is None:
1717            baseline_file = run_dir / "baseline.json"
1718            if baseline_file.is_file():
1719                baseline = GitBaseline.from_dict(safe_load_json(baseline_file))
1720            else:
1721                baseline = capture_baseline(self.target_repo)
1722        if delta is None:
1723            delta = capture_delta(self.target_repo, baseline)
1724
1725        CheckpointManager.start_stage(
1726            run_dir,
1727            task_spec.task_id,
1728            "verifying",
1729            repo_path=self.target_repo,
1730            input_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "diff.patch")],
1731        )
1732        if task_spec.current_state != "verifying":
1733            task_spec.transition_to(
1734                "verifying",
1735                "Human approval authorized the governed workflow to continue; "
1736                "executing the deterministic verification plan that the "
1737                "pre-verification escalation skipped.",
1738            )
1739            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
1740
1741        self._record_event(
1742            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1743            agent_id="control_plane",
1744            action="verification_started",
1745            spec=task_spec,
1746            metadata={
1747                "steps_count": len(verif_plan.steps),
1748                "trigger": "resume_after_pre_verification_escalation",
1749            },
1750        )
1751
1752        verif_status = self._execute_verification_plan(
1753            verif_plan=verif_plan,
1754            task_spec=task_spec,
1755            baseline=baseline,
1756            delta=delta,
1757            run_dir=run_dir,
1758            progress=progress,
1759        )
1760
1761        plan_json = verif_plan.to_json()
1762        (run_dir / "verification_plan.json").write_text(plan_json, encoding="utf-8")
1763        (run_dir / "verification_result.json").write_text(plan_json, encoding="utf-8")
1764
1765        self._record_event(
1766            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1767            agent_id="control_plane",
1768            action="verification_completed",
1769            spec=task_spec,
1770            result=verif_status,
1771            verification_summary={s.name: s.status for s in verif_plan.steps},
1772        )
1773        CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
1774            run_dir,
1775            "verifying",
1776            output_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "verification_result.json")],
1777            result_summary={s.name: s.status for s in verif_plan.steps},
1778        )
1779        return verif_status
1780
1781    def _set_effective_implementer(
1782        self,
1783        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1784        run_dir: Path,
1785        resource_id: Optional[str],
1786    ) -> None:
1787        """Pins the single authoritative effective-implementer identity.
1788
1789        `actual_agent` mirrors it so durable task metadata, the
1790        reviewer-independence records (which read the same resource id) and the
1791        final summary cannot disagree about who produced the governed
1792        candidate. Full attempt history is untouched -- every provider that was
1793        asked still has its own record under implementation/attempts/.
1794
1795        A no-op when implementation produced no resource at all, so a task that
1796        failed before any provider ran does not claim an implementer
1797        (issues.md #16).
1798        """
1799        if not resource_id:
1800            return
1801        task_spec.effective_implementer_resource_id = resource_id
1802        task_spec.actual_agent = resource_id
1803        # The dispatch slot is per-invocation scratch; it must not survive as a
1804        # second, contradictory answer to "who implemented this".
1805        task_spec.dispatch_resource_id = None
1806        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
1807
1808    def _persist_effective_route(
1809        self,
1810        routing: Any,
1811        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1812        attempt_resource_id: str,
1813        route_status: str,
1814        accepted: bool,
1815        candidate_resource: Optional[str] = None,
1816        last_attempted_resource_id: Optional[str] = None,
1817    ) -> None:
1818        """Makes routing evidence on disk match who is actually implementing.
1819
1820        This used to run only after a *successful* failover, so a run that
1821        failed over and then failed left route.json still naming the originally
1822        routed provider, with no effective_route.json at all -- durable evidence
1823        contradicting the run (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05). Routing becomes durable at
1824        every real handoff instead, and distinguishes the resource currently
1825        attempting implementation from one whose work was actually accepted.
1826
1827        initial_route.json is never touched here; it stays the immutable record
1828        of what was routed first.
1829        """
1830        if self.config.provider_pool is None:
1831            return
1832        if "initial_route" not in routing.metadata:
1833            routing.metadata["initial_route"] = {
1834                "selected_agent_id": routing.selected_agent_id,
1835                "selected_agent_name": getattr(
1836                    routing, "selected_agent_name", routing.selected_agent_id
1837                ),
1838                "reviewer_resource_mapping": dict(
1839                    routing.metadata.get("reviewer_resource_mapping", {})
1840                ),
1841                "reviewer_resource_identities": dict(
1842                    routing.metadata.get("reviewer_resource_identities", {})
1843                ),
1844                "review_diversity_achieved": routing.metadata.get(
1845                    "review_diversity_achieved"
1846                ),
1847            }
1848
1849        # Reviewers are recomputed against whoever is implementing now, so no
1850        # mapping can imply a provider reviews its own work. Until a candidate
1851        # is actually accepted the mapping is labelled provisional, because the
1852        # implementer may change again on the next hop.
1853        mapping, diversity = self.config.provider_pool.select_reviewers(
1854            attempt_resource_id,
1855            routing.recommended_reviewers,
1856            task=task_spec,
1857        )
1858        registry = self.config.provider_pool.registry
1859        identities = {
1860            role: registry.get_resource(resource_id).resource_identity().to_dict()
1861            for role, resource_id in mapping.items()
1862            if registry.get_resource(resource_id) is not None
1863        }
1864        routing.metadata["reviewer_resource_mapping"] = mapping
1865        routing.metadata["reviewer_resource_identities"] = identities
1866        routing.metadata["review_diversity_achieved"] = diversity
1867        routing.metadata["reviewer_mapping_status"] = (
1868            "CONFIRMED"
1869            if accepted
1870            else ("CANDIDATE_REVIEW" if candidate_resource else "PROVISIONAL")
1871        )
1872        routing.metadata["route_status"] = route_status
1873        # Promoting a retained fallback credits the resource that produced the
1874        # artifact, but the last resource that actually *ran* is still the one
1875        # the failover chain ended on. Conflating them would rewrite history as
1876        # though the producer had been the final implementation attempt.
1877        routing.metadata["current_attempt_resource"] = (
1878            last_attempted_resource_id or attempt_resource_id
1879        )
1880        routing.metadata["last_attempted_implementation_resource"] = (
1881            last_attempted_resource_id or attempt_resource_id
1882        )
1883        routing.metadata["initial_implementation_resource"] = (
1884            routing.metadata.get("initial_route", {}).get("selected_agent_id")
1885            or routing.selected_agent_id
1886        )
1887        # A candidate is work that exists and is being governed; an accepted
1888        # implementation is work that cleared review, verification and
1889        # authority. Conflating them let SLOPFIX-06's route evidence claim an
1890        # accepted implementer while the task was still under review.
1891        routing.metadata["candidate_resource"] = candidate_resource
1892        routing.metadata["accepted_implementation_resource"] = (
1893            attempt_resource_id if accepted else None
1894        )
1895        routing.metadata["final_implementation_resource"] = (
1896            attempt_resource_id if accepted else None
1897        )
1898        routing.metadata["final_route"] = {
1899            "selected_agent_id": attempt_resource_id,
1900            "accepted": accepted,
1901            "reviewer_resource_mapping": mapping,
1902            "reviewer_resource_identities": identities,
1903            "review_diversity_achieved": diversity,
1904        }
1905        routing.metadata["reassignment_reason"] = (
1906            f"Implementation moved from {routing.selected_agent_id} to "
1907            f"{attempt_resource_id}; reviewers recomputed to keep review "
1908            f"independent of the implementer"
1909        )
1910
1911        # The effective implementer as durable routing evidence, so
1912        # effective_route.json, task.yaml and the summary answer the question
1913        # from one value rather than three (issues.md #16).
1914        routing.metadata["effective_implementer_resource_id"] = attempt_resource_id
1915
1916        run_dir = self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id
1917        if run_dir.exists():
1918            atomic_write_json(run_dir / "route.json", asdict(routing))
1919            effective = asdict(routing)
1920            effective["selected_agent_id"] = attempt_resource_id
1921            # The name has to follow the id. HOWLFRAM-BUG-52's
1922            # effective_route.json read `selected_agent_id: claude_code` beside
1923            # `selected_agent_name: "Antigravity CLI (agy)"` because only the id
1924            # was rewritten here, leaving the originally routed provider's name
1925            # attached to a different resource.
1926            effective_profile = registry.get_resource(attempt_resource_id)
1927            if effective_profile is not None:
1928                effective["selected_agent_name"] = getattr(
1929                    effective_profile, "name", attempt_resource_id
1930                )
1931            else:
1932                effective["selected_agent_name"] = attempt_resource_id
1933            atomic_write_json(run_dir / "effective_route.json", effective)
1934
1935        self._record_event(
1936            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1937            agent_id="control_plane",
1938            action="effective_route_updated",
1939            spec=task_spec,
1940            metadata={
1941                "initial_implementation_resource": routing.selected_agent_id,
1942                "attempt_resource": attempt_resource_id,
1943                "candidate_resource": candidate_resource,
1944                "accepted_implementation_resource": (
1945                    attempt_resource_id if accepted else None
1946                ),
1947                "route_status": route_status,
1948                "reviewer_mapping": mapping,
1949                "diversity_achieved": diversity,
1950            },
1951        )
1952
1953    def _record_event(
1954        self,
1955        task_id: str,
1956        agent_id: str,
1957        action: str,
1958        command: Optional[str] = None,
1959        result: Optional[str] = None,
1960        artifact: Optional[str] = None,
1961        spec: Optional[TaskSpec] = None,
1962        findings_summary: Optional[Dict[str, int]] = None,
1963        verification_summary: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
1964        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
1965    ) -> None:
1966        """Records an immutable event in the append-only evidence ledger."""
1967        if not self.config.record_evidence:
1968            return
1969
1970        meta = metadata or {}
1971        entry = EvidenceEntry(
1972            task_id=task_id,
1973            agent_id=agent_id,
1974            action=action,
1975            command=command,
1976            result=result,
1977            artifact=artifact,
1978            task_class=spec.task_class if spec else None,
1979            risk_level=spec.risk_level if spec else None,
1980            reasoning_tier=spec.recommended_reasoning_tier if spec else None,
1981            actual_agent=agent_id,
1982            repository=self.target_repo.name,
1983            findings_summary=findings_summary,
1984            verification_summary=verification_summary,
1985            metadata=meta,
1986        )
1987        try:
1988            self.ledger.append_entry(entry)
1989        except Exception:
1990            pass
1991
1992    def _write_delta_patch(
1993        self,
1994        delta: RepositoryDelta,
1995        stage_dir: Path,
1996        run_dir: Path,
1997    ) -> None:
1998        """Publishes a captured patch as the stage artifact and the run's current diff."""
1999        (stage_dir / "diff.patch").write_text(delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")
2000        (run_dir / "diff.patch").write_text(delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")
2001
2002    def _record_delta_captured(
2003        self,
2004        task_spec: TaskSpec,
2005        delta: Optional[RepositoryDelta] = None,
2006    ) -> None:
2007        """Records the repository_delta_captured event for a captured delta."""
2008        self._record_event(
2009            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2010            agent_id="control_plane",
2011            action="repository_delta_captured",
2012            spec=task_spec,
2013            metadata=delta.to_event_metadata() if delta is not None else None,
2014        )

2016    def prepare_task_plan(
2017        self,
2018        task_spec: TaskSpec,
2019        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
2020    ) -> Tuple[ProjectContext, RoutingDecision, VerificationPlan, Path, Optional[Any]]:
2021        """Prepares task run directory, project discovery, routing, verification plan, and review briefs."""
2022        run_dir = self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id
2023        run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2024        (run_dir / "reviews").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2025        (run_dir / "remediation").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2026
2027        ctx = ProjectAdapter.discover(self.target_repo)
2028        (run_dir / "project_context.json").write_text(ctx.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
2029
2030        router = TaskRouter(resource_pool=self.config.provider_pool)
2031        routing = router.route(task_spec)
2032        atomic_write_json(run_dir / "route.json", asdict(routing))
2033        atomic_write_json(run_dir / "initial_route.json", asdict(routing))
2034
2035        verif_plan = ProjectAdapter.create_verification_plan(ctx, task_id=task_spec.task_id)
2036        (run_dir / "verification_plan.json").write_text(verif_plan.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
2037
2038        task_spec.recommended_agent = routing.selected_agent_id
2039        task_spec.actual_agent = routing.selected_agent_id
2040        task_spec.is_override = routing.is_override
2041        task_spec.override_reason = routing.rationale if routing.is_override else None
2042        if task_spec.current_state == "discovered":
2043            task_spec.transition_to("planned", "Task routed and verification plan generated")
2044        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
2045        skill_ctx = build_skill_context(task_spec)
2046        for role_id in routing.recommended_reviewers:
2047            role = get_reviewer_role(role_id)
2048            if role:
2049                (run_dir / "reviews" / f"{role_id}.md").write_text(
2050                    role.render_brief(task=task_spec, diff_content="", context=skill_ctx), encoding="utf-8"
2051                )
2052        (run_dir / "findings_template.yaml").write_text("# Review Findings Template\nfindings: []\n", encoding="utf-8")
2053
2054        hf_res = None
2055        if self.config.enable_howlframe_audit:
2056            try:
2057                hf_res = HowlFrameAuditRunner.run_audit(
2058                    context=ctx,
2059                    record_evidence=self.config.record_evidence,
2060                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2061                    ledger=self.ledger,
2062                    dogfood_mode="shadow",
2063                )
2064                (run_dir / "howlframe_audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(hf_res.to_dict(), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
2065            except Exception:
2066                pass
2067
2068        # Check pre-execution human authority boundary and bind HowlChangeOps decision if applicable
2069        pre_b = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate_pre_execution(
2070            task=task_spec,
2071            planned_actions=planned_actions,
2072            target_repo=self.target_repo,
2073        )
2074        self._bind_decision_packet(pre_b, run_dir)
2075        if pre_b.requires_human_approval and pre_b.decision_packet:
2076            (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(pre_b.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
2077
2078        return ctx, routing, verif_plan, run_dir, hf_res
2079
2080    def _bind_decision_packet(self, boundary_res: Any, run_dir: Path) -> None:
2081        """Binds bounded executor decision ID to human decision packet if required."""
2082        if not boundary_res.requires_human_approval or not boundary_res.decision_packet:
2083            return
2084        if not boundary_res.decision_packet.proposed_actions:
2085            return
2086        act_dict = boundary_res.decision_packet.proposed_actions[0]
2087        action_obj = ProposedAction.from_dict(act_dict)
2088        from howlplane.control_plane.executor import ExecutorRegistry
2089        executor = ExecutorRegistry.get_executor_for_action(action_obj.action_type)
2090        if executor and executor.is_available():
2091            verdict, dec_id, _ = executor.evaluate(action_obj, self.target_repo, run_dir)
2092            if dec_id:
2093                boundary_res.decision_packet.changeops_decision_id = dec_id
2094                boundary_res.decision_packet.executor_id = executor.name
2095
2096    def _fault(self, stage: str, run_dir: Path, task_spec: TaskSpec) -> None:
2097        """Fires the configured failure-injection hook for a lifecycle point.
2098
2099        Used to prove the acquisition/cleanup boundary holds: a test raises from
2100        any of these points and asserts no lock file survives.
2101        """
2102        if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
2103            self.config.failure_injection_hook(stage, run_dir, task_spec)
2104
2105    def run(
2106        self,
2107        task_spec: TaskSpec,
2108        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
2109        lock_ownership: Optional[LockOwnership] = None,
2110    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
2111        """
2112        Executes the complete governed control-plane loop for the task under
2113        mutual-exclusion locks and durable checkpoint guarantees.
2114
2115        `lock_ownership` is the task-lock token of an outer lifecycle that
2116        already owns this run -- `ai resume` holds the task lock across the
2117        whole recovery, then hands it here. Without it a resumed run would
2118        deadlock against itself (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06).
2119        """
2120        start_time = time.time()
2121        run_dir = self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id
2122
2123        # Setup Progress Tracker
2124        progress = self.config.progress_tracker
2125        if progress is None:
2126            enabled = (self.config.progress_mode != "never")
2127            stream = (
2128                self.config.progress_stream
2129                if self.config.progress_stream is not None
2130                else sys.stderr
2131            )
2132            progress = TaskProgressTracker(
2133                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2134                run_dir=run_dir,
2135                stream=stream,
2136                heartbeat_interval=self.config.heartbeat_interval,
2137                enabled=enabled,
2138            )
2139
2140        # Every acquisition below is registered for release the moment it
2141        # succeeds. Previously the repo lock was taken before the task lock but
2142        # outside the try/finally, so a task-lock failure stranded
2143        # `.git/howlplane.lock` and no later run could proceed
2144        # (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06). Progress starts only once the locks are held,
2145        # so a resume that cannot acquire never overwrites the durable
2146        # progress record of the run it was trying to recover.
2147        with ExitStack() as stack:
2148            if self.config.acquire_locks:
2149                repo_lock = RepoLock(
2150                    self.target_repo,
2151                    task_spec.task_id,
2152                    command=f"ai work {task_spec.task_id} --execute",
2153                )
2154                repo_lock.acquire()
2155                stack.callback(repo_lock.release)
2156                self._fault("after_repo_lock", run_dir, task_spec)
2157
2158                task_lock = TaskLock(
2159                    self.target_repo, task_spec.task_id, operation="orchestrate"
2160                )
2161                task_lock.acquire(lock_ownership)
2162                stack.callback(task_lock.release)
2163                self._fault("after_task_lock", run_dir, task_spec)
2164
2165            progress.start(
2166                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2167                run_dir=run_dir,
2168                initial_phase=TaskPhase.PREPARING.value,
2169            )
2170            stack.callback(progress.close)
2171            self._fault("after_progress_start", run_dir, task_spec)
2172
2173            try:
2174                result = self._run_governed_loop(
2175                    task_spec, planned_actions, start_time, progress=progress
2176                )
2177                if self.trajectory_store is not None:
2178                    try:
2179                        traj = ExecutionTrajectoryBuilder.from_orchestration_result(result)
2180                        self.trajectory_store.save(traj)
2181                        result.trajectory_id = traj.trajectory_id
2182                    except Exception as exc:
2183                        # Evidence persistence must never fail live engineering work (#B10).
2184                        # Degrade safely (record the conflict, continue) rather than killing the run.
2185                        self._record_event(
2186                            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2187                            agent_id="control_plane",
2188                            action="trajectory_persistence_conflict",
2189                            result=str(exc),
2190                            spec=task_spec,
2191                            metadata={
2192                                "conflict_error": str(exc),
2193                                "trajectory_id": getattr(traj, "trajectory_id", None) if "traj" in locals() else None,
2194                            },
2195                        )
2196                        if getattr(result, "trajectory_id", None) is None and "traj" in locals() and traj is not None:
2197                            result.trajectory_id = traj.trajectory_id
2198                return result
2199            except Exception as exc:
2200                progress.record_terminal(
2201                    TaskProgressState.FAILED,
2202                    TaskPhase.FAILED,
2203                    error_message=str(exc),
2204                )
2205                raise
2206
2207    def _run_governed_loop(
2208        self,
2209        task_spec: TaskSpec,
2210        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
2211        start_time: Optional[float] = None,
2212        progress: Optional[TaskProgressTracker] = None,
2213    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
2214        start_time = start_time or time.time()
2215        if progress is None:
2216            progress = TaskProgressTracker(
2217                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2218                run_dir=None,
2219                enabled=False,
2220            )
2221
2222        progress.transition(
2223            TaskPhase.ROUTING, details="selecting implementation resource"
2224        )
2225        ctx, routing, verif_plan, run_dir, hf_res = self.prepare_task_plan(task_spec, planned_actions)
2226        reviews_dir = run_dir / "reviews"
2227        remediation_base_dir = run_dir / "remediation"
2228        hf_audit_status = hf_res.status if hf_res else None
2229        hf_audit_match = (hf_res.status == "MATCH") if hf_res else True
2230
2231        CheckpointManager.start_stage(
2232            run_dir,
2233            task_spec.task_id,
2234            "planned",
2235            repo_path=self.target_repo,
2236            input_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "route.json"), str(run_dir / "verification_plan.json")],
2237        )
2238
2239        self._record_event(
2240            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2241            agent_id="control_plane",
2242            action="task_created",
2243            spec=task_spec,
2244            metadata={"repo_path": str(self.target_repo), "project_types": ctx.project_types},
2245        )
2246        self._record_event(
2247            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2248            agent_id="control_plane",
2249            action="project_discovered",
2250            spec=task_spec,
2251            metadata={"hygiene_status": ctx.hygiene_status, "has_agents_md": ctx.has_agents_md},
2252        )
2253        self._record_event(
2254            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2255            agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
2256            action="route_selected",
2257            spec=task_spec,
2258            metadata={
2259                "selected_agent": routing.selected_agent_id,
2260                "reviewers": routing.recommended_reviewers,
2261                "is_override": routing.is_override,
2262            },
2263        )
2264        CheckpointManager.complete_stage(run_dir, "planned")
2265
2266        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2267        # Stage 2.5: Pre-Execution Human Authority Gating
2268        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2269        pre_boundary = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate_pre_execution(
2270            task=task_spec,
2271            planned_actions=planned_actions,
2272            target_repo=self.target_repo,
2273        )
2274        self._bind_decision_packet(pre_boundary, run_dir)
2275
2276        if pre_boundary.requires_human_approval:
2277            progress.record_terminal(
2278                TaskProgressState.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
2279                TaskPhase.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
2280            )
2281            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
2282                run_dir,
2283                task_spec.task_id,
2284                "awaiting_human",
2285                repo_path=self.target_repo,
2286                metadata={"boundary_triggers": pre_boundary.triggered_boundaries},
2287            )
2288            task_spec.transition_to(
2289                "awaiting_human",
2290                f"Pre-execution human authority boundary triggered: {pre_boundary.triggered_boundaries}",
2291            )
2292            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
2293
2294            if pre_boundary.decision_packet:
2295                (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(
2296                    pre_boundary.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8"
2297                )
2298
2299            self._record_human_boundary_events(
2300                task_spec, run_dir, boundaries=pre_boundary.triggered_boundaries, reason="Pre-execution boundary triggered"
2301            )
2302
2303            stage_kwargs = dict(
2304                start_time=start_time,
2305                run_dir=run_dir,
2306                routing=routing,
2307                initial_delta=None,
2308                current_delta=None,
2309                review_cycles=[],
2310                reconciliation=None,
2311                verif_plan=verif_plan,
2312                boundary_res=pre_boundary,
2313                hf_status=hf_audit_status,
2314                hf_match=hf_audit_match,
2315                remediation_count=0,
2316            )
2317            return self._make_result(task_spec, "awaiting_human", 2, **stage_kwargs)
2318
2319        if not routing.selected_agent_id:
2320            blocked = routing.metadata.get("blocked_outcome") or {
2321                "status": "BLOCKED",
2322                "reason": FAILURE_CLASS_NO_ELIGIBLE_RESOURCE,
2323            }
2324            progress.record_terminal(
2325                TaskProgressState.FAILED,
2326                TaskPhase.FAILED,
2327                error_message=blocked.get("reason"),
2328            )
2329            task_spec.transition_to("blocked", blocked["reason"])
2330            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
2331            return self._make_result(
2332                task_spec,
2333                "blocked",
2334                3,
2335                start_time=start_time,
2336                run_dir=run_dir,
2337                routing=routing,
2338                verif_plan=verif_plan,
2339                hf_status=hf_audit_status,
2340                hf_match=hf_audit_match,
2341                err_msg=json.dumps(blocked, sort_keys=True),
2342                failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_NO_ELIGIBLE_RESOURCE,
2343            )
2344
2345        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2346        # Stage 3: Baseline Capture / Baseline Recovery
2347        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2348        baseline_file = run_dir / "baseline.json"
2349        if baseline_file.is_file():
2350            try:
2351                baseline = GitBaseline.from_dict(safe_load_json(baseline_file))
2352            except Exception:
2353                baseline = capture_baseline(self.target_repo)
2354                (run_dir / "baseline.json").write_text(baseline.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
2355        else:
2356            baseline = capture_baseline(self.target_repo)
2357            (run_dir / "baseline.json").write_text(baseline.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
2358
2359        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2360        # Stage 4: Implementation (implementing) / Reconcile on Recovery
2361        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2362        has_existing_delta, rec_delta, rec_msg = CrashRecoveryEngine.reconcile_interrupted_implementation(
2363            self.target_repo, run_dir, task_spec
2364        )
2365
2366        impl_dir = run_dir / "implementation"
2367        impl_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2368        attempts_dir = impl_dir / "attempts"
2369        attempts_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2370
2371        # Declared for the whole loop, not just the branch that runs providers:
2372        # a recovered implementation skips the attempt loop entirely, and later
2373        # stages still need to know who (if anyone) is credited with the work.
2374        final_impl_resource_id: Optional[str] = None
2375
2376        # Stays None on the crash-recovery path, where an interrupted
2377        # implementation's delta is reconciled rather than re-run: there is no
2378        # provider execution in *this* process to report (#59.1 Phase 1).
2379        impl_res: Optional[AgentExecutionResult] = None
2380        implementation_attempts: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
2381        # Declared out here because a resumed run can skip the attempt loop
2382        # entirely and still needs to report failover accounting.
2383        last_selection_decision: Optional[Any] = None
2384        # Set only when a budget-stopped attempt left a delta worth governing.
2385        timeout_candidate: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
2386        # Set only when a retained fallback is promoted: the producer becomes
2387        # the candidate, but the failover chain still ended on this resource.
2388        salvage_last_attempted_id: Optional[str] = None
2389
2390        if has_existing_delta and rec_delta:
2391            current_delta = rec_delta
2392            initial_delta = rec_delta
2393            # A resumed run reconciles the delta instead of re-running the
2394            # provider, so who produced it is reconstructed from the durable
2395            # route rather than re-derived. Without this the later stages had
2396            # no implementer to credit and acceptance could never be recorded.
2397            final_impl_resource_id = self._recover_implementation_resource(
2398                run_dir, routing
2399            )
2400            # A parked candidate is the strongest form of recovered work. If
2401            # there is none, the delta in the tree may be a retained fallback
2402            # whose promotion was interrupted -- but only if it actually is
2403            # that artifact, which _recover_promoted_salvage proves before
2404            # crediting its producer.
2405            timeout_candidate = self._load_parked_candidate(run_dir)
2406            if timeout_candidate is None:
2407                timeout_candidate = self._recover_promoted_salvage(
2408                    run_dir, current_delta, task_spec
2409                )
2410                if timeout_candidate is not None:
2411                    final_impl_resource_id = timeout_candidate["resource_id"]
2412                    # The durable route already records which resource the
2413                    # failover chain ended on. Crediting the producer as the
2414                    # candidate must not overwrite that with the producer.
2415                    salvage_last_attempted_id = routing.metadata.get(
2416                        "last_attempted_implementation_resource"
2417                    )
2418            self._record_event(
2419                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2420                agent_id="control_plane",
2421                action="implementation_recovered",
2422                spec=task_spec,
2423                metadata={
2424                    "files_changed": len(current_delta.files_modified) + len(current_delta.files_added),
2425                    "recovered_implementation_resource": final_impl_resource_id,
2426                    "candidate_recovered": timeout_candidate is not None,
2427                },
2428            )
2429            if task_spec.current_state == "planned":
2430                task_spec.transition_to(
2431                    "implementing",
2432                    "Recovered existing implementation delta from interrupted run",
2433                )
2434                task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
2435            impl_chk = CheckpointManager._find_latest_checkpoint_for_stage(run_dir, "implementing")
2436            if impl_chk and impl_chk.status == "in_progress":
2437                CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
2438                    run_dir,
2439                    "implementing",
2440                    result_summary={"recovered": True, "resource_id": final_impl_resource_id},
2441                )
2442        else:
2443            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
2444                run_dir,
2445                task_spec.task_id,
2446                "implementing",
2447                agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
2448                repo_path=self.target_repo,
2449            )
2450
2451            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
2452                self.config.failure_injection_hook("implementing", run_dir, task_spec)
2453
2454            impl_prompt = self._build_implementation_prompt(task_spec, ctx)
2455            current_impl_resource_id = routing.selected_agent_id
2456            attempted_impl_resource_ids: Set[str] = set()
2457
2458            def fail_implementation(
2459                err_msg: str,
2460                failure_class: str,
2461                exit_code: int = 1,
2462                termination_reason: str = TERMINATION_NON_FAILOVER_FAILURE,
2463                rollback: bool = True,
