2464            ) -> OrchestrationResult:
2465                """Terminal-fails the run from inside the implementation attempt loop.
2466
2467                Reads the attempt-scoped locals (delta, provider execution, attempt
2468                records) at call time, so every terminal path reports the state as of
2469                the attempt that failed.
2470
2471                Rollback used to sit at the end of the failover branch, where it
2472                only ever ran to prepare a clean tree for a *next* attempt. A
2473                terminal attempt therefore left its edits behind and its record
2474                carried no rollback key at all, contaminating the next run's
2475                starting state (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05). Undoing it here instead
2476                makes every terminal implementation failure restore the
2477                pre-task baseline, and say so. Evidence is already written by
2478                this point, so the patch survives the restore.
2479                """
2480                # Unconditional, exactly like the inter-attempt rollback: a
2481                # task-attributable delta can be empty while the provider has
2482                # still clobbered a file the operator had already modified,
2483                # which capture_delta deliberately excludes. Only the baseline
2484                # restore knows how to put those back.
2485                if current_impl_resource_id != routing.selected_agent_id:
2486                    self._persist_effective_route(
2487                        routing,
2488                        task_spec,
2489                        current_impl_resource_id,
2490                        ROUTE_STATUS_IMPLEMENTATION_FAILED,
2491                        accepted=False,
2492                    )
2493                if rollback:
2494                    restored_ok, restore_err = restore_repository_to_baseline(
2495                        self.target_repo, baseline, current_delta
2496                    )
2497                    self._attach_rollback_result(
2498                        attempt_record, attempts_dir, restored_ok, restore_err
2499                    )
2500                    if not restored_ok:
2501                        err_msg = (
2502                            f"{err_msg} Repository could not be restored to baseline "
2503                            f"({restore_err}); task-attributable changes remain."
2504                        )
2505                return self._fail_task(
2506                    task_spec,
2507                    run_dir,
2508                    err_msg,
2509                    start_time,
2510                    exit_code=exit_code,
2511                    agent_id="control_plane",
2512                    progress_tracker=progress,
2513                    stage="implementing",
2514                    routing=routing,
2515                    initial_delta=current_delta,
2516                    current_delta=current_delta,
2517                    verif_plan=verif_plan,
2518                    hf_status=hf_audit_status,
2519                    hf_match=hf_audit_match,
2520                    provider_execution=impl_res,
2521                    failure_class=failure_class,
2522                    implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts,
2523                    failover_summary=self._build_failover_summary(
2524                        implementation_attempts,
2525                        termination_reason,
2526                        last_selection_decision,
2527                    ),
2528                )
2529
2530            def govern_candidate() -> Dict[str, Any]:
2531                """Preserves the current attempt's delta as a governed candidate.
2532
2533                Reads the attempt-scoped locals at call time, the same way
2534                fail_implementation does, so both terminal exits salvage
2535                identically.
2536                """
2537                captured = self._capture_timeout_candidate(
2538                    run_dir=run_dir,
2539                    attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
2540                    attempt_record=attempt_record,
2541                    task_spec=task_spec,
2542                    resource_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2543                    delta=current_delta,
2544                )
2545                self._record_delta_captured(task_spec, current_delta)
2546                return captured
2547
2548            def promote_retained_fallback() -> Optional[str]:
2549                """Recovers a retained fallback at a terminal exit.
2550
2551                Reads the attempt-scoped locals at call time, exactly like
2552                fail_implementation and govern_candidate, so all three terminal
2553                exits salvage identically instead of repeating the sequence.
2554                Returns the producing resource, or None to fail as before.
2555                """
2556                nonlocal timeout_candidate, current_delta
2557                promoted = self._promote_retained_salvage(
2558                    run_dir=run_dir,
2559                    attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
2560                    task_spec=task_spec,
2561                    baseline=baseline,
2562                    current_delta=current_delta,
2563                    attempt_record=attempt_record,
2564                )
2565                if promoted is None:
2566                    return None
2567                timeout_candidate, producer, current_delta = promoted
2568                self._record_delta_captured(task_spec, current_delta)
2569                return producer
2570
2571            for attempt_num in range(1, self.config.max_provider_failover_attempts + 1):
2572                impl_res = None
2573                normalized_failure = None
2574
2575                impl_backend = self._resolve_backend(current_impl_resource_id)
2576
2577                if not impl_backend.is_available():
2578                    impl_res = AgentExecutionResult(
2579                        agent_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2580                        role="implementation",
2581                        command=f"backend:{current_impl_resource_id}",
2582                        exit_code=127,
2583                        stdout="",
2584                        stderr=f"Agent binary '{current_impl_resource_id}' is not installed or available on PATH.",
2585                        duration_seconds=0.0,
2586                        success=False,
2587                        error_message=f"Agent '{current_impl_resource_id}' unavailable",
2588                    )
2589                else:
2590                    if task_spec.current_state != "implementing":
2591                        task_spec.transition_to(
2592                            "implementing",
2593                            f"Launching implementation attempt {attempt_num}: {current_impl_resource_id}",
2594                        )
2595                        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
2596
2597                    task_spec.actual_agent = current_impl_resource_id
2598                    task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
2599
2600                    self._record_event(
2601                        task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2602                        agent_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2603                        action="implementation_started",
2604                        spec=task_spec,
2605                        metadata={"attempt": attempt_num},
2606                    )
2607
2608                    attempt_scratch = self._provider_scratch_dir(
2609                        run_dir, attempt_num, current_impl_resource_id
2610                    )
2611                    attempt_scratch.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2612                    self._record_scratch_manifest(
2613                        run_dir,
2614                        task_spec.task_id,
2615                        attempt_num,
2616                        current_impl_resource_id,
2617                        attempt_scratch,
2618                        status="active",
2619                    )
2620                    evidence_root_before = {
2621                        entry.name for entry in run_dir.iterdir()
2622                    }
2623                    attempts_before = {
2624                        entry.name for entry in attempts_dir.iterdir()
2625                    } if attempts_dir.is_dir() else set()
2626
2627                    impl_agent_id = getattr(impl_backend, "agent_id", None) or current_impl_resource_id
2628                    # capture_delta already owns the task baseline and control
2629                    # plane exclusions. Reusing it keeps watchdog progress from
2630                    # treating journals, scratch, locks, or .task_runs as work.
2631                    def repository_fingerprint() -> str:
2632                        delta = capture_delta(self.target_repo, baseline)
2633                        return hashlib.sha256(delta.diff_content.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
2634
2635                    observe_provider = ProviderStreamObserver(
2636                        impl_agent_id,
2637                        self.config.provider_stall_timeout_seconds,
2638                        repository_fingerprint,
2639                    )
2640
2641                    with progress.operation(
2642                        phase=TaskPhase.IMPLEMENTING,
2643                        resource_id=impl_agent_id,
2644                        role="implementation",
2645                        details="started",
2646                        suppress_completion=True,
2647                        deadline_seconds=self.config.timeout_seconds,
2648                    ):
2649                        execute_kwargs: Dict[str, Any] = {
2650                            "task": task_spec,
2651                            "cwd": self.target_repo,
2652                            "role": "implementation",
2653                            "prompt_override": impl_prompt,
2654                            "timeout_seconds": self.config.timeout_seconds,
2655                        }
2656                        # Third-party/test adapters predate streamed execution.
2657                        # Preserve their bounded legacy contract; built-in CLI
2658                        # adapters opt into observation via **kwargs.
2659                        parameters = inspect.signature(impl_backend.execute).parameters
2660                        supports_kwargs = any(
2661                            parameter.kind == inspect.Parameter.VAR_KEYWORD
2662                            for parameter in parameters.values()
2663                        )
2664                        if supports_kwargs or "watchdog_callback" in parameters:
2665                            execute_kwargs.update({
2666                                "watchdog_callback": observe_provider,
2667                                "watchdog_interval_seconds": self.config.provider_watchdog_interval_seconds,
2668                            })
2669                        impl_res = impl_backend.execute(
2670                            **execute_kwargs,
2671                        )
2672
2673                # Relocate provider scratch before any evidence for this
2674                # attempt is written, so control-plane artifacts can never be
2675                # mistaken for files the provider left behind.
2676                if impl_backend.is_available():
2677                    swept = self._sweep_provider_scratch(
2678                        run_dir=run_dir,
2679                        resource_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2680                        attempt_num=attempt_num,
2681                        known_before=evidence_root_before,
2682                        attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
2683                        attempts_before=attempts_before,
2684                        owned_attempt_name=(
2685                            f"{attempt_num:02d}-{current_impl_resource_id}"
2686                        ),
2687                    )
2688                    if swept:
2689                        self._record_event(
2690                            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2691                            agent_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2692                            action="provider_scratch_relocated",
2693                            spec=task_spec,
2694                            metadata={"attempt": attempt_num, "files": swept},
2695                        )
2696
2697                # Snapshot capacity before record_result mutates it, so the
2698                # recorded "before" is genuinely the pre-attempt state.
2699                capacity_before: Dict[str, str] = (
2700                    self.config.provider_pool.get_all_statuses()
2701                    if self.config.provider_pool is not None else {}
2702                )
2703
2704                if self.config.provider_pool is not None and impl_res is not None:
2705                    normalized_failure = self.config.provider_pool.record_result(
2706                        current_impl_resource_id,
2707                        impl_res,
2708                        task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2709                    )
2710
2711                current_delta = self._capture_scoped_delta(
2712                    task_spec, baseline, current_impl_resource_id, stage="implementation"
2713                )
2714
2715                denial_outcome = (
2716                    (impl_res.metadata or {}).get(TOOL_PERMISSION_KEY)
2717                    if impl_res is not None else None
2718                )
2719                if (
2720                    impl_res is not None
2721                    and impl_res.success
2722                    and denial_outcome == TOOL_PERMISSION_DENIED
2723                    and current_delta.is_empty
2724                ):
2725                    impl_res.success = False
2726                    if not impl_res.error_message:
2727                        impl_res.error_message = (
2728                            "Required tool permissions were unavailable and zero delta produced"
2729                        )
2730                    if self.config.provider_pool is not None:
2731                        normalized_failure = ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED
2732
2733                attempt_record = self._record_implementation_attempt(
2734                    run_dir=run_dir,
2735                    attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
2736                    attempt_num=attempt_num,
2737                    resource_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2738                    impl_res=impl_res,
2739                    delta=current_delta,
2740                    failure_class=normalized_failure.value if normalized_failure else None,
2741                    capacity_before=capacity_before,
2742                )
2743                implementation_attempts.append(attempt_record)
2744
2745                if impl_res is not None and impl_res.success:
2746                    final_impl_resource_id = current_impl_resource_id
2747                    (impl_dir / "result.json").write_text(impl_res.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
2748                    self._write_delta_patch(current_delta, impl_dir, run_dir)
2749                    self._record_event(
2750                        task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2751                        agent_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2752                        action="implementation_completed",
2753                        result="success",
2754                        spec=task_spec,
2755                        metadata={
2756                            "files_changed": len(current_delta.files_modified) + len(current_delta.files_added),
2757                            "attempt": attempt_num,
2758                        },
2759                    )
2760                    self._record_delta_captured(task_spec, current_delta)
2761                    self._supersede_retained_salvage(attempts_dir, task_spec)
2762                    break
2763
2764                # Failed attempt: determine whether to failover or terminal-fail.
2765                err_msg = (
2766                    impl_res.stderr.strip()
2767                    if impl_res and impl_res.stderr and impl_res.stderr.strip()
2768                    else (impl_res.error_message if impl_res else f"Implementation failed on {current_impl_resource_id}")
2769                )
2770                failure_class_value = normalized_failure.value if normalized_failure else None
2771                if normalized_failure in {
2772                    ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT,
2773                    ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
2774                    ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED,
2775                    ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED,
2776                    ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
2777                    ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_STALLED,
2778                }:
2779                    detail = failure_class_value.lower() if failure_class_value else "provider failure"
2780                    progress.emit_provider_unusable(
2781                        current_impl_resource_id,
2782                        detail,
2783                        impl_res.duration_seconds if impl_res else 0.0,
2784                        diagnostics=(impl_res.metadata or {}).get("watchdog_diagnostics") if impl_res else None,
2785                    )
2786
2787                progress.emit_implementation_failed(
2788                    current_impl_resource_id,
2789                    reason=failure_class_value or err_msg,
2790                )
2791
2792                # This resource is spent for this task from here on, whatever
2793                # happens next. Recording it before selection is what stops a
2794                # resource whose cooldown elapsed mid-attempt from being offered
2795                # back and dead-ending the loop (SLOPFIX-03).
2796                attempted_impl_resource_ids.add(current_impl_resource_id)
2797
2798                if not self._is_failover_eligible_failure(normalized_failure):
2799                    # EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED is failover-eligible, so this
2800                    # attempt is never itself salvageable -- but an earlier one
2801                    # may be, and a provider erroring outright is still a
2802                    # termination without a successful implementation.
2803                    fallback_producer = promote_retained_fallback()
2804                    if fallback_producer is not None:
2805                        salvage_last_attempted_id = current_impl_resource_id
2806                        final_impl_resource_id = fallback_producer
2807                        break
2808                    return fail_implementation(
2809                        err_msg,
2810                        self._map_failure_class_to_orchestrator_class(normalized_failure),
2811                        exit_code=impl_res.exit_code if impl_res and impl_res.exit_code != 0 else 1,
2812                        termination_reason=TERMINATION_NON_FAILOVER_FAILURE,
2813                    )
2814
2815                # While failover budget remains, a fresh provider may yet
2816                # produce a complete, provider-attested result, and that is
2817                # strictly better than governing a fragment -- so the current
2818                # attempt's work is still rolled back before the next one runs.
2819                # It is not discarded, though: SLOPFIX-07R rolled back Codex's
2820                # eligible artifact and then forgot it existed, because salvage
2821                # was only ever evaluated for whichever attempt happened to be
2822                # last. Retention keeps it recoverable without ever letting it
2823                # contaminate a later attempt.
2824                salvageable = self._is_salvageable_timeout_candidate(
2825                    normalized_failure, current_delta
2826                )
2827                exhausted = attempt_num >= self.config.max_provider_failover_attempts
2828
2829                if exhausted and salvageable:
2830                    timeout_candidate = govern_candidate()
2831                    # State a terminal attempt reaches by exhausting the budget
2832                    # is still state: record it rather than letting the absence
2833                    # of `rollback`/`next_selection` imply it (SLOPFIX-06's
2834                    # attempt 3 was silent about all of it).
2835                    self._attach_terminal_disposition(
2836                        attempt_record,
2837                        attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
2838                        attempt_num=attempt_num,
2839                        attempted=attempted_impl_resource_ids,
2840                        task_spec=task_spec,
2841                    )
2842                    final_impl_resource_id = current_impl_resource_id
2843                    break
2844
2845                if exhausted:
2846                    # This is the SLOPFIX-07R path: the last attempt produced
2847                    # nothing, but an earlier productive timeout may have.
2848                    fallback_producer = promote_retained_fallback()
2849                    if fallback_producer is not None:
2850                        salvage_last_attempted_id = current_impl_resource_id
2851                        final_impl_resource_id = fallback_producer
2852                        break
2853                    err_msg = (
2854                        f"Implementation failed on {current_impl_resource_id} ({failure_class_value}); "
2855                        f"max failover attempts ({self.config.max_provider_failover_attempts}) reached."
2856                    )
2857                    return fail_implementation(
2858                        err_msg,
2859                        FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_EXHAUSTED,
2860                        termination_reason=TERMINATION_MAX_ATTEMPTS_REACHED,
2861                    )
2862
2863                # Select next eligible implementation resource. Everything already
2864                # attempted is a hard exclusion, not merely a demotion.
2865                next_resource_id = None
2866                if self.config.provider_pool is not None:
2867                    next_decision = self.config.provider_pool.select_resource(
2868                        task_spec,
2869                        role="implementation",
2870                        avoid_resource_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2871                        exclude_resource_ids=attempted_impl_resource_ids,
2872                    )
2873                    last_selection_decision = next_decision
2874                    self._attach_next_selection(attempt_record, attempts_dir, next_decision)
2875                    if next_decision.selected:
2876                        next_resource_id = next_decision.selected.resource_id
2877
2878                if (
2879                    not next_resource_id
2880                    or next_resource_id == current_impl_resource_id
2881                    or next_resource_id in attempted_impl_resource_ids
2882                ):
2883                    if salvageable:
2884                        timeout_candidate = govern_candidate()
2885                        final_impl_resource_id = current_impl_resource_id
2886                        break
2887
2888                    fallback_producer = promote_retained_fallback()
2889                    if fallback_producer is not None:
2890                        salvage_last_attempted_id = current_impl_resource_id
2891                        final_impl_resource_id = fallback_producer
2892                        break
2893
2894                    err_msg = f"Implementation failed on {current_impl_resource_id} ({failure_class_value}) and no eligible failover resource remains."
2895                    return fail_implementation(
2896                        err_msg,
2897                        FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_EXHAUSTED,
2898                        termination_reason=TERMINATION_NO_ELIGIBLE_RESOURCE,
2899                    )
2900
2901                # Preserve before destroying. Retention is recorded first so
2902                # an interruption between here and the rollback can only ever
2903                # leave a fallback that is known about, never one that was
2904                # silently dropped.
2905                if salvageable:
2906                    self._retain_salvage_artifact(
2907                        attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
2908                        attempt_record=attempt_record,
2909                        task_spec=task_spec,
2910                        resource_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2911                        delta=current_delta,
2912                        baseline=baseline,
2913                    )
2914
2915                # Restore repository to baseline before the next attempt.
2916                restored_ok, restore_err = restore_repository_to_baseline(
2917                    self.target_repo, baseline, current_delta
2918                )
2919                self._attach_rollback_result(
2920                    attempt_record, attempts_dir, restored_ok, restore_err
2921                )
2922                if not restored_ok:
2923                    err_msg = f"Implementation failover aborted: cannot safely restore baseline ({restore_err})."
2924                    return fail_implementation(
2925                        err_msg,
2926                        FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
2927                        termination_reason=TERMINATION_ROLLBACK_FAILED,
2928                        rollback=False,
2929                    )
2930
2931                # "Salvage preserved" and "rollback restored" are both true
2932                # here, and the evidence says both. The patch lives in the
2933                # attempt's evidence; the working tree is clean for the next
2934                # attempt. Replayability is proven against that clean tree,
2935                # because that is what a promotion would replay onto.
2936                if salvageable:
2937                    self._confirm_salvage_replayable(
2938                        run_dir, attempts_dir, attempt_record, task_spec
2939                    )
2940                    self._fault(FAULT_AFTER_SALVAGE_RETENTION, run_dir, task_spec)
2941
2942                progress.emit_failover(
2943                    current_impl_resource_id,
2944                    next_resource_id,
2945                    failure_class=failure_class_value,
2946                )
2947                self._record_event(
2948                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2949                    agent_id="control_plane",
2950                    action="implementation_failover",
2951                    spec=task_spec,
2952                    metadata={
2953                        "attempt": attempt_num,
2954                        "source_resource": current_impl_resource_id,
2955                        "target_resource": next_resource_id,
2956                        "failure_class": failure_class_value,
2957                    },
2958                )
2959
2960                current_impl_resource_id = next_resource_id
2961                self._persist_effective_route(
2962                    routing,
2963                    task_spec,
2964                    current_impl_resource_id,
2965                    ROUTE_STATUS_SUPERSEDED,
2966                    accepted=False,
2967                )
2968
2969            if timeout_candidate is None and (impl_res is None or not impl_res.success):
2970                err_msg = (
2971                    f"Implementation exhausted all {self.config.max_provider_failover_attempts} "
2972                    "attempted provider(s) without success."
2973                )
2974                return self._fail_task(
2975                    task_spec,
2976                    run_dir,
2977                    err_msg,
2978                    start_time,
2979                    exit_code=1,
2980                    agent_id="control_plane",
2981                    progress_tracker=progress,
2982                    stage="implementing",
2983                    routing=routing,
2984                    current_delta=current_delta if "current_delta" in locals() else None,
2985                    verif_plan=verif_plan,
2986                    hf_status=hf_audit_status,
2987                    hf_match=hf_audit_match,
2988                    provider_execution=impl_res,
2989                    failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_PROVIDER_EXHAUSTED,
2990                    implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts,
2991                    failover_summary=self._build_failover_summary(
2992                        implementation_attempts,
2993                        TERMINATION_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED,
2994                        last_selection_decision,
2995                    ),
2996                )
2997
2998            initial_delta = current_delta
2999            CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
3000                run_dir,
3001                "implementing",
3002                output_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "diff.patch")],
3003            )
3004
3005        # Implementation has settled -- by success, by promotion of a retained
3006        # candidate, or by recovery on resume. This is the one place the
3007        # effective implementer becomes durable, and it runs before the
3008        # authority gate, so a task that escalates before Stage 6 still records
3009        # who produced the candidate. HOWLFRAM-BUG-52 escalated here and left
3010        # `final_implementation_resource: null` with task.yaml naming a
3011        # reviewer (issues.md #16).
3012        self._set_effective_implementer(task_spec, run_dir, final_impl_resource_id)
3013
3014        # Whether the work came from this run's attempt loop or was recovered on
3015        # resume, reviewer independence is settled here. If the final
3016        # implementation resource differs from the initially
3017        # routed one, recompute reviewer assignments so independence claims
3018        # are truthful (#59.2 Phase 9).
3019        if (
3020            final_impl_resource_id is not None
3021            and self.config.provider_pool is not None
3022            and (
3023                final_impl_resource_id != routing.selected_agent_id
3024                # A promoted producer can coincide with the originally
3025                # routed resource, and reviewers must still be recomputed
3026                # against it before it can be reviewed.
3027                or salvage_last_attempted_id is not None
3028            )
3029        ):
3030            # Implementation being finished is not the same as the work
3031            # being accepted: review, reconciliation, verification and the
3032            # authority gate all still lie ahead. The route records who
3033            # produced the candidate and stays provisional until Stage 8
3034            # (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06).
3035            self._persist_effective_route(
3036                routing,
3037                task_spec,
3038                final_impl_resource_id,
3039                ROUTE_STATUS_SUPERSEDED,
3040                accepted=False,
3041                candidate_resource=final_impl_resource_id,
3042                last_attempted_resource_id=salvage_last_attempted_id,
3043            )
3044
3045        # A salvaged candidate carries no completion claim from its
3046        # producer, so independent review is the only thing standing behind
3047        # it. When no independent reviewer is available the pool falls back
3048        # to the implementer reviewing its own work, which for this kind of
3049        # candidate is no review at all. Park it for a human rather than
3050        # completing on a self-review (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05).
3051        if timeout_candidate is not None and not routing.metadata.get(
3052            "review_diversity_achieved", True
3053        ):
3054            err_msg = (
3055                "Timed-out implementation candidate cannot be independently "
3056                f"reviewed: no reviewer is available other than "
3057                f"{final_impl_resource_id}, which produced it."
3058            )
3059            decision_pkt = HumanDecisionPacket(
3060                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3061                objective=task_spec.objective,
3062                change_summary=(
3063                    f"Candidate ({current_delta.insertions} ins, "
3064                    f"{current_delta.deletions} del) was left by "
3065                    f"{final_impl_resource_id} after this control plane "
3066                    "stopped it at its execution budget. The provider never "
3067                    "reported completion."
3068                ),
3069                boundary_triggers=["reviewer_independence_unavailable"],
3070                evidence=[
3071                    f"origin={CANDIDATE_ORIGIN_TIMED_OUT}",
3072                    "provider_completion_claim=false",
3073                ],
3074                risks=[
3075                    "No independent reviewer is available, so the candidate "
3076                    "has nothing standing behind it.",
3077                ],
3078                review_findings_summary={
3079                    "blocker": 0, "high": 0, "medium": 0, "low": 0,
3080                },
3081                verification_status="unverified",
3082                recommended_action=(
3083                    "Inspect implementation/attempts/*/candidate.patch and "
3084                    "either authorize it explicitly or discard it."
3085                ),
3086            )
3087            self._park_awaiting_human(
3088                task_spec, run_dir, err_msg, decision_pkt, progress
3089            )
3090            return self._make_result(
3091                task_spec=task_spec,
3092                final_state="awaiting_human",
3093                exit_code=2,
3094                start_time=start_time,
3095                run_dir=run_dir,
3096                routing=routing,
3097                initial_delta=initial_delta,
3098                current_delta=current_delta,
3099                verif_plan=verif_plan,
3100                hf_status=hf_audit_status,
3101                hf_match=hf_audit_match,
3102                provider_execution=impl_res,
3103                implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts,
3104                timeout_candidate=timeout_candidate,
3105            )
3106
3107            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
3108                self.config.failure_injection_hook("post_implementation", run_dir, task_spec)
3109
3110        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3111        # Stage 5: Independent Adversarial Reviews & Remediation Loop
3112        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3113        if task_spec.current_state != "reviewing":
3114            task_spec.transition_to("reviewing", "Initiating independent reviewer analysis on actual implementation diff")
3115            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
3116
3117        review_cycles: List[ReviewCycleResult] = []
3118        latest_reconciliation: Optional[ReconciliationResult] = None
3119        remediation_count = 0
3120        current_reviewers = list(routing.recommended_reviewers)
3121
3122        def _make_parked_review_exit(park_msg: str) -> OrchestrationResult:
3123            return self._make_result(
3124                task_spec=task_spec,
3125                final_state="awaiting_human",
3126                exit_code=2,
3127                start_time=start_time,
3128                run_dir=run_dir,
3129                routing=routing,
3130                initial_delta=initial_delta,
3131                current_delta=current_delta,
3132                review_cycles=review_cycles,
3133                reconciliation=latest_reconciliation,
3134                verif_plan=verif_plan,
3135                remediation_count=remediation_count,
3136                err_msg=park_msg,
3137                provider_execution=impl_res,
3138                failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED,
3139                hf_status=hf_audit_status,
3140                hf_match=hf_audit_match,
3141                implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts,
3142                failover_summary=self._build_failover_summary(
3143                    implementation_attempts,
3144                    TERMINATION_IMPLEMENTATION_SUCCEEDED,
3145                    last_selection_decision,
3146                ),
3147            )
3148
3149        while True:
3150            cycle_idx = len(review_cycles) + 1
3151            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
3152                run_dir,
3153                task_spec.task_id,
3154                "reviewing",
3155                repo_path=self.target_repo,
3156                metadata={"cycle": cycle_idx, "reviewers": current_reviewers},
3157            )
3158
3159            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
3160                self.config.failure_injection_hook("reviewing", run_dir, task_spec)
3161
3162            self._record_event(
3163                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3164                agent_id="control_plane",
3165                action="review_started",
3166                spec=task_spec,
3167                metadata={"cycle": cycle_idx, "reviewers": current_reviewers},
3168            )
3169
3170            cycle_res = ReviewRunner.execute_review_cycle(
3171                task=task_spec,
3172                diff_content=current_delta.diff_content,
3173                reviewer_roles=current_reviewers,
3174                cwd=self.target_repo,
3175                backend=self.config.custom_backend,
3176                cycle_index=cycle_idx,
3177                reviewer_agent_mapping=(
3178                    self.config.reviewer_agent_mapping
3179                    or routing.metadata.get("reviewer_resource_mapping")
3180                ),
3181                custom_reviewer_fn=self.config.custom_reviewer_fn,
3182                run_dir=run_dir,
3183                provider_pool=self.config.provider_pool,
3184                progress_tracker=progress,
3185                implementer_resource_id=final_impl_resource_id,
3186            )
3187            review_cycles.append(cycle_res)
3188            latest_reconciliation = cycle_res.reconciliation
3189
3190            # Save review cycle artifacts
3191            cycle_dir = reviews_dir if cycle_idx == 1 else (remediation_base_dir / f"cycle-{remediation_count:02d}" / "re_review")
3192            cycle_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
3193            for role_id, single_rev in cycle_res.reviewer_results.items():
3194                (cycle_dir / f"{role_id}.md").write_text(single_rev.raw_output, encoding="utf-8")
3195                (cycle_dir / f"{role_id}_findings.yaml").write_text(
3196                    yaml.dump([f.to_dict() for f in single_rev.findings], sort_keys=False),
3197                    encoding="utf-8",
3198                )
3199
3200            # Persist findings and reconciliation
3201            findings_data = {"findings": [f.to_dict() for f in cycle_res.all_findings]}
3202            (run_dir / "findings.yaml").write_text(yaml.dump(findings_data, sort_keys=False), encoding="utf-8")
3203            # Written unconditionally. A cycle with no findings leaves
3204            # cycle_res.reconciliation as None, and skipping the write used to
3205            # leave the *previous* cycle's report on disk -- so the decision
3206            # packet pointed operators at a finding that had already been
3207            # remediated (HOWLFRAM-BUG-50). An empty cycle now says it is empty.
3208            if cycle_res.reconciliation:
3209                (run_dir / "reconciliation.json").write_text(json.dumps(cycle_res.reconciliation.to_dict(), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
3210                (run_dir / "reconciliation_report.md").write_text(cycle_res.reconciliation.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
3211            else:
3212                (run_dir / "reconciliation.json").write_text(
3213                    json.dumps(
3214                        {
3215                            "summary": {"total_findings": 0, "unresolved_blockers": 0, "unresolved_highs": 0},
3216                            "findings": [],
3217                            "cycle_index": cycle_res.cycle_index,
3218                            "status": cycle_res.status,
3219                        },
3220                        indent=2,
3221                    ),
3222                    encoding="utf-8",
3223                )
3224                (run_dir / "reconciliation_report.md").write_text(
3225                    "# Review Reconciliation Report\n\n"
3226                    f"Cycle {cycle_res.cycle_index} produced no reviewer findings to reconcile "
3227                    f"(cycle status: `{cycle_res.status}`).\n",
3228                    encoding="utf-8",
3229                )
3230
3231            findings_summary = {
3232                "total": len(cycle_res.all_findings),
3233                "blocker": cycle_res.reconciliation.unresolved_blockers if cycle_res.reconciliation else 0,
3234                "high": cycle_res.reconciliation.unresolved_highs if cycle_res.reconciliation else 0,
3235            }
3236            self._record_event(
3237                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3238                agent_id="control_plane",
3239                action="review_completed",
3240                spec=task_spec,
3241                findings_summary=findings_summary,
3242                metadata={"status": cycle_res.status, "cycle": cycle_idx},
3243            )
3244            CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
3245                run_dir,
3246                "reviewing",
3247                output_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "reconciliation.json")],
3248                result_summary=findings_summary,
3249            )
3250
3251            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
3252                self.config.failure_injection_hook("post_review", run_dir, task_spec)
3253
3254            # Check if independent review was satisfied
3255            if (
3256                self.config.preserve_independent_review
3257                and not self.config.custom_reviewer_fn
3258                and not getattr(cycle_res, "independent_review_satisfied", True)
3259            ):
3260                triggers: List[str] = ["independent_review_unavailable"]
3261                if cycle_res.non_independent_roles:
3262                    triggers.append("non_independent_review")
3263                risks: List[str] = ["No independent provider family was available to complete code review."]
3264                evidence: List[str] = [
3265                    f"{role}: reviewed by non-independent provider family ({getattr(cycle_res, 'reviewing_provider_families', {}).get(role, 'unknown')})"
3266                    for role in cycle_res.non_independent_roles
3267                ] or ["Independent review could not be satisfied by any configured provider."]
3268                err_msg = "Independent review unavailable: no independent provider family completed review"
3269                decision_pkt = HumanDecisionPacket(
3270                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3271                    objective=task_spec.objective,
3272                    change_summary=(
3273                        f"Implementation diff ({current_delta.insertions} ins, {current_delta.deletions} del) "
3274                        f"lacks independent review; triggers: {', '.join(triggers)}."
3275                    ),
3276                    boundary_triggers=triggers,
3277                    evidence=evidence,
3278                    risks=risks,
3279                    review_findings_summary=findings_summary,
3280                    verification_status="unverified",
3281                    recommended_action="Authorize manual review or configure an independent provider family.",
3282                )
3283                self._park_awaiting_human(
3284                    task_spec,
3285                    run_dir,
3286                    err_msg,
3287                    decision_pkt,
3288                    progress,
3289                )
3290                return _make_parked_review_exit(err_msg)
3291
3292            # Check if any findings require remediation
3293            if not cycle_res.requires_remediation:
3294                break
3295
3296            # If remediation required, check cycle bounds
3297            if remediation_count >= self.config.max_remediation_cycles:
3298                err_msg = (
3299                    f"Remediation limit reached ({self.config.max_remediation_cycles} cycles) with "
3300                    f"{findings_summary['blocker']} blockers and {findings_summary['high']} high findings remaining."
3301                )
3302                # Name the cause that actually stopped the loop. Reporting every
3303                # escalation as "unresolved findings" told operators a change had
3304                # defects when the real problem was that a reviewer never ran, or
3305                # that the implementer reviewed its own diff -- three different
3306                # situations calling for three different human judgments
3307                # (HOWLFRAM-BUG-50).
3308                triggers: List[str] = []
3309                risks: List[str] = []
3310                evidence = [f.title for f in cycle_res.all_findings if f.severity in ("blocker", "high")]
3311                if findings_summary["high"] > 0 or findings_summary["blocker"] > 0:
3312                    triggers.append("security_policy_exception")
3313                    risks.append("Unresolved reviewer findings may indicate defects or security vulnerabilities.")
3314                if cycle_res.non_independent_roles:
3315                    triggers.append("non_independent_review")
3316                    risks.append(
3317                        "The implementer reviewed its own change for "
3318                        f"{', '.join(cycle_res.non_independent_roles)}; those roles are not independent review."
3319                    )
3320                    evidence.extend(
3321                        f"{role}: reviewed by the implementer ({final_impl_resource_id or 'unknown'})"
3322                        for role in cycle_res.non_independent_roles
3323                    )
3324                if cycle_res.status == "review_failure":
3325                    triggers.append("review_incomplete")
3326                    risks.append("At least one reviewer never completed, so this change is under-reviewed.")
3327                    evidence.extend(
3328                        f"{role}: {res.status}"
3329                        for role, res in sorted(cycle_res.reviewer_results.items())
3330                        if res.status == "reviewer_failure"
3331                    )
3332                if not triggers:
3333                    triggers.append("unresolved_findings")
3334                    risks.append("Unresolved reviewer findings may indicate defects or security vulnerabilities.")
3335
3336                decision_pkt = HumanDecisionPacket(
3337                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3338                    objective=task_spec.objective,
3339                    change_summary=(
3340                        f"Implementation diff ({current_delta.insertions} ins, {current_delta.deletions} del) "
3341                        f"reached the remediation limit; triggers: {', '.join(triggers)}."
3342                    ),
3343                    boundary_triggers=triggers,
3344                    evidence=evidence,
3345                    risks=risks,
3346                    review_findings_summary=findings_summary,
3347                    verification_status="unverified",
3348                    recommended_action="Review finding report in reconciliation_report.md and authorize override or manual remediation.",
3349                )
3350                self._park_awaiting_human(
3351                    task_spec,
3352                    run_dir,
3353                    f"Max remediation cycles exceeded: {err_msg}",
3354                    decision_pkt,
3355                    progress,
3356                )
3357                return _make_parked_review_exit(err_msg)
3358
3359            remediation_count += 1
3360            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
3361                run_dir,
3362                task_spec.task_id,
3363                "remediating",
3364                repo_path=self.target_repo,
3365                metadata={"cycle": remediation_count},
3366            )
3367
3368            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
3369                self.config.failure_injection_hook("remediating", run_dir, task_spec)
3370
3371            task_spec.transition_to(
3372                "remediating",
3373                f"Remediation cycle {remediation_count}: resolving {len(cycle_res.all_findings)} review findings",
3374            )
3375            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
3376
3377            self._record_event(
3378                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3379                agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
3380                action="remediation_started",
3381                spec=task_spec,
3382                metadata={"cycle": remediation_count, "findings_count": len(cycle_res.all_findings)},
3383            )
3384
3385            rem_cycle_dir = remediation_base_dir / f"cycle-{remediation_count:02d}"
3386            rem_cycle_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
3387
3388            rem_resource_id = (
3389                final_impl_resource_id or routing.selected_agent_id
3390            )
3391            rem_backend = self._resolve_backend(rem_resource_id)
3392            rem_agent_id = getattr(rem_backend, "agent_id", None) or rem_resource_id
3393            rem_res = None
3394            rem_failure = None
3395            remediation_timeout = None
3396            if not self.config.custom_remediation_fn:
3397                rem_prompt = self._build_remediation_prompt(task_spec, current_delta.diff_content, cycle_res.all_findings)
3398                affected_files = set(current_delta.files_modified + current_delta.files_added)
3399                remediation_timeout = compute_remediation_timeout(
3400                    self.config, cycle_res.all_findings, affected_files
3401                )
3402            with progress.operation(
3403                phase=TaskPhase.REMEDIATING,
3404                resource_id=rem_agent_id,
3405                role="remediation",
3406                cycle=remediation_count,
3407                details=f"cycle {remediation_count}",
3408                deadline_seconds=remediation_timeout,
3409            ):
3410                if self.config.custom_remediation_fn:
3411                    self.config.custom_remediation_fn(task_spec, self.target_repo, cycle_res.all_findings)
3412                else:
3413                    self._record_event(
3414                        task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3415                        agent_id=rem_agent_id,
3416                        action="remediation_timeout_derived",
3417                        spec=task_spec,
3418                        metadata={
3419                            "cycle": remediation_count,
3420                            "timeout_seconds": remediation_timeout,
3421                            "findings_count": len(cycle_res.all_findings),
3422                            "affected_files_count": len(affected_files),
3423                            "run_mode": self.config.run_mode,
3424                            "remediation_timeout_ceiling": (
3425                                self.config.bounded_remediation_timeout_ceiling_seconds
3426                                if self.config.run_mode == "bounded"
3427                                else None
3428                            ),
3429                        },
3430                    )
3431                    rem_res = rem_backend.execute(
3432                        task=task_spec,
3433                        cwd=self.target_repo,
3434                        role="remediation",
3435                        prompt_override=rem_prompt,
3436                        timeout_seconds=remediation_timeout,
3437                    )
3438                    (rem_cycle_dir / "result.json").write_text(rem_res.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
3439                    if self.config.provider_pool is not None:
3440                        rem_failure = self.config.provider_pool.record_result(
3441                            rem_resource_id, rem_res, task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3442                        )
3443                    else:
3444                        from howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool import ProviderPoolManager
3445
3446                        rem_failure = ProviderPoolManager.classify_result(rem_resource_id, rem_res)
3447
3448            current_delta = self._capture_scoped_delta(
3449                task_spec, baseline, routing.selected_agent_id, stage="remediation"
3450            )
3451            self._write_delta_patch(current_delta, rem_cycle_dir, run_dir)
3452
3453            if rem_res is not None and not rem_res.success:
3454                # Evidence must survive, but incomplete remediation must not be
3455                # recorded as completed or leak into a later task's baseline.
3456                # Restore the whole task, including earlier remediation cycles;
3457                # the cumulative patch above preserves all of that work.
3458                restored, restore_error = restore_repository_to_baseline(
3459                    self.target_repo, baseline, current_delta,
3460                )
3461                failure_class = self._map_failure_class_to_orchestrator_class(rem_failure)
3462                error = rem_res.error_message or rem_res.stderr or "Remediation worker failed"
3463                if not restored:
3464                    error += f"; baseline restore failed: {restore_error}"
3465                disposition = {
3466                    "resource_id": rem_resource_id,
3467                    "failure_class": failure_class,
3468                    "provider_failure_class": getattr(rem_failure, "value", None),
3469                    "rollback": {"restored": restored, "error": restore_error},
3470                }
3471                (rem_cycle_dir / "failure.json").write_text(
3472                    json.dumps(disposition, indent=2), encoding="utf-8",
3473                )
3474                self._record_event(
3475                    task_id=task_spec.task_id, agent_id=rem_resource_id,
3476                    action="remediation_failed", spec=task_spec, metadata=disposition,
3477                )
3478                return self._fail_task(
3479                    task_spec, run_dir, error, start_time,
3480                    exit_code=rem_res.exit_code or 1, progress_tracker=progress,
3481                    stage="remediating", routing=routing, current_delta=current_delta,
3482                    review_cycles=review_cycles, verif_plan=verif_plan,
3483                    remediation_count=remediation_count, provider_execution=rem_res,
3484                    failure_class=failure_class, implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts,
3485                )
3486
3487            self._record_event(
3488                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3489                agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
3490                action="remediation_completed",
3491                spec=task_spec,
3492                metadata={"cycle": remediation_count, "files_modified": len(current_delta.files_modified)},
3493            )
3494            self._record_delta_captured(task_spec)
3495            CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
3496                run_dir,
3497                "remediating",
3498                output_artifacts=[str(rem_cycle_dir / "diff.patch")],
3499            )
3500
3501            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
3502                self.config.failure_injection_hook("post_remediation", run_dir, task_spec)
3503
3504            current_reviewers = ReviewRunner.determine_re_review_roles(
3505                cycle_res.all_findings,
3506                routing.recommended_reviewers,
3507            )
3508            task_spec.transition_to("reviewing", f"Re-review cycle {remediation_count + 1} for targeted roles: {current_reviewers}")
3509            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
3510
3511        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3512        # Stage 6: Deterministic Verification Gate (verifying)
3513        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3514        if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
3515            self.config.failure_injection_hook("verifying", run_dir, task_spec)
3516
3517        # The same gate the resume path runs, called rather than restated, so a
3518        # task verified after a pre-verification escalation and a task verified
3519        # in one pass cannot reach different conclusions from the same evidence
3520        # (issues.md #12).
3521        verif_status = self.run_deterministic_verification(
3522            task_spec,
3523            run_dir=run_dir,
3524            progress=progress,
3525            verif_plan=verif_plan,
3526            baseline=baseline,
3527            delta=current_delta,
3528        )
3529        verif_summary = {s.name: s.status for s in verif_plan.steps}
3530        if verif_status != "passed":
3531            failed_steps = [s.name for s in verif_plan.steps if s.status == "failed" and s.required]
3532            err_msg = f"Deterministic verification failed on required steps: {', '.join(failed_steps)}"
3533            # A salvaged candidate only ever existed on sufferance. Governance
3534            # has now rejected it, so the repository goes back to its pre-task
3535            # baseline rather than keeping a patch nothing stands behind. A
3536            # provider-attested implementation still keeps its diff in place for
3537            # inspection, as before.
3538            if timeout_candidate is not None and not current_delta.is_empty:
3539                restored_ok, restore_err = restore_repository_to_baseline(
3540                    self.target_repo, baseline, current_delta
3541                )
3542                self._record_event(
3543                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3544                    agent_id="control_plane",
3545                    action="timeout_candidate_rejected",
3546                    spec=task_spec,
3547                    metadata={
3548                        "stage": "verifying",
3549                        "origin": CANDIDATE_ORIGIN_TIMED_OUT,
3550                        "rollback_restored": restored_ok,
3551                        "rollback_error": restore_err,
3552                        "failed_steps": failed_steps,
3553                    },
3554                )
3555                if not restored_ok:
3556                    err_msg = (
3557                        f"{err_msg}. Repository could not be restored to baseline "
3558                        f"({restore_err}); candidate changes remain."
3559                    )
3560            return self._fail_task(
3561                task_spec,
3562                run_dir,
3563                err_msg,
3564                start_time,
3565                exit_code=1,
3566                progress_tracker=progress,
3567                stage="verifying",
3568                routing=routing,
3569                initial_delta=initial_delta,
3570                current_delta=current_delta,
3571                review_cycles=review_cycles,
3572                reconciliation=latest_reconciliation,
3573                verif_plan=verif_plan,
3574                hf_status=hf_audit_status,
3575                hf_match=hf_audit_match,
3576                remediation_count=remediation_count,
3577                provider_execution=impl_res,
3578                failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_VERIFICATION,
3579                timeout_candidate=timeout_candidate,
3580            )
3581
3582        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3583        # Stage 7: Human Authority Boundary Gate (awaiting_human)
3584        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3585        actions_to_check = list(planned_actions or [])
3586        if any(kw in task_spec.objective.lower() for kw in ["deploy", "terraform apply", "kubectl apply", "drop table"]):
3587            actions_to_check.append(task_spec.objective)
3588
3589        boundary_res = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate(
3590            task=task_spec,
3591            planned_actions=actions_to_check,
3592            change_summary=f"Changed {len(current_delta.files_modified) + len(current_delta.files_added)} files (+{current_delta.insertions}/-{current_delta.deletions})",
3593            reconciliation=latest_reconciliation,
3594            verification=verif_plan,
3595            non_independent_roles=sorted(
3596                {role for cyc in review_cycles for role in cyc.non_independent_roles}
3597            ),
3598        )
3599
3600        stage_kwargs = dict(
3601            start_time=start_time,
3602            run_dir=run_dir,
3603            routing=routing,
3604            initial_delta=initial_delta,
3605            current_delta=current_delta,
3606            review_cycles=review_cycles,
3607            reconciliation=latest_reconciliation,
3608            verif_plan=verif_plan,
3609            boundary_res=boundary_res,
3610            hf_status=hf_audit_status,
3611            hf_match=hf_audit_match,
3612            remediation_count=remediation_count,
3613            provider_execution=impl_res,
3614            implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts,
3615            failover_summary=self._build_failover_summary(
3616                implementation_attempts,
3617                TERMINATION_IMPLEMENTATION_SUCCEEDED
3618                if timeout_candidate is None
3619                else TERMINATION_TIMEOUT_CANDIDATE_GOVERNED,
3620                last_selection_decision,
3621            ),
3622            timeout_candidate=timeout_candidate,
3623        )
3624
3625        if boundary_res.requires_human_approval:
3626            progress.record_terminal(
3627                TaskProgressState.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
3628                TaskPhase.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
3629            )
3630            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
3631                run_dir,
3632                task_spec.task_id,
3633                "awaiting_human",
3634                repo_path=self.target_repo,
3635                metadata={"boundary_triggers": boundary_res.triggered_boundaries},
3636            )
3637            task_spec.transition_to("awaiting_human", f"Human authority boundary triggered: {boundary_res.triggered_boundaries}")
3638            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
3639
3640            if boundary_res.decision_packet:
3641                (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(boundary_res.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
3642
3643            self._record_human_boundary_events(
3644                task_spec, run_dir, boundaries=boundary_res.triggered_boundaries
3645            )
3646
3647            return self._make_result(
3648                task_spec, "awaiting_human", 2,
3649                failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED, **stage_kwargs,
3650            )
3651
3652        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3653        # Stage 8: Governed Completion (complete)
3654        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3655        CheckpointManager.start_stage(
3656            run_dir,
3657            task_spec.task_id,
3658            "complete",
3659            repo_path=self.target_repo,
3660        )
3661        task_spec.transition_to("complete", "All reviews, reconciliations, deterministic verifications, and policies passed.")
3662        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
3663
3664        # The one place acceptance becomes true. Everything before this point
3665        # survived review, reconciliation, deterministic verification and the
3666        # human authority boundary; only now is there an accepted implementer.
3667        if final_impl_resource_id is not None:
3668            self._persist_effective_route(
3669                routing,
3670                task_spec,
3671                final_impl_resource_id,
3672                ROUTE_STATUS_SUPERSEDED
3673                if final_impl_resource_id != routing.metadata.get(
3674                    "initial_implementation_resource", routing.selected_agent_id
3675                )
3676                else ROUTE_STATUS_ACCEPTED,
3677                accepted=True,
3678                # Acceptance does not erase how the work arrived. A candidate
3679                # that cleared governance is still a candidate in provenance.
3680                candidate_resource=(
3681                    final_impl_resource_id if timeout_candidate else None
3682                ),
3683                # Acceptance names an accepted implementer; it does not
3684                # retroactively make a promoted fallback the last resource that
3685                # was actually attempted.
3686                last_attempted_resource_id=salvage_last_attempted_id,
3687            )
3688
3689        # Generate summary markdown
3690        summary_md = self._render_summary_markdown(
3691            task=task_spec,
3692            routing=routing,
3693            delta=current_delta,
3694            review_cycles=review_cycles,
3695            verif_plan=verif_plan,
3696            remediation_count=remediation_count,
3697            hf_status=hf_audit_status,
3698        )
3699        (run_dir / "summary.md").write_text(summary_md, encoding="utf-8")
3700
3701        self._record_event(
3702            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3703            agent_id="control_plane",
3704            action="task_completed",
3705            spec=task_spec,
3706            metadata={
3707                "remediation_cycles": remediation_count,
3708                "verification_status": verif_status,
3709                "files_changed": len(current_delta.files_modified) + len(current_delta.files_added),
3710            },
3711        )
3712        CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
3713            run_dir,
3714            "complete",
3715            output_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "summary.md")],
3716        )
3717
3718        progress.record_terminal(
3719            TaskProgressState.COMPLETE,
3720            TaskPhase.COMPLETE,
3721        )
3722        self._prune_ephemeral_scratch(run_dir, task_spec.task_id)
3723        return self._make_result(task_spec, "complete", 0, **stage_kwargs)

3809    def _fail_task(
3810        self,
3811        task_spec: TaskSpec,
3812        run_dir: Path,
3813        err_msg: str,
3814        start_time: float,
3815        exit_code: int = 1,
3816        agent_id: str = "control_plane",
3817        progress_tracker: Optional[Any] = None,
3818        **kwargs,
3819    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
3820        # Capture the original active stage identity BEFORE modifying task_spec state
3821        active_stage = kwargs.pop("stage", None)
3822        if not active_stage or active_stage in ("failed", "cancelled"):
3823            active_stage = task_spec.current_state
3824        if not active_stage or active_stage in ("failed", "cancelled"):
3825            latest_chk = CheckpointManager.load_latest_checkpoint(run_dir)
3826            if latest_chk and latest_chk.stage not in ("failed", "cancelled"):
3827                active_stage = latest_chk.stage
3828
3829        # Terminalize current stage checkpoint so it does not remain permanently in_progress
3830        try:
3831            delta = kwargs.get("current_delta") or kwargs.get("initial_delta")
3832            summary: Dict[str, Any] = {
3833                "error": err_msg,
3834                "exit_code": exit_code,
3835            }
3836            if kwargs.get("failure_class"):
3837                summary["failure_class"] = kwargs.get("failure_class")
3838            if delta is not None:
3839                summary.update(delta.to_event_metadata())
3840                summary["partial_work"] = not delta.is_empty
3841            CheckpointManager.fail_stage(
3842                run_dir,
3843                stage=active_stage,
3844                reason=err_msg,
3845                result_summary=summary,
3846            )
3847        except Exception:
3848            pass
3849
3850        if progress_tracker is not None:
3851            progress_tracker.record_terminal(
3852                TaskProgressState.FAILED,
3853                TaskPhase.FAILED,
3854                error_message=err_msg,
3855            )
3856        task_spec.transition_to("failed", err_msg)
3857        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
3858
3859        self._record_event(
3860            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3861            agent_id=agent_id,
3862            action="task_failed",
3863            result=err_msg,
3864            spec=task_spec,
3865        )
3866        self._prune_ephemeral_scratch(run_dir, task_spec.task_id)
3867        return self._make_result(
3868            task_spec=task_spec,
3869            final_state="failed",
3870            exit_code=exit_code,
3871            start_time=start_time,
3872            run_dir=run_dir,
3873            err_msg=err_msg,
3874            **kwargs,
3875        )
3876

3955    def _render_summary_markdown(
3956        self,
3957        task: TaskSpec,
3958        routing: RoutingDecision,
3959        delta: RepositoryDelta,
3960        review_cycles: List[ReviewCycleResult],
3961        verif_plan: VerificationPlan,
3962        remediation_count: int,
3963        hf_status: Optional[str],
3964    ) -> str:
3965        # One authoritative answer, not a per-line re-derivation. `actual_agent`
3966        # mirrors the effective implementer once implementation settles; the
3967        # explicit field wins where both exist (issues.md #16).
3968        implementer_id = (
3969            task.effective_implementer_resource_id
3970            or task.actual_agent
3971            or routing.selected_agent_id
3972        )
3973        lines = [
3974            f"# Governed Task Run Summary: `{task.task_id}`",
3975            "",
3976            "## Overview",
3977            f"- **Objective:** {task.objective}",
3978            f"- **Repository:** {self.target_repo.name}",
3979            f"- **Final State:** `{task.current_state.upper()}`",
3980            f"- **Implementing Agent:** {implementer_id} (`{implementer_id}`)",
3981            f"- **Reasoning Tier:** {routing.reasoning_tier}",
3982            f"- **HowlFrame Shadow Audit:** {hf_status or 'N/A'}",
3983            "",
3984        ]
3985        if implementer_id and implementer_id != routing.selected_agent_id:
3986            lines.append(f"- **Initial Route:** {routing.selected_agent_name} (`{routing.selected_agent_id}`)")
3987            lines.append("")
3988        lines.extend([
3989            "## Repository Changes",
3990            f"- **Files Added:** {len(delta.files_added)}",
3991            f"- **Files Modified:** {len(delta.files_modified)}",
3992            f"- **Files Deleted:** {len(delta.files_deleted)}",
3993            f"- **Total Insertions:** +{delta.insertions}",
3994            f"- **Total Deletions:** -{delta.deletions}",
3995            "",
3996            "## Review & Remediation",
3997            f"- **Total Review Cycles:** {len(review_cycles)}",
3998            f"- **Remediation Cycles:** {remediation_count}",
3999        ])
4000        if review_cycles:
4001            last_cycle = review_cycles[-1]
4002            lines.append(f"- **Final Review Status:** `{last_cycle.status}`")
4003            for role, res in sorted(last_cycle.reviewer_results.items()):
4004                lines.append(f"  - `{role}`: {res.status} ({len(res.findings)} findings)")
4005
4006        lines.extend([
4007            "",
4008            "## Deterministic Verification",
4009            f"- **Overall Status:** `{verif_plan.overall_status.upper()}`",
4010        ])
4011        executed_steps = [
4012            s for s in verif_plan.steps
4013            if s.exit_code is not None or s.status in ("verified", "failed")
4014        ]
4015        if not executed_steps and verif_plan.steps:
4016            lines.append(f"- **Discovered:** {len(verif_plan.steps)} steps (not executed — implementation failed before verification)")
4017        for step in verif_plan.steps:
4018            if step.exit_code is not None or step.status in ("verified", "failed"):
4019                mark = "✓" if step.status == "verified" else "✗"
4020                lines.append(f"- [{mark}] **{step.name}** (`{step.category}`): {step.status} (exit {step.exit_code})")
4021            else:
4022                lines.append(f"- [ ] **{step.name}** (`{step.category}`): {step.status}")
4023
4024        lines.extend([
4025            "",
4026            "---",
4027            "*Verified and sealed by HowlPlane AI Engineering Control Plane.*",
4028        ])
4029        return "\n".join(lines)

Drives the end-to-end governed engineering lifecycle, maintaining strict control over state transitions, adversarial reviews, remediation loops, verification gates, and human authority boundaries.

GovernedTaskOrchestrator( target_repo: Union[str, pathlib.Path], control_plane_root: Union[str, pathlib.Path, NoneType] = None, config: Optional[OrchestrationConfig] = None)
